-- DaDa UI v5: native menu; gameplay code and config IDs preserved.
-- Native MM2 Skinchanger. Renderer adapted from the supplied skinchanger by belfor.
-- The weapon catalogue is loaded remotely; no weapon/mesh table is embedded here.
local function mountDaDaSkinChanger(panel, pal)
    local DATA_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mavey184-cyber/Menu/refs/heads/main/MM2_SkinMeshData.lua"
    local LocalPlayer = LP
    local MESHES = {}
    local active, enabled, loading = true, false, false
    local generation = 0
    local selected = {Knife = nil, Gun = nil}
    local selectionBindings = {}
    local fallbackRotation = {
        Gingerscope={X=90,Y=0,Z=0},
        Harvester={X=90,Y=0,Z=0},
        Icepiercer={X=90,Y=0,Z=0},
    }
    local items, filtered = {}, {}
    local records, templates = {}, {}
    local heldTemplates, nativeWarnings = {}, {}
    local inventoryChanges = {}
    local lastChoice, filterType, page = nil, "All", 1
    local PAGE_SIZE = 30
    local render, filterItems, loadCatalogue
    local statusLabel, selectionLabel, enabledBinding
    local statusText = "Loading weapon catalogue..."
    local statusColor = pal.muted
    local function alive()
        return active and not espLifecycle.stopped
    end
    local function setStatus(message, color)
        statusText = tostring(message)
        statusColor = color or pal.muted
        if statusLabel and statusLabel.Parent and alive() then
            statusLabel.Text = statusText
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = statusColor
        end
    end
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections, connection)
        return connection
    end

local function trimAsset(v)
    if type(v) == 'string' then
        return (v:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', ''))
    end

    return v
end
local function applyProps(inst, props, skip)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {})do
        if not (skip and skip[k]) then
            if k == 'MeshId' or k == 'TextureId' or k == 'TextureID' or k == 'Texture' then
                v = trimAsset(v)
            end

            pcall(function()
                inst[k] = v
            end)
        end
    end
end
local function createMeshPart(props)
    local meshId = trimAsset(props.MeshId or '')
    local size = props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local part

    pcall(function()
        part = game:GetService('InsertService'):CreateMeshPartAsync(meshId, Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise)
    end)

    if part then
        pcall(function()
            part.Size = size
        end)

        return part
    end

    local p = Instance.new('Part')

    p.Size = size

    local sm = Instance.new('SpecialMesh')

    sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

    pcall(function()
        sm.MeshId = meshId
    end)
    pcall(function()
        sm.TextureId = trimAsset(props.TextureID or '')
    end)

    sm.Parent = p

    return p
end

local CHROMA = {
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0),
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255),
}

local function chromaColor(t)
    local n = #CHROMA
    local phase = t % n
    local i = math.floor(phase)

    return CHROMA[i + 1]:Lerp(CHROMA[((i + 1) % n) + 1], phase - i)
end
local function isChroma(name, data)
    if data.Meta and data.Meta.Chroma == true then
        return true
    end

    return name:sub(-6) == 'Chroma'
end

local CHROMA_FLASH_RATE = 1.8
local CHROMA_LAYER = 'rbxassetid://18363392181'

local function startChroma(overlay)
    local flashParts, smoothDecals, smoothOther = {}, {}, {}
    local tagged = false

    for _, d in ipairs(overlay:GetDescendants())do
        local role = d:GetAttribute('MM2Chroma')

        if role then
            tagged = true

            if role == 'part' then
                flashParts[#flashParts + 1] = d
            elseif role == 'decal' and d:IsA('Decal') then
                pcall(function()
                    d.Texture = CHROMA_LAYER
                end)

                smoothDecals[#smoothDecals + 1] = d
            elseif role == 'fire' then
                smoothOther[#smoothOther + 1] = d
            end
        end
    end

    if not tagged then
        for _, d in ipairs(overlay:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA('BasePart') and (d.Material == Enum.Material.Neon or d.Name:lower():find('light')) then
                flashParts[#flashParts + 1] = d
            elseif d:IsA('Decal') and d.Name:lower():find('chroma') then
                smoothDecals[#smoothDecals + 1] = d
            elseif d:IsA('Fire') then
                smoothOther[#smoothOther + 1] = d
            end
        end

        if #smoothDecals == 0 then
            smoothOther[#smoothOther + 1] = overlay
        end
    end
    if #flashParts == 0 and #smoothDecals == 0 and #smoothOther == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    return RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local now = os.clock()
        local col = chromaColor(now)

        for _, s in ipairs(smoothDecals)do
            s.Color3 = col
        end
        for _, s in ipairs(smoothOther)do
            if s:IsA('Fire') then
                s.Color = col
            elseif s:IsA('BasePart') then
                s.Color = col
            end
        end

        local step = math.floor(now * CHROMA_FLASH_RATE)

        for i, b in ipairs(flashParts)do
            b.Color = CHROMA[((step + i - 1) % #CHROMA) + 1]
        end
    end)
end

local STRUCTURAL = {
    WeldConstraint = true,
    Weld = true,
    Motor6D = true,
    RigidConstraint = true,
    Bone = true,
    Snap = true,
    ManualWeld = true,
    Rotate = true,
    RotateP = true,
    RotateV = true,
}

local function chromaTag(inst, node)
    if not (inst and node.Tags) then
        return
    end

    for _, t in ipairs(node.Tags)do
        local r = (t == 'ChromaPart' and 'part') or (t == 'ChromaDecal' and 'decal') or (t == 'ChromaFire' and 'fire') or nil

        if r then
            pcall(function()
                inst:SetAttribute('MM2Chroma', r)
            end)
        end
    end
end
local function instantiateNode(node)
    local cls = node.Class

    if STRUCTURAL[cls] then
        return nil
    end

    local inst

    if cls == 'MeshPart' then
        inst = createMeshPart(node.Props)

        applyProps(inst, node.Props, {
            MeshId = true,
            Size = true,
            RelCF = true,
            CanCollide = true,
        })
    else
        local ok, res = pcall(Instance.new, cls)

        if not ok or not res then
            return nil
        end

        inst = res

        applyProps(inst, node.Props, {RelCF = true})
    end

    inst.Name = node.Name or inst.Name
    chromaTag(inst, node)

    return inst
end
local function rebuildTree(node, parentInst, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)
    for _, child in ipairs(node.Children or {})do
        local inst = instantiateNode(child)

        if inst then
            idToInst[child.Id] = inst

            if inst:IsA('BasePart') then
                inst.Anchored, inst.CanCollide, inst.CanQuery, inst.CanTouch, inst.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
                parts[#parts + 1] = {
                    inst = inst,
                    relcf = child.Props.RelCF,
                }
                inst.Parent = root

                rebuildTree(child, inst, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)
            elseif inst:IsA('Attachment') then
                if child.Props.RelCF then
                    pcall(function()
                        inst.CFrame = child.Props.RelCF
                    end)
                end

                inst.Parent = root

                rebuildTree(child, inst, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)
            elseif inst:IsA('Beam') or inst:IsA('Trail') then
                inst.Parent = parentInst
                deferred[#deferred + 1] = {
                    inst = inst,
                    a0 = child.Att0,
                    a1 = child.Att1,
                }

                rebuildTree(child, inst, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)
            else
                inst.Parent = parentInst

                rebuildTree(child, inst, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)
            end
        else
            rebuildTree(child, parentInst, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)
        end
    end
end
local function buildFullOverlay(data)
    local rn = data.Model

    if not rn then
        return nil
    end

    local root

    if rn.Class == 'MeshPart' then
        root = createMeshPart(rn.Props)

        applyProps(root, rn.Props, {
            MeshId = true,
            Size = true,
            RelCF = true,
            CanCollide = true,
        })
    else
        root = Instance.new('Part')

        applyProps(root, rn.Props, {
            RelCF = true,
            CanCollide = true,
        })
    end

    chromaTag(root, rn)
    -- These are DISPLAY mounts, not a Tool's hand grip. Keep the marker only
    -- for display-to-display alignment; never compare it with Tool.Grip.
    local rigidMount,plainGrip=false,false
    for _,child in ipairs(rn.Children or {}) do
        if child.Class=='RigidConstraint' then rigidMount=true end
        if child.Class=='Attachment' and child.Name=='Attachment' then plainGrip=true end
    end
    if rigidMount and plainGrip then root:SetAttribute('DaDaGripAttachment','Attachment') end

    root.Anchored, root.CanCollide, root.CanQuery, root.CanTouch, root.Massless = false, false, false, false, true

    local idToInst = {
        [rn.Id] = root,
    }
    local parts, deferred = {}, {}

    rebuildTree(rn, root, root, idToInst, parts, deferred)

    for _, d in ipairs(deferred)do
        if d.a0 and idToInst[d.a0] then
            pcall(function()
                d.inst.Attachment0 = idToInst[d.a0]
            end)
        end
        if d.a1 and idToInst[d.a1] then
            pcall(function()
                d.inst.Attachment1 = idToInst[d.a1]
            end)
        end
    end

    return {
        root = root,
        parts = parts,
    }
end
local function finalizeOverlay(built, targetCF)
    local root = built.root

    pcall(function()
        root.CFrame = targetCF
    end)

    for _, p in ipairs(built.parts)do
        if p.relcf then
            pcall(function()
                p.inst.CFrame = targetCF * p.relcf
            end)
        end

        local w = Instance.new('WeldConstraint')

        w.Part0 = p.inst
        w.Part1 = root
        w.Parent = p.inst
    end

    return root
end

local PARTICLE_CLASSES = {
    ParticleEmitter = true,
    Fire = true,
    Smoke = true,
    Sparkles = true,
    PointLight = true,
    SpotLight = true,
    SurfaceLight = true,
}

local function buildFlatOverlay(data)
    local root, meshes, decals, effects

    do
        root, meshes, decals, effects = nil, {}, {}, {}

        for _, e in ipairs(data.Display or {})do
            if e.Path == '(root)' then
                root = e
            elseif e.Class == 'SpecialMesh' then
                meshes[#meshes + 1] = e
            elseif e.Class == 'Decal' or e.Class == 'Texture' then
                decals[#decals + 1] = e
            elseif PARTICLE_CLASSES[e.Class] then
                effects[#effects + 1] = e
            end
        end
    end

    if not root then
        return nil
    end

    local part

    if root.Class == 'MeshPart' then
        part = createMeshPart(root.Props)

        applyProps(part, root.Props, {
            MeshId = true,
            Size = true,
            CanCollide = true,
        })
    else
        part = Instance.new('Part')
        part.Size = root.Props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

        applyProps(part, root.Props, {
            Size = true,
            CanCollide = true,
        })

        for _, m in ipairs(meshes)do
            local sm = Instance.new('SpecialMesh')

            sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

            applyProps(sm, m.Props)

            sm.Parent = part
        end
    end

    part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Massless = false, false, false, false, true

    for _, d in ipairs(decals)do
        local dc = Instance.new('Decal')

        applyProps(dc, d.Props)

        dc.Parent = part
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(effects)do
        local ok, inst = pcall(Instance.new, e.Class)

        if ok and inst then
            applyProps(inst, e.Props)

            inst.Parent = part
        end
    end

    return {
        root = part,
        parts = {},
    }
end
local function buildAnyOverlay(data)
    if data.Model then
        return buildFullOverlay(data)
    end
    if data.Display then
        return buildFlatOverlay(data)
    end

    return nil
end

    local function dropRecord(base)
        local record = records[base]
        if not record then return end
        records[base] = nil
        if record.chroma then pcall(function() record.chroma:Disconnect() end) end
        if record.overlay then pcall(function() record.overlay:Destroy() end) end
        for _, saved in ipairs(record.hidden) do
            pcall(function() saved.inst[saved.prop] = saved.value end)
        end
    end
    local function clearRecords()
        local bases = {}
        for base in pairs(records) do bases[#bases + 1] = base end
        for _, base in ipairs(bases) do dropRecord(base) end
    end
    local function clearTemplates()
        for _, cache in ipairs({templates, heldTemplates}) do
            for _, template in pairs(cache) do
                if template then pcall(function() template:Destroy() end) end
            end
            table.clear(cache)
        end
        table.clear(nativeWarnings)
    end
    local function hideOriginal(record, base)
        local function hide(instance)
            if instance == record.overlay or instance:IsDescendantOf(record.overlay)
                or record.seen[instance] then return end
            local property
            if instance:IsA('BasePart') or instance:IsA('Decal') or instance:IsA('Texture') then
                property = 'Transparency'
            elseif instance:IsA('ParticleEmitter') or instance:IsA('Trail')
                or instance:IsA('Beam') or instance:IsA('Fire')
                or instance:IsA('Smoke') or instance:IsA('Sparkles')
                or instance:IsA('Light') then
                property = 'Enabled'
            end
            if not property then return end
            local ok = pcall(function()
                local value = instance[property]
                instance[property] = property == 'Transparency' and 1 or false
                record.hidden[#record.hidden + 1] = {inst=instance, prop=property, value=value}
            end)
            if ok then record.seen[instance] = true end
        end
        hide(base)
        for _, descendant in ipairs(base:GetDescendants()) do hide(descendant) end
    end
    local function collectTargets()
        local targets = {}
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass('Backpack')
        local function scan(container)
            if not container then return end
            for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA('Tool') then
                    local slot
                    if tool.Name == 'Gun' or CollectionService:HasTag(tool, 'Weapon_Gun') then
                        slot = 'Gun'
                    elseif tool.Name == 'Knife' or CollectionService:HasTag(tool, 'Weapon_Knife') then
                        slot = 'Knife'
                    end
                    local handle = slot and tool:FindFirstChild('Handle')
                    if handle and handle:IsA('BasePart') then targets[handle] = slot end
                end
            end
        end
        scan(character)
        scan(backpack)
        if character then
            for _, slot in ipairs({'Knife', 'Gun'}) do
                local ref = character:FindFirstChild('DisplayRef' .. slot)
                local base = ref and ref:IsA('ObjectValue') and ref.Value
                if base and base:IsA('Model') then
                    base = base.PrimaryPart or base:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)
                end
                if base and base:IsA('BasePart') and base.Parent then targets[base] = slot end
            end
        end
        return targets
    end
    -- The catalogue contains GunDisplay/KnifeDisplay models. Their
    -- CustomAttachment (including legacy "Attachment") is a holster mount,
    -- NOT the point Roblox uses for a held Tool. Resolve a real Tool for the
    -- held variant, keeping its own Handle geometry and its own hand grip.
    local function findNativeTool(container, name, slot, allowUnique)
        local candidates = {}
        local function consider(instance)
            if not instance:IsA('Tool') then return end
            local handle = instance:FindFirstChild('Handle')
            if not handle or not handle:IsA('BasePart') then return end
            local parent = instance.Parent
            if instance.Name == name or (parent and parent.Name == name) then
                candidates[#candidates + 1] = {tool=instance, exact=true}
            elseif allowUnique then
                candidates[#candidates + 1] = {tool=instance, exact=false}
            end
        end
        consider(container)
        for _, descendant in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do consider(descendant) end
        local exact, unique
        local exactCount, count = 0, 0
        for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
            count += 1
            unique = candidate.tool
            if candidate.exact then exactCount += 1; exact = candidate.tool end
        end
        -- Never silently pick an arbitrary skin out of a multi-Tool package.
        if exactCount == 1 then return exact end
        if exactCount == 0 and allowUnique and count == 1 then return unique end
        return nil
    end
    local function nativeVisual(instance)
        return instance:IsA('BasePart') or instance:IsA('DataModelMesh')
            or instance:IsA('Attachment') or instance:IsA('Decal')
            or instance:IsA('Texture') or instance:IsA('Beam')
            or instance:IsA('Trail') or instance:IsA('SurfaceAppearance')
            or instance:IsA('Folder') or instance:IsA('Model')
            or PARTICLE_CLASSES[instance.ClassName] == true
    end
    local function buildHeldTemplate(source, name)
        local sourceHandle = source:FindFirstChild('Handle')
        if not sourceHandle or not sourceHandle:IsA('BasePart') then return nil end
        local grip = source.Grip
        local copy = source:Clone()
        if not copy then return nil end
        local root
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            root = copy:FindFirstChild('Handle')
            assert(root and root:IsA('BasePart'), 'Native Tool has no cloneable Handle')
            -- Nothing is parented into the live game before scripts, remotes,
            -- old joints and other nonvisual objects have been removed.
            local function sanitize(parent)
                for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                    if nativeVisual(child) then sanitize(child) else child:Destroy() end
                end
            end
            sanitize(copy)
            local parts, origin = {}, root.CFrame
            for _, part in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA('BasePart') then
                    parts[#parts + 1] = {inst=part, relcf=origin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)}
                end
            end
            root.Parent = nil
            for _, child in ipairs(copy:GetChildren()) do child.Parent = root end
            copy:Destroy()
            -- No live hand, Tool.Grip, RightGrip or original mesh is modified.
            for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                local instance = part.inst
                instance.Anchored, instance.CanCollide = false, false
                instance.CanTouch, instance.CanQuery, instance.Massless = false, false, true
                instance.CFrame = part.relcf
                if instance ~= root then
                    local weld = Instance.new('WeldConstraint')
                    weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = root, instance, instance
                end
            end
            root.Name = 'DaDaSkinOverlay'
            root.Archivable = true
            root:SetAttribute('DaDaSkinKey', name)
            root:SetAttribute('DaDaHeldGrip', grip)
            return root
        end)
        if not ok then
            if root then pcall(function() root:Destroy() end) end
            pcall(function() copy:Destroy() end)
            return nil
        end
        return result
    end
    local function resolveHeldTemplate(name, version)
        if heldTemplates[name] ~= nil then return heldTemplates[name] or nil end
        local data = MESHES[name]
        local slot = data and data.Meta and data.Meta.ItemType
        if not slot then return nil end
        local function current()
            return alive() and enabled and generation == version
        end
        local source = findNativeTool(ReplicatedStorage, name, slot, false)
        local template = source and buildHeldTemplate(source, name)
        if not template then
            -- ItemID is the real item asset, not the display mesh or thumbnail.
            -- GetObjects may be blocked by Roblox/executor asset permissions;
            -- that failure must not disable the catalogue or hide the weapon.
            local itemID = tonumber(data.Meta.ItemID)
            if itemID and itemID > 0 then
                local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetObjects('rbxassetid://' .. tostring(itemID))
                end)
                if ok and type(objects) == 'table' then
                    if current() then
                        for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
                            local native = findNativeTool(object, name, slot, true)
                            if native then template = buildHeldTemplate(native, name) end
                            if template then break end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, object in ipairs(objects) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
                end
            end
        end
        if not current() then
            if template then template:Destroy() end
            return nil
        end
        -- Negative results are cached too: do not HTTP-load an inaccessible
        -- asset on every reconcile tick. Reload Catalogue clears this cache.
        heldTemplates[name] = template or false
        return template
    end
    local function getTemplate(name, version, base)
        local tool = base and base:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Tool')
        if tool and tool:FindFirstChild('Handle') == base then
            local held = resolveHeldTemplate(name, version)
            if held then return held end
            if not alive() or not enabled or generation ~= version then return nil end
        end
        if templates[name] then return templates[name] end
        local data = MESHES[name]
        if not data then return nil end
        local built = buildAnyOverlay(data)
        if not built or not built.root then
            error('Cannot rebuild the mesh for ' .. tostring(name))
        end
        if not alive() or not enabled or generation ~= version then
            built.root:Destroy()
            return nil
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(finalizeOverlay, built, CFrame.new())
        if not ok then built.root:Destroy(); error(result) end
        result.Name = 'DaDaSkinOverlay'
        result.Archivable = true
        result:SetAttribute('DaDaSkinKey', name)
        templates[name] = result
        return result
    end
    local function displayMount(root)
        -- Direct children only: effect/muzzle attachments are not mounts.
        local custom = root:FindFirstChild('CustomAttachment')
        if custom and custom:IsA('Attachment') then return custom.CFrame end
        if root:GetAttribute('DaDaGripAttachment') == 'Attachment'
            or root:FindFirstChildOfClass('RigidConstraint') then
            local legacy = root:FindFirstChild('Attachment')
            if legacy and legacy:IsA('Attachment') then return legacy.CFrame end
        end
        -- Flat/ordinary display models use their root as the display frame.
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    local function handGrip(base, tool)
        -- C1/C0 is already in Handle coordinates. Do not multiply it by
        -- CustomAttachment or apply Tool.Grip a second time.
        for _, joint in ipairs(base:GetJoints()) do
            if joint:IsA('JointInstance') and joint.Name == 'RightGrip' then
                if joint.Part1 == base then return joint.C1 end
                if joint.Part0 == base then return joint.C0 end
            end
        end
        return tool.Grip
    end
    local function skinMountOffset(base, overlay)
        local tool = base:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Tool')
        if tool and tool:FindFirstChild('Handle') == base then
            local sourceGrip = overlay:GetAttribute('DaDaHeldGrip')
            if typeof(sourceGrip) == 'CFrame' then
                return handGrip(base, tool) * sourceGrip:Inverse()
            end
            -- Display-only special guns use a Z-long mesh, unlike the standard
            -- Handle frame. This fallback is ONLY for these three guns, ONLY
            -- while held, and NEVER combined with a real native Tool grip.
            local rotation=fallbackRotation[overlay:GetAttribute('DaDaSkinKey')]
            if rotation then
                return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotation.X),math.rad(rotation.Y),math.rad(rotation.Z))
            end
            return CFrame.new()
        end
        return displayMount(base) * displayMount(overlay):Inverse()
    end
    local retryAfter = {}
    local function reconcile()
        if not enabled or not next(MESHES) then return end
        local targets = collectTargets()
        local stale = {}
        for base, record in pairs(records) do
            if not base.Parent or targets[base] ~= record.slot or selected[record.slot] ~= record.name
                or not record.overlay.Parent then
                stale[#stale + 1] = base
            end
        end
        for _, base in ipairs(stale) do dropRecord(base) end
        for base, slot in pairs(targets) do
            if not alive() or not enabled then break end
            local name = selected[slot]
            if name and MESHES[name] then
                if records[base] then
                    local record=records[base]
                    -- Equip/rig changes can replace RightGrip after the skin was mounted.
                    record.weld.C0=skinMountOffset(base,record.overlay)
                    hideOriginal(record, base)
                elseif not retryAfter[base] or os.clock() >= retryAfter[base] then
                    local version = generation
                    local overlay, attached
                    local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        local template = getTemplate(name, version, base)
                        if not template or not alive() or not enabled or generation ~= version
                            or selected[slot] ~= name or not base.Parent
                            or collectTargets()[base] ~= slot then return end
                        overlay = template:Clone()
                        if not overlay then error('Cannot clone ' .. name) end
                        -- Held Tool grip and holstered display mount are separate frames.
                        -- Never rotate every skin by the same 90/180 degree correction.
                        local offset=skinMountOffset(base,overlay)
                        local delta=base.CFrame*offset*overlay.CFrame:Inverse()
                        local poses={{part=overlay,cf=overlay.CFrame}}
                        for _, part in ipairs(overlay:GetDescendants()) do
                            if part:IsA('BasePart') then poses[#poses+1]={part=part,cf=part.CFrame} end
                        end
                        for _,pose in ipairs(poses) do pose.part.CFrame=delta*pose.cf end
                        local weld = Instance.new('Weld')
                        weld.Name='DaDaSkinMount'
                        weld.C0,weld.C1=offset,CFrame.new()
                        weld.Part0,weld.Part1,weld.Parent=base,overlay,overlay
                        local record = {overlay=overlay, weld=weld, hidden={}, seen={}, name=name, slot=slot}
                        records[base] = record
                        hideOriginal(record, base)
                        overlay.Parent = base
                        record.chroma = isChroma(name, MESHES[name]) and startChroma(overlay) or nil
                        attached = true
                        local tool = base:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Tool')
                        if tool and tool:FindFirstChild('Handle') == base
                            and not overlay:GetAttribute('DaDaHeldGrip') and not nativeWarnings[name] then
                            nativeWarnings[name] = true
                            warn('[DaDa Skinchanger] ' .. name
                                .. ': native Tool unavailable; using display geometry in the original Handle frame.')
                            setStatus(name .. ': native Tool unavailable; exact held alignment could not be verified.', pal.danger)
                        end
                    end)
                    if not ok then
                        dropRecord(base)
                        if overlay and not attached then pcall(function() overlay:Destroy() end) end
                        retryAfter[base] = os.clock() + 5
                        warn('[DaDa Skinchanger] ' .. tostring(err))
                        setStatus('Mesh error: ' .. tostring(err), pal.danger)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for base in pairs(retryAfter) do
            if not targets[base] then retryAfter[base] = nil end
        end
    end
    local function updateSelections()
        if selectionLabel and selectionLabel.Label then
            selectionLabel:Set('Knife: ' .. (selected.Knife or '—') .. '  |  Gun: ' .. (selected.Gun or '—'))
            selectionLabel.Label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        end
        if render then render() end
    end
    local function setEnabled(value)
        enabled = value == true
        generation += 1
        table.clear(retryAfter)
        if not enabled then
            clearRecords()
            setStatus('Disabled. Original weapon models restored.')
        else
            setStatus('Enabled. Select a skin below; equip a normal Knife / Gun to see it.')
        end
        if render then render() end
    end
    local function restoreChoice(slot,value)
        local key=value~="" and value or nil
        local data=key and MESHES[key]
        if data and data.Meta.ItemType~=slot then error("Skin is not a "..slot..": "..key) end
        selected[slot]=key
        generation+=1
        table.clear(retryAfter)
        local stale={}
        for base,record in pairs(records) do if record.slot==slot then stale[#stale+1]=base end end
        for _,base in ipairs(stale) do dropRecord(base) end
        updateSelections()
    end
    for _,slot in ipairs({'Knife','Gun'}) do
        selectionBindings[slot]=panel:Value('custom/skinchanger/'..slot,'',function(value)
            restoreChoice(slot,value)
        end,function() return selected[slot] or '' end,function(value)
            if type(value)~='string' or #value>200 or value:find('%c') then return false,'invalid skin key' end
            local data=MESHES[value]
            if data and data.Meta.ItemType~=slot then return false,'wrong weapon type' end
            return true,value
        end)
    end
    panel:Value('custom/skinchanger/last-choice','',function(value)
        lastChoice=value~='' and value or nil
    end,function() return lastChoice or '' end,function(value)
        if type(value)=='string' and #value<=200 and not value:find('%c') then return true,value end
        return false,'invalid selected skin'
    end)
    local function choose(key)
        if not alive() then return end
        local data = MESHES[key]
        local slot = data and data.Meta and data.Meta.ItemType
        if slot ~= 'Knife' and slot ~= 'Gun' then error('Unknown weapon type: ' .. tostring(key)) end
        selected[slot], lastChoice = key, key
        -- Keep at most the two selected weapon templates, not every browsed skin.
        for _, cache in ipairs({templates, heldTemplates}) do
            for cachedName, template in pairs(cache) do
                if cachedName ~= selected.Knife and cachedName ~= selected.Gun then
                    if template then template:Destroy() end
                    cache[cachedName] = nil
                    nativeWarnings[cachedName] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        generation += 1
        table.clear(retryAfter)
        -- Prevent the old Extras color-only skins from recoloring the rebuilt weapon.
        if slot == 'Gun' then SHF.gun_skin = 'None' else SHF.knife_skin = 'None' end
        if not enabled then enabledBinding.apply(true) end
        local stale = {}
        for base, record in pairs(records) do
            if record.slot == slot then stale[#stale + 1] = base end
        end
        for _, base in ipairs(stale) do dropRecord(base) end
        updateSelections()
        setStatus('Selected ' .. tostring(data.Meta.ItemName or key) .. ' (' .. slot .. '). Local visual only.', pal.success)
    end

    -- Keep catalogue skins separate from the game's authoritative inventory.
    -- Never insert fake ownership entries into ProfileData.Weapons.Owned.
    local equipBusy = false
    local function addAndEquipSelected()
        if equipBusy or not alive() then return end
        if not lastChoice or not MESHES[lastChoice] then
            setStatus('Select a weapon card first.', pal.danger)
            return
        end
        local key = lastChoice
        local slot = MESHES[key].Meta and MESHES[key].Meta.ItemType
        if slot ~= 'Knife' and slot ~= 'Gun' then
            setStatus('Unknown weapon type: ' .. tostring(key), pal.danger)
            return
        end
        equipBusy = true
        local ownedRequest = false
        local equippedTool = false
        local requestError
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            choose(key)
            assert(alive(), 'Skinchanger unloaded')
            local modules = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Modules')
            local profileModule = modules and modules:FindFirstChild('ProfileData')
            local services = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('ClientServices')
            local equipModule = services and services:FindFirstChild('EquipService')
            -- Preserve the existing game inventory route, but only for owned items.
            if profileModule and profileModule:IsA('ModuleScript')
                and equipModule and equipModule:IsA('ModuleScript') then
                local requestOK, requestResult = pcall(function()
                    local profile = require(profileModule)
                    local owned = type(profile) == 'table' and profile.Weapons and profile.Weapons.Owned
                    if type(owned) ~= 'table' or (tonumber(owned[key]) or 0) < 1 then return false end
                    local equip = require(equipModule)
                    assert(alive(), 'Skinchanger unloaded')
                    assert(type(equip) == 'table' and type(equip.EquipItem) == 'function',
                        'EquipService.EquipItem is unavailable')
                    local result = equip:EquipItem('Weapons', key)
                    assert(result ~= false, 'EquipService rejected the equip request')
                    return true
                end)
                if requestOK then ownedRequest = requestResult == true
                else requestError = tostring(requestResult) end
            end
            assert(alive(), 'Skinchanger unloaded')
            -- A cosmetic selection cannot create a round weapon. Equip only a real
            -- matching Tool already supplied by the game; never clone/rename one.
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass('Backpack')
            local tool = character and character:FindFirstChild(slot)
            if not (tool and tool:IsA('Tool')) then
                tool = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(slot)
            end
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and tool and tool:IsA('Tool') then
                if tool.Parent ~= character then humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end
                equippedTool = tool.Parent == character
            end
        end)
        equipBusy = false
        if not alive() then return end
        if not ok then
            setStatus('Local skin / equip: ' .. tostring(err), pal.danger)
        elseif requestError then
            setStatus('Skin selected locally. Inventory equip failed: ' .. requestError, pal.danger)
        elseif ownedRequest then
            setStatus('Skin selected; owned-item equip requested: ' .. key
                .. '. Server confirmation is not verified.', pal.success)
        elseif equippedTool then
            setStatus('Local skin selected: ' .. key .. '. Existing ' .. slot .. ' equipped.', pal.success)
        else
            setStatus('Local skin selected: ' .. key .. '. Waiting for the game to give you a ' .. slot
                .. '; no inventory ownership changed.', pal.muted)
        end
    end

    enabledBinding = panel:Toggle('Enable Skinchanger', false, setEnabled, nil,
        {get=function() return enabled end})
    panel:Dropdown('Weapon Type', {'All', 'Knife', 'Gun'}, 'All', function(value)
        filterType = value
        if filterItems then filterItems() end
    end, {get=function() return filterType end})
    selectionLabel = panel:Label('Knife: —  |  Gun: —')
    local root = Instance.new('Frame')
    root.Name = 'SkinchangerCatalogue'
    root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 456)
    root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    panel:Mount(root, 'Skinchanger weapon skins catalogue search')
    local search = Instance.new('TextBox')

    search.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    search.BackgroundColor3, search.BorderSizePixel = pal.control, 0
    search.Text, search.PlaceholderText = '', 'Search name, ID, rarity...'
    search.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    search.TextColor3, search.PlaceholderColor3 = pal.text, pal.muted
    search.TextSize, search.Font = 12, Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    search.Parent = root
    Instance.new('UICorner', search).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    local padding = Instance.new('UIPadding', search)
    padding.PaddingLeft, padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), UDim.new(0, 8)

    local renderedPage
    local empty = Instance.new('TextLabel')

    empty.BackgroundTransparency, empty.TextWrapped = 1, true
    empty.TextColor3, empty.Font, empty.TextSize = pal.muted, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 12
    empty.Parent = root
    local footer = Instance.new('TextLabel')
    footer.Position, footer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 374), UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 28)
    footer.BackgroundTransparency, footer.TextColor3 = 1, pal.text
    footer.TextSize, footer.Font, footer.Parent = 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, root

    local previous = nav('‹', UDim2.fromOffset(0, 374))
    local following = nav('›', UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 374))
    statusLabel = Instance.new('TextLabel')
    statusLabel.Name = 'SkinchangerStatus'
    statusLabel.Position, statusLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 410), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency, statusLabel.TextWrapped = 1, true
    statusLabel.TextXAlignment, statusLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    statusLabel.TextSize, statusLabel.Font = 11, Enum.Font.Gotham
    statusLabel.Text, statusLabel.TextColor3, statusLabel.Parent = statusText, statusColor, root

    -- All weapon image metadata comes from the remotely loaded catalogue.
    local function skinThumbnail(id)
        return 'rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=' .. id .. '&w=420&h=420'
    end
    local gameWeaponImages = {}
    local function refreshGameWeaponImages()
        gameWeaponImages = {}
        -- Read image metadata only. Never edit Sync, ProfileData or inventory.
        local database = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Database')
        local module = database and database:FindFirstChild('Sync')
        if not module then return end
        local ok, sync = pcall(require, module)
        if not ok or type(sync) ~= 'table' or type(sync.Weapons) ~= 'table' then return end
        for key, meta in pairs(sync.Weapons) do
            if type(key) == 'string' and type(meta) == 'table' then
                gameWeaponImages[key] = meta.Image or meta.Icon or meta.Thumbnail
            end
        end
    end
    local function skinImageCandidates(meta, key)
        local result, seen = {}, {}
        local function add(uri)
            if uri and uri ~= '' and not seen[uri] then
                seen[uri] = true
                result[#result + 1] = uri
            end
        end
        local function addImage(value)
            if type(value) == 'number' then value = tostring(value) end
            if type(value) ~= 'string' then return end
            value = value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
            local lower = value:lower()
            local id = lower:match('[?&]assetid=(%d+)') or lower:match('[?&]id=(%d+)')
                or lower:match('^rbxassetid://(%d+)$') or lower:match('^(%d+)$')
            if lower:find('rbxthumb://', 1, true) or lower:find('/thumbs/', 1, true) then
                -- A thumbnail asset ID is not necessarily an Image content ID.
                if id then add(skinThumbnail(id)); add('rbxassetid://' .. id)
                else add(value) end
            elseif id then
                add('rbxassetid://' .. id)
                add(skinThumbnail(id))
            elseif value ~= '' then
                add(value)
            end
        end
        -- Optional thumbnail correction lives in the remote data, not this menu.
        local customID = tostring(meta.ImageOverride or ''):match('^(%d+)$')
        if customID then add(skinThumbnail(customID)); add('rbxassetid://' .. customID) end
        addImage(meta.Image)
        addImage(meta.Icon)
        addImage(meta.Thumbnail)
        addImage(gameWeaponImages[key])
        -- ItemID is often the weapon model, so use its thumbnail only last.
        local itemID = tostring(meta.ItemID or ''):match('%d+')
        if itemID then add(skinThumbnail(itemID)) end
        return result
    end
    render = function()
        if not alive() or not root.Parent then return end
        for _, child in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA('GuiObject') then child:Destroy() end
        end
        local pageCount = math.max(1, math.ceil(#filtered / PAGE_SIZE))
        page = math.clamp(page, 1, pageCount)
        if renderedPage ~= page then grid.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero; renderedPage = page end
        footer.Text = string.format('%d / %d · %d skins', page, pageCount, #filtered)
        previous.Active, following.Active = page > 1, page < pageCount
        previous.TextTransparency = page > 1 and 0 or 0.65
        following.TextTransparency = page < pageCount and 0 or 0.65
        empty.Visible = #filtered == 0
        empty.Text = loading and 'Loading remote catalogue...'
            or (#items == 0 and 'Catalogue unavailable. Press Reload Catalogue.' or 'No matching skins')
        local first = (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1
        for index = first, math.min(first + PAGE_SIZE - 1, #filtered) do
            local item = filtered[index]
            local key = item.key
            local card = Instance.new('TextButton')
            card.Name, card.Text = 'Skin_' .. key, ''
            card.BackgroundColor3, card.BorderSizePixel = pal.control, 0
            card.LayoutOrder, card.Parent = index, grid
            Instance.new('UICorner', card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            if selected[item.slot] == key then
                local border = Instance.new('UIStroke', card)
                border.Color, border.Thickness = pal.blue, 2
            end
            local image = Instance.new('ImageLabel')
            image.Position, image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 2), UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 56)
            image.BackgroundTransparency, image.ScaleType = 1, Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            image.Name = 'SkinThumbnail'
            image.ImageTransparency, image.ImageColor3 = 0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            local candidates = item.images or {item.image}
            image.Image = candidates[1] or ''
            image.Parent = card
            if #candidates > 1 then
                task.spawn(function()
                    for candidateIndex, uri in ipairs(candidates) do
                        if not alive() or image.Parent ~= card or card.Parent ~= grid then return end
                        image.Image = uri
                        local deadline = os.clock() + 5
                        repeat
                            task.wait(0.2)
                            if not alive() or image.Parent ~= card or card.Parent ~= grid then return end
                            if image.IsLoaded then return end
                        until os.clock() >= deadline
                    end
                end)
            end
            local name = Instance.new('TextLabel')
            name.Position, name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 58), UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 28)
            name.BackgroundTransparency, name.TextWrapped = 1, true
            name.TextColor3, name.TextSize, name.Font = pal.text, 10, Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            name:SetAttribute("DaDaKeepText", true)
            name.Text, name.TextTruncate, name.Parent = item.name, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, card
            local detail = Instance.new('TextLabel')
            detail.Position, detail.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 86), UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 16)
            detail.BackgroundTransparency, detail.TextColor3 = 1, pal.muted
            detail.TextSize, detail.Font = 9, Enum.Font.Gotham
            detail.Text = item.slot .. (item.rarity ~= '' and (' · ' .. item.rarity) or '')
            detail.TextTruncate, detail.Parent = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, card
            -- Card connections die with their Instances on the next render.
            card.Activated:Connect(function()
                if not alive() then return end
                local ok, err = pcall(choose, key)
                if not ok then setStatus(tostring(err), pal.danger) end
            end)
        end
    end
    filterItems = function()
        filtered = {}
        local query = search.Text:lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if (filterType == 'All' or item.slot == filterType)
                and (query == '' or item.haystack:find(query, 1, true)) then
                filtered[#filtered + 1] = item
            end
        end
        page = 1
        grid.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
        render()
    end
    connect(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'), filterItems)
    connect(previous.Activated, function() page -= 1; render() end)
    connect(following.Activated, function() page += 1; render() end)
    panel:Button('Add + Equip Selected (local inventory)', function()
        task.spawn(addAndEquipSelected)
    end)
    panel:Button('Restore Original Weapons', function()
        selected.Knife, selected.Gun, lastChoice = nil, nil, nil
        enabledBinding.apply(false)
        clearTemplates()
        updateSelections()
    end)
    panel:Button('Reload Catalogue', function()
        if loadCatalogue then task.spawn(loadCatalogue) end
    end)
    panel:Label('Cosmetics only. No server inventory / ownership changes.')

    loadCatalogue = function()
        if loading or not alive() then return end
        loading = true
        setStatus('Downloading MM2_SkinMeshData.lua...')
        render()
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            assert(type(loadstring) == 'function', 'loadstring is unavailable in this executor')
            local source = game:HttpGet(DATA_URL)
            assert(type(source) == 'string' and #source > 0, 'Empty HTTP response')
            if not alive() then return nil end
            local chunk, compileError = loadstring(source, '@MM2_SkinMeshData.lua')
            assert(chunk, 'Catalogue compile error: ' .. tostring(compileError))
            local data = chunk()
            assert(type(data) == 'table', 'Catalogue must return a table')
            refreshGameWeaponImages()
            local newItems = {}
            for key, entry in pairs(data) do
                if type(key) == 'string' and type(entry) == 'table' and type(entry.Meta) == 'table'
                    and (entry.Model or entry.Display) then
                    local meta = entry.Meta
                    if meta.ItemType == 'Knife' or meta.ItemType == 'Gun' then
                        local name = tostring(meta.ItemName or key)
                        local rarity = tostring(meta.Rarity or '')
                        local previews = skinImageCandidates(meta, key)
                        newItems[#newItems + 1] = {key=key, name=name, rarity=rarity,
                            slot=meta.ItemType, image=previews[1] or '', images=previews,
                            haystack=(key .. ' ' .. name .. ' ' .. rarity .. ' ' .. meta.ItemType):lower()}
                    end
                end
            end
            assert(#newItems > 0, 'Catalogue has no compatible Knife / Gun entries')
            table.sort(newItems, function(a, b)
                if a.name:lower() ~= b.name:lower() then return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end
                return a.key < b.key
            end)
            return {meshes=data, items=newItems}
        end)
        loading = false
        if not alive() then return end
        if ok and result then
            generation += 1
            clearRecords()
            clearTemplates()
            table.clear(retryAfter)
            MESHES, items = result.meshes, result.items
            for _, slot in ipairs({'Knife', 'Gun'}) do
                if selected[slot] then
                    local entry=MESHES[selected[slot]]
                    if not entry or entry.Meta.ItemType~=slot then
                        warn('[DaDa Skinchanger] Saved '..slot..' skin unavailable: '..tostring(selected[slot]))
                        selected[slot]=nil
                    end
                end
            end
            if lastChoice and not MESHES[lastChoice] then lastChoice = nil end
            setStatus(string.format('Loaded %d skins. Click a card to apply; normal Knife / Gun required.', #items), pal.success)
            updateSelections()
        else
            setStatus('Catalogue load failed: ' .. tostring(result) .. '. Press Reload Catalogue.', pal.danger)
            warn('[DaDa Skinchanger] ' .. tostring(result))
            if notify then pcall(notify, 'Skinchanger', 'Catalogue failed to load. Use Reload Catalogue.') end
        end
        filterItems()
    end
    local function destroy()
        if not active then return end
        active, enabled = false, false
        generation += 1
        clearRecords()
        clearTemplates()
        for key, change in pairs(inventoryChanges) do
            -- Never overwrite a later inventory update made by the game.
            if change.owned[key] == change.assigned then change.owned[key] = change.old end
        end
        table.clear(inventoryChanges)
        table.clear(retryAfter)
        table.clear(MESHES)
        table.clear(items)
        table.clear(filtered)
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups, destroy)
    task.spawn(loadCatalogue)
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive() do
            local ok, err = pcall(reconcile)
            if not ok and alive() then
                warn('[DaDa Skinchanger] ' .. tostring(err))
                setStatus('Skinchanger: ' .. tostring(err), pal.danger)
            end
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end)
end

-- Model-only morph; cosmetics follow the visible model, not the hidden avatar.
local function mountDaDaMorph(panel,pal)
    local active=true
    local enabled=false
    local setEnabled
    local selectionVersion=0
    local entries,byId={},{}
    local selected,visual,character,offset
    local hidden={}
    local renderCards,loadEntry
    local page,pageSize=1,9
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function label(parent,text,size)
        local object=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        object.BackgroundTransparency=1
        object.TextColor3=pal.text
        object.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        object.TextSize=size or 11
        object.TextWrapped=true
        object.Text=text
        object.Parent=parent
        return object
    end
    -- These controls intentionally precede the input and gallery.
    panel:Toggle("Morph",false,function(value)
        if setEnabled then setEnabled(value) end
    end,nil,{get=function() return enabled end})
    local inputRow=Instance.new("Frame")
    inputRow.Name="MorphAssetInput"
    inputRow.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
    inputRow.BackgroundTransparency=1
    panel:Mount(inputRow,"Morph Asset ID +")
    local input=Instance.new("TextBox")
    input.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,1,0)
    input.BackgroundColor3=pal.control
    input.TextColor3=pal.text
    input.PlaceholderColor3=pal.muted
    input.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    input.TextSize=12
    input.PlaceholderText="Model Asset ID"
    input.Text=""
    input.ClearTextOnFocus=false
    input.Parent=inputRow
    Instance.new("UICorner",input).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
    local plus=Instance.new("TextButton")
    plus.Position=UDim2.new(1,-34,0,0)
    plus.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,32)
    plus.BackgroundColor3=pal.control
    plus.TextColor3=pal.text
    plus.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    plus.TextSize=22
    plus.Text="+"
    plus.Parent=inputRow
    Instance.new("UICorner",plus).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
    local status=label(nil,"Enter a model Asset ID and press +",11)
    status.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,38)
    panel:Mount(status,"Morph status")
    local function setStatus(text,isError)
        if not active then return end
        status.Text=text
        status.TextColor3=isError and pal.danger or pal.muted
    end
    local grid=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    grid.Name="MorphModels"
    grid.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,330)
    grid.BackgroundTransparency=1
    grid.BorderSizePixel=0
    grid.ScrollBarThickness=0
    grid.ScrollingEnabled=false
    grid.CanvasSize=UDim2.new()
    grid.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    panel:Mount(grid,"Morph model gallery")
    local layout=Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    layout.CellSize=UDim2.new(1/3,-4,0,106)
    layout.FillDirectionMaxCells=3
    layout.CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6)
    layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Parent=grid
    local navigation=Instance.new("Frame")
    navigation.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,28)
    navigation.BackgroundTransparency=1
    panel:Mount(navigation,"Morph pages")
    local function pageButton(text,x)
        local button=Instance.new("TextButton")
        button.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(32,28)
        button.Position=x
        button.Text=text
        button.TextColor3=pal.text
        button.BackgroundColor3=pal.control
        button.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        button.TextSize=14
        button.Parent=navigation
        Instance.new("UICorner",button).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
        return button
    end
    local previous=pageButton("<",UDim2.fromOffset(0,0))
    local following=pageButton(">",UDim2.new(1,-32,0,0))
    local pageLabel=label(navigation,"1 / 1",11)
    pageLabel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(36,0)
    pageLabel.Size=UDim2.new(1,-72,1,0)
    local function preservedAura(object,char)
        local current=object
        while current and current~=char do
            if current:GetAttribute("DaDaPreserveAura2")==true then return true end
            current=current.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function restoreCharacter()
        for object,properties in pairs(hidden) do
            for key,value in pairs(properties) do
                pcall(function() object[key]=value end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(hidden)
        character=nil
    end
    local function publishEffectTarget(target)
        if SHF.morphEffectTarget==target then return end
        SHF.morphEffectTarget=target
        if type(SHF.applyAura2)=="function" then pcall(SHF.applyAura2) end
        if type(SHF.updateChinaHat)=="function" then pcall(SHF.updateChinaHat) end
    end
    local function clearVisual()
        local current=SHF.morphEffectTarget
        if current and current.model==visual then publishEffectTarget(nil) end
        if visual then visual:Destroy();visual=nil end
        offset=nil
        restoreCharacter()
    end
    local function hideProperty(object,key,value)
        local properties=hidden[object]
        if not properties then properties={};hidden[object]=properties end
        pcall(function()
            if properties[key]==nil then properties[key]=object[key] end
            if object[key]~=value then object[key]=value end
        end)
    end
    local bodyNames={Head=true,Torso=true,["Left Arm"]=true,["Right Arm"]=true,
        ["Left Leg"]=true,["Right Leg"]=true,HumanoidRootPart=true,
        UpperTorso=true,LowerTorso=true,LeftUpperArm=true,LeftLowerArm=true,LeftHand=true,
        RightUpperArm=true,RightLowerArm=true,RightHand=true,
        LeftUpperLeg=true,LeftLowerLeg=true,LeftFoot=true,
        RightUpperLeg=true,RightLowerLeg=true,RightFoot=true}
    local function shouldHideForModel(object,char)
        if preservedAura(object,char) or object:IsA("Tool")
            or object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then return false end
        local top=object
        while top and top.Parent~=char do top=top.Parent end
        if not top then return false end
        -- Hide only the avatar, never arbitrary equipped models or Tool effects.
        return top:IsA("Accessory") or top:IsA("Humanoid")
            or (top:IsA("BasePart") and bodyNames[top.Name]==true)
    end
    local function hideCharacter(char)
        for _,object in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if shouldHideForModel(object,char) then
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    hideProperty(object,"LocalTransparencyModifier",1)
                elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
                    hideProperty(object,"Transparency",1)
                elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail")
                    or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Highlight")
                    or object:IsA("Fire") or object:IsA("Smoke") or object:IsA("Sparkles")
                    or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                    hideProperty(object,"Enabled",false)
                elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
                    hideProperty(object,"DisplayDistanceType",Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None)
                end
            end
        end
        for object,properties in pairs(hidden) do
            if not object:IsDescendantOf(char) or not shouldHideForModel(object,char) then
                for key,value in pairs(properties) do pcall(function() object[key]=value end) end
                hidden[object]=nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function safePart(part)
        part.CanCollide=false
        part.CanTouch=false
        part.CanQuery=false
        part.Anchored=true
        part.Massless=true
        part.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
        part.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
    end
    local function sanitize(model)
        local count=0
        for _,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or object:IsA("Animator")
                or object:IsA("Animation") or object:IsA("AnimationController")
                or object:IsA("Sound") then
                object:Destroy()
            elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
                object:Destroy()
            elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                safePart(object)
                count=count+1
            end
        end
        assert(count>0,"This asset has no 3D parts; use a Model/MeshPart asset ID")
    end
    local function enlargeSmallModel(model,root,humanoid)
        local function partHeight(name)
            local part=character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
            return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Size.Y or 0
        end
        local targetHeight
        if humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            targetHeight=partHeight("Head")+partHeight("Torso")
                +math.max(partHeight("Left Leg"),partHeight("Right Leg"))
        else
            targetHeight=partHeight("Head")+partHeight("UpperTorso")+partHeight("LowerTorso")
                +math.max(partHeight("LeftUpperLeg")+partHeight("LeftLowerLeg")+partHeight("LeftFoot"),
                    partHeight("RightUpperLeg")+partHeight("RightLowerLeg")+partHeight("RightFoot"))
        end
        if targetHeight<=0 then
            targetHeight=math.max(5,humanoid.HipHeight*2+root.Size.Y)
        end
        local _,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
        if size.Y>0.000001 and size.Y<targetHeight then
            model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale()*(targetHeight/size.Y))
        end
    end
    local function positionOffset(model,root,humanoid)
        local modelRoot=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
        if modelRoot and modelRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
            return modelRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(model:GetPivot())
        end
        local box,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
        local feet=humanoid.HipHeight+root.Size.Y*.5
        if humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            local leg=character and character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
            if leg then feet=feet+leg.Size.Y end
        end
        return CFrame.new(0,size.Y*.5-feet,0)*box:ToObjectSpace(model:GetPivot())
    end
    local function update()
        if not active or espLifecycle.stopped or not enabled or not selected then return end
        local char=LP.Character
        local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not char.Parent or not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then
            if visual or character then clearVisual() end
            return
        end
        -- Static Model overlay retains the existing model positioning.
        if character~=char or not visual or not visual.Parent then
            clearVisual()
            character=char
            local clone=selected.template:Clone()
            local scaled,scaleError=pcall(enlargeSmallModel,clone,root,hum)
            if not scaled then warn("[DaDa Morph] Could not enlarge model: "..tostring(scaleError)) end
            local ok,result=pcall(positionOffset,clone,root,hum)
            if not ok then clone:Destroy();error(result) end
            visual,offset=clone,result
            visual.Name="DaDaMorph_"..selected.id
            visual:PivotTo(root.CFrame*offset)
            visual.Parent=workspace
            local box,size=visual:GetBoundingBox()
            publishEffectTarget({model=visual,char=char,
                boxOffset=visual:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(box),size=size})
        end
        visual:PivotTo(root.CFrame*offset)
        for _,part in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then safePart(part) end
        end
        hideCharacter(char)
        if type(SHF.updateAura2MorphAnchors)=="function" then SHF.updateAura2MorphAnchors() end
        if type(SHF.updateChinaHat)=="function" then SHF.updateChinaHat() end
    end
    local function select(entry,keepVersion)
        if not active then return end
        if not keepVersion then selectionVersion=selectionVersion+1 end
        if not entry.template then
            loadEntry(entry,true)
            return
        end
        clearVisual()
        selected=entry
        local ok,err=pcall(update)
        if not ok then
            selected=nil;clearVisual()
            setStatus("Morph failed: "..tostring(err),true)
        else
            setStatus("Selected: "..entry.name..(enabled and " (local visual)" or ". Turn Morph ON to apply."))
        end
        renderCards()
    end
    renderCards=function()
        for _,child in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
        end
        local visible={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
            visible[#visible+1]=entry
        end
        local pageCount=math.max(1,math.ceil(#visible/pageSize))
        page=math.max(1,math.min(page,pageCount))
        pageLabel.Text=tostring(page).." / "..tostring(pageCount)
        previous.AutoButtonColor=page>1
        following.AutoButtonColor=page<pageCount
        local first=(page-1)*pageSize+1
        for index=first,math.min(first+pageSize-1,#visible) do
            local entry=visible[index]
            local card=Instance.new("TextButton")
            card.Name="Morph_"..entry.id
            card.LayoutOrder=index
            card.Text=""
            card.BackgroundColor3=pal.control
            card.BorderSizePixel=0
            card.Parent=grid
            Instance.new("UICorner",card).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
            local viewport=Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
            viewport.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,68)
            viewport.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4)
            viewport.BackgroundTransparency=1
            viewport.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(190,190,190)
            viewport.LightColor=Color3.new(1,1,1)
            viewport.Active=false
            viewport.Parent=card
            if entry.template then
            local preview=entry.template:Clone()
            -- A viewport uses static, sanitized clones, never asset scripts.
            preview.Parent=viewport
            local box,size=preview:GetBoundingBox()
            local camera=Instance.new("Camera")
            camera.FieldOfView=40
            local distance=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z,1)*2.5
            camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(box.Position+Vector3.new(distance*.65,distance*.35,distance),box.Position)
            camera.Parent=viewport
            viewport.CurrentCamera=camera
            else
                local placeholder=label(viewport,entry.loading and "Loading..." or "Click to load",9)
                placeholder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
            end
            local name=label(card,(entry==selected and (enabled and "[ON] " or "[SET] ") or "")..entry.name,10)
            name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,73)
            name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,18)
            name.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            local idLabel=label(card,entry.id,8)
            idLabel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,91)
            idLabel.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,14)
            idLabel.TextColor3=pal.muted
            card.Activated:Connect(function() if active then select(entry) end end)
        end
    end
    loadEntry=function(entry,equipWhenReady)
        if not active or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
        if equipWhenReady then entry.equipVersion=selectionVersion end
        if entry.loading then return end
        if entry.template then
            local equipVersion=entry.equipVersion;entry.equipVersion=nil
            if equipVersion==selectionVersion then select(entry,true) end
            return
        end
        entry.loading=true
        setStatus("Loading model "..entry.id.."...")
        renderCards()
        task.spawn(function()
            local template,loaded
            local ok,err=pcall(function()
                    loaded=game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..entry.id)
                    assert(type(loaded)=="table" and #loaded>0,"Asset returned no objects")
                    template=Instance.new("Model")
                    template.Name="Morph_"..entry.id
                    entry.name=loaded[1].Name~="" and loaded[1].Name or ("Model "..entry.id)
                    for _,object in ipairs(loaded) do object.Parent=template end
                    sanitize(template)
                if not active or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
                entry.template=template;template=nil
            end)
            if template then template:Destroy() end
            if not ok and loaded then
                for _,object in ipairs(loaded) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
            end
            entry.loading=false
            local equipVersion=entry.equipVersion;entry.equipVersion=nil
            if not active or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            renderCards()
            if not ok then
                -- Do not retry a failed asset load on every render frame.
                if selected==entry then selected=nil;clearVisual();renderCards() end
                setStatus("Cannot load "..entry.id..": "..tostring(err)..". Click the card to retry.",true)
            elseif entry.template then
                setStatus("Added "..entry.name..". Click its card to use.")
                if equipVersion==selectionVersion then select(entry,true) end
            end
        end)
    end
    setEnabled=function(value)
        if not active then return end
        enabled=value==true
        selectionVersion=selectionVersion+1
        if not enabled then
            clearVisual()
            setStatus("Morph OFF. Original character and cosmetic targets restored.")
        elseif selected then
            local ok,err=pcall(update)
            if not ok then clearVisual();setStatus("Morph failed: "..tostring(err),true) end
        else
            setStatus("Morph ON. Add a model and select its card.")
        end
        renderCards()
    end
    local function addAsset()
        if not active then return end
        local raw=input.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local id,key,entry
            id=raw:match("^(%d+)$") or raw:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
            if not id or #id>20 or not tonumber(id) or tonumber(id)<=0 then
                setStatus("Enter a numeric model Asset ID",true);return
            end
            id=id:gsub("^0+", "");key="Model:"..id
            entry=byId[key] or {id=id,name="Model "..id,kind="Model"}
        if not byId[key] then entries[#entries+1]=entry;byId[key]=entry end
        local index=0
        for _,value in ipairs(entries) do
            index=index+1
            if value==entry then page=math.floor((index-1)/pageSize)+1;break end
        end
        loadEntry(entry,false)
        renderCards()
    end
    connect(previous.Activated,function() page=page-1;renderCards() end)
    connect(following.Activated,function() page=page+1;renderCards() end)
    connect(plus.Activated,addAsset)
    connect(input.FocusLost,function(enter) if enter then addAsset() end end)
    panel:Label("Model-only local morph. Equipped Tools remain visible.")
    panel:Label("China Hat follows the model top. Aura v2 follows the visible model.")
    connect(LP.CharacterRemoving,function(char)
        if char==character then clearVisual() end
    end)
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped,function()
        if not enabled or not selected then return end
        local ok,err=pcall(update)
        if not ok then
            selected=nil;clearVisual();renderCards()
            setStatus("Morph stopped: "..tostring(err),true)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
        active=false;enabled=false;selectionVersion=selectionVersion+1;selected=nil;clearVisual()
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
            if entry.template then entry.template:Destroy() end
        end
        table.clear(entries);table.clear(byId)
    end)
    -- Built-in gallery entry is visible immediately; asset permissions may still
    -- prevent loading, so keep its card and allow click-to-retry on failure.
    local defaultEntry={id="138151705692565",name="Model 138151705692565",kind="Model"}
    entries[#entries+1]=defaultEntry;byId["Model:"..defaultEntry.id]=defaultEntry
    renderCards()
    loadEntry(defaultEntry,false)

end

-- Config decoration: preload content URLs directly; keep stable image layers.
local function mountDaDaAnimeGirl(panel, window)
    local frameImages = {
        "rbxassetid://100188039339300",
        "rbxassetid://72000557281456",
        "rbxassetid://130557381012899",
        "rbxassetid://87426473745070",
        "rbxassetid://83943444943612",
        "rbxassetid://78105248407382",
        "rbxassetid://80458837473966",
        "rbxassetid://100639837901861",
        "rbxassetid://134730906801213",
        "rbxassetid://71712999559241",
        "rbxassetid://134540540842866",
        "rbxassetid://75146096659726",
        "rbxassetid://134760356943954",
        "rbxassetid://138959990784454",
        "rbxassetid://123371574328847",
        "rbxassetid://72616788820986",
        "rbxassetid://118446838186139",
        "rbxassetid://114199650730710",
        "rbxassetid://100242177743892",
        "rbxassetid://133368667384737",
        "rbxassetid://105652842700961",
        "rbxassetid://90937545848773",
        "rbxassetid://115825624695456",
        "rbxassetid://112052341451558",
        "rbxassetid://81926789066757",
        "rbxassetid://95617258323931",
        "rbxassetid://130822023164595",
        "rbxassetid://73608301021499",
        "rbxassetid://95456150461341",
        "rbxassetid://117449345865119",
    }
    local contentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
    local enabled, sizePercent = false, 100
    local disposed, started = false, false
    local states, workers = {}, {}
    local batchStarted, batchWarned = 0, false
    local playback, elapsed, frameIndex, cursor = nil, 0, nil, 1
    local FPS = 30
    local host = Instance.new("Frame")
    host.Name = "DaDaAnimeGirl"
    host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    host.BorderSizePixel = 0
    host.Active = false
    host.Visible = false
    -- Preserve the 100% placement. The image's calibrated attachment point is
    -- 20px left / 29px up from the canvas corner; scale those offsets together
    -- with the canvas so the artwork stays attached to the menu's top-right.
    host.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
    host.Position = UDim2.new(1, 20, 0, 29)
    host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 240)
    host.ZIndex = 20
    host.Parent = window.Main
    local layers = {}
    for index, uri in ipairs(frameImages) do
        local layer = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        layer.Name = "Frame" .. index
        layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
        layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        layer.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        layer.Active = false
        layer.Image = uri
        layer.ImageTransparency = 1
        layer.Visible = true
        layer.ZIndex = 20
        layer.Parent = host
        layers[index] = layer
        states[index] = "pending"
    end
    local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    status.Name = "LoadingStatus"
    status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    status.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
    status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -36)
    status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    status.TextSize = 11
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    status.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    status.TextWrapped = true
    status.Text = "Loading frames: 0 / 30"
    status.ZIndex = 21
    status.Parent = host

    local function alive()
        return not disposed and not espLifecycle.stopped and host.Parent ~= nil
    end
    local function stopPlayback()
        if playback then playback:Disconnect(); playback = nil end
    end
    local function canShow()
        return alive() and enabled and window.Main.Visible and window.Gui.Enabled
    end
    local function available(index)
        -- Preload success is valid even when a hidden label's IsLoaded lags.
        return states[index] == "ready" or layers[index].IsLoaded
    end
    local function counts()
        local loaded, pending = 0, 0
        for index = 1, #layers do
            if available(index) then
                loaded = loaded + 1
            elseif states[index] == "pending" or states[index] == "loading" then
                pending = pending + 1
            end
        end
        return loaded, pending
    end
    local function showFrame(index)
        if not available(index) then return false end
        layers[index].ImageTransparency = 0
        if frameIndex and index ~= frameIndex then layers[frameIndex].ImageTransparency = 1 end
        frameIndex = index
        return true
    end
    local function syncPlayback()
        if not alive() then stopPlayback(); return end
        host.Visible = enabled
        if not canShow() then stopPlayback(); return end
        if playback then return end
        playback = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not canShow() then stopPlayback(); return end
            local loaded, pending = counts()
            if loaded == 0 then
                status.Visible = true
                status.Text = pending > 0 and "Loading frames: 0 / 30"
                    or "Frames unavailable. Retry loading in Config."
                return
            end
            -- Prefer a complete preload, but never let one hung asset block all others.
            if pending > 0 and os.clock() - batchStarted < 8 then
                status.Visible = true
                status.Text = string.format("Loading frames: %d / %d", loaded, #layers)
                return
            end
            status.Visible = false
            if loaded < #layers and not batchWarned then
                batchWarned = true
                warn(string.format("[DaDa Anime girl] %d/30 frames cached; unavailable frames are held/skipped", loaded))
            end
            if not frameIndex then
                for index = 1, #layers do
                    if showFrame(index) then cursor = index; break end
                end
                elapsed = 0
            end
            elapsed = elapsed + dt
            local advance = math.floor(elapsed * FPS)
            if advance > 0 then
                elapsed = elapsed - advance / FPS
                cursor = ((cursor - 1 + advance) % #layers) + 1
                -- Cursor advances even if this frame is missing: no permanent stall.
                -- Never hide the last good layer to show an unavailable one.
                showFrame(cursor)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function preloadFrames(retry)
        if not alive() then return end
        if started and not retry then return end
        started = true
        batchStarted, batchWarned = os.clock(), false
        for index, uri in ipairs(frameImages) do
            local frame, asset = index, uri
