            if not available(frame) and not workers[frame] then
                states[frame] = "loading"
                workers[frame] = true
                -- Separate requests: one slow asset cannot hold up the other 29.
                task.spawn(function()
                    local succeeded, failure = false, nil
                    local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        contentProvider:PreloadAsync({asset}, function(_, fetchStatus)
                            if not alive() then return end
                            if fetchStatus == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                                succeeded = true
                                states[frame] = "ready"
                            else
                                failure = tostring(fetchStatus)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    if not alive() then return end
                    workers[frame] = nil
                    if succeeded or layers[frame].IsLoaded then
                        states[frame] = "ready"
                    else
                        states[frame] = "failed"
                        warn("[DaDa Anime girl] Frame " .. frame .. ": " .. tostring(err or failure or "not loaded"))
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    panel:Toggle("Anime girl", false, function(value)
        enabled = value
        if value then
            elapsed, cursor = 0, 1
            if not frameIndex then showFrame(1) end
            preloadFrames(false)
        end
        syncPlayback()
    end, nil, {get = function() return enabled end})
    local function applyAnimeSize(value)
        sizePercent = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 100, 50, 200)
        local scale = sizePercent / 100
        -- Fractional offsets are intentional: rounding only the size would
        -- move the attachment point at intermediate slider values.
        host.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180 * scale, 240 * scale)
        host.Position = UDim2.new(1, 20 * scale, 0, 29 * scale)
    end
    applyAnimeSize(sizePercent)
    panel:Slider("Anime girl Size", 100, 50, 200, applyAnimeSize,
        {step = 1, get = function() return sizePercent end})
    panel:Button("Retry Anime girl Frames", function() preloadFrames(true) end)
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections, window.Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(syncPlayback))
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections, window.Gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(syncPlayback))
    getgenv().DaDa_NL_AttachAnime=function(main,newGui)
        window={Main=main,Gui=newGui}
        host.Parent=main
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(syncPlayback))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,newGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(syncPlayback))
        syncPlayback()
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups, function()
        getgenv().DaDa_NL_AttachAnime=nil
        disposed, enabled = true, false
        stopPlayback()
        host:Destroy()
    end)
    -- Begin caching immediately when the menu is built, before the toggle is used.
    preloadFrames()
end


-- Additional Combat features from ve.lol.txt; original menu code is retained.
SHF.mountCombatSpoof = function(makePanel)
    local hostNotify = notify
    local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
    local previous = env.VelocityFakeMobile
    if type(previous) == "table" and type(previous.Unload) == "function" then
        previous.Unload()
    end
    -- Avoid two velocity engines if the earlier standalone file is still running.
    if type(env.VelocitySpoof) == "table" and type(env.VelocitySpoof.Unload) == "function" then
        env.VelocitySpoof.Unload()
    end

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    assert(player, "Velocity + Fake Position requires a Roblox client")
    local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local cameraBinding = "DaDaCombatSpoof_Restore"
    local ZERO = Vector3.zero
    local clock, random = os.clock, math.random
    local state = {
        Velocity = false, Fake = false, Preset = "low", Marker = true,
        Bhop = false, Power = 40, Strafe = false, AutoStrafe = false,
        AntiAim = false, AntiMode = "spin", SpinSpeed = 360, JitterAngle = 90,
        Axes = {X = true, Y = true, Z = true},
        Range = {X = 9, Y = 9, Z = 9}, -- multipliers of 1e9, as in the source UI
        Stomping = false, Purchasing = false, LastError = nil,
    }
    local presets = {"low", "high", "y high", "limit", "zero"}
    local connections, hooks = {}, {}
    local transparency = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local root, humanoid, character
    local snapshot, realCFrame, fakePosition, pendingTeleport
    local generation, characterGeneration = 0, 0
    local busy, unloaded = false, false
    local lastTime, fps = clock(), 200
    local oldRate, oldHeight, heightChanged
    local statusText = "Готово · обе функции выключены"
    local uiRefresh = function() end
    local api = {}
    local wasJumping, isBoosting, bhopSpeed = false, false, 0
    local lastCameraYaw, jumpHeldAt = nil, -math.huge
    local jumpHeld, jumpTouch = false, nil
    local spinYaw, jitterBase, jitterElapsed, jitterSide = nil, nil, 0, 1
    local autoRotateSaved = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local touchJumpButton

    local function connect(signal, fn)
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        connections[#connections + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local function notify(text)
        statusText = text
        uiRefresh()
        if hostNotify then pcall(hostNotify, "Combat", text) end
    end
    local function attempt(fn)
        local ok, value = pcall(fn)
        return ok, value
    end
    attempt(function() oldRate = getfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate") end)
    local function restoreRate()
        -- Unlike the source, do not invent an old value if reading it failed.
        if oldRate ~= nil then
            attempt(function() setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", tostring(oldRate)) end)
        end
    end
    local function updateRate()
        if oldRate == nil then return end
        attempt(function()
            setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", tostring(math.floor(fps * 10 + 0.5) / 10))
        end)
    end
    local function restoreSnapshot()
        local saved = snapshot
        snapshot = nil
        if not saved then return end
        attempt(function() saved.Root.CFrame = saved.CFrame end)
        attempt(function() saved.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = saved.Linear end)
        attempt(function() saved.Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = saved.Angular end)
    end
    local function invalidate()
        generation = generation + 1
        restoreSnapshot()
    end
    local function restoreTransparency()
        for part, value in pairs(transparency) do
            attempt(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = value end)
            transparency[part] = nil
        end
    end
    local function updateTransparency()
        if not state.Fake or not character then return end
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                if transparency[part] == nil then
                    transparency[part] = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
                end
                part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0.6
            end
        end
    end
    local function setWorldLimits(value)
        if value then
            if heightChanged then return true end
            -- Ordinary API first; hidden-property fallback for executor environments.
            local ok, valueBefore = attempt(function() return workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight end)
            if not ok then
                ok, valueBefore = attempt(function()
                    return gethiddenproperty(workspace, "FallenPartsDestroyHeight")
                end)
            end
            if not ok or type(valueBefore) ~= "number" then return false end
            oldHeight = valueBefore
            local success = attempt(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -9e9 end)
            if not success then
                success = attempt(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(workspace, "FallenPartsDestroyHeight", -9e9)
                end)
            end
            heightChanged = success
            return success
        end
        if heightChanged then
            local success = attempt(function() workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = oldHeight end)
            if not success then
                success = attempt(function()
                    sethiddenproperty(workspace, "FallenPartsDestroyHeight", oldHeight)
                end)
            end
            if success then heightChanged = false end
            return success
        end
        return true
    end

    -- Scoped version of the source's HRP hook. No changes to Humanoid.Health,
    -- no hooks on every body part, and no interception for unrelated instances.
    local function restoreHooks()
        for i = #hooks, 1, -1 do
            local entry = hooks[i]
            attempt(function()
                if getrawmetatable(entry.Root) == entry.Installed then
                    setrawmetatable(entry.Root, entry.Original)
                end
            end)
            hooks[i] = nil
        end
    end
    local function installRootHook(target)
        if type(getrawmetatable) ~= "function" or type(setrawmetatable) ~= "function"
            or type(newcclosure) ~= "function" or type(checkcaller) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Нет API метатаблиц для Fake Position"
        end
        local ok, err = attempt(function()
            local old = getrawmetatable(target)
            assert(type(old) == "table", "Root metatable is unavailable")
            assert(type(old.__index) == "function" and type(old.__newindex) == "function",
                "Unsupported root metatable")
            local replacement = {}
            for k, v in pairs(old) do replacement[k] = v end
            replacement.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
                if self == target and not checkcaller() and state.Fake and realCFrame
                    and key == "CFrame" then
                    return realCFrame
                end
                return old.__index(self, key)
            end)
            replacement.__newindex = newcclosure(function(self, key, value)
                if self == target and not checkcaller() and state.Fake then
                    if key == "CFrame" or key == "Position" or key == "Anchored" then return end
                end
                return old.__newindex(self, key, value)
            end)
            setrawmetatable(target, replacement)
            hooks[#hooks + 1] = {Root = target, Original = old, Installed = replacement}
        end)
        return ok, err
    end

    local function getVelocity(preset)
        -- Exact expressions from the source, including the asymmetry in high.Y.
        return preset == "y high" and Vector3.new(0, 16384, 0)
            or preset == "limit" and Vector3.new(
                random(-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807),
                random(-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807),
                random(-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807)
            )
            or preset == "low" and Vector3.new(
                random(1,2) == 1 and -300 or 300,
                random(1,2) == 1 and -300 or 300,
                random(1,2) == 1 and -300 or 300
            )
            or preset == "high" and Vector3.new(
                random(1,2) == 1 and -16384 or 16384,
                random(1,2) == 1 and -14384 or 16384,
                random(1,2) == 1 and -16384 or 16384
            )
            or ZERO
    end
    local function getFakeCFrame(base)
        local axes, range = state.Axes, state.Range
        local p = base.Position
        local x = axes.X and ((random() * 2 - 1) * range.X * 1e9) or p.X
        local y = axes.Y and (-random() * range.Y * 1e9) or p.Y
        local z = axes.Z and ((random() * 2 - 1) * range.Z * 1e9) or p.Z
        return CFrame.new(Vector3.new(x, y, z)) * CFrame.Angles(
            math.rad(random(1,359)), math.rad(random(1,359)), math.rad(random(1,359)))
    end

    function api.SetVelocity(value)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "SetVelocity expects a boolean")
        if unloaded then return false end
        invalidate()
        state.Velocity = value
        if not value then env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = 0 end
        if not state.Velocity and not state.Fake then restoreRate() end
        notify(value and "Velocity Spoof включён" or "Velocity Spoof выключен")
        return true
    end
    function api.SetFake(value)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "SetFake expects a boolean")
        if unloaded then return false end
        if value == state.Fake then return true end
        invalidate()
        pendingTeleport, fakePosition = nil, nil
        if value then
            if not root or not root.Parent then notify("Персонаж ещё не готов"); return false end
            local ok, err = installRootHook(root)
            if not ok then
                state.LastError = tostring(err)
                notify("Fake недоступен: " .. tostring(err))
                return false
            end
            if not setWorldLimits(true) then
                restoreHooks()
                notify("Fake недоступен: не удалось изменить границу мира")
                return false
            end
            realCFrame = root.CFrame
            state.Fake = true
            updateTransparency()
        else
            state.Fake = false
            restoreHooks()
            restoreTransparency()
            if not setWorldLimits(false) then
                notify("Fake OFF · не удалось вернуть границу мира")
                env.FAKE_POS_ACTIVE = false
                return false
            end
        end
        env.FAKE_POS_ACTIVE = state.Fake
        if not state.Velocity and not state.Fake then restoreRate() end
        notify(value and "Fake Position включён" or "Fake Position выключен")
        return true
    end
    function api.SetPreset(value)
        for _, name in ipairs(presets) do
            if name == value then state.Preset = value; uiRefresh(); return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function api.SetAxis(axis, value)
        if state.Axes[axis] == nil or type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        invalidate()
        state.Axes[axis] = value
        uiRefresh()
        return true
    end
    function api.SetRange(axis, value)
        if state.Range[axis] == nil or type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return false end
        state.Range[axis] = math.clamp(math.floor(value + 0.5), 1, 9)
        uiRefresh()
        return true
    end
    function api.SetMarker(value)
        state.Marker = value == true
        uiRefresh()
    end
    function api.Teleport(value)
        if typeof(value) == "Vector3" then value = CFrame.new(value) end
        if typeof(value) ~= "CFrame" or not root or not root.Parent or unloaded then return false end
        invalidate()
        if state.Fake then
            pendingTeleport = CFrame.new(value.Position)
        else
            root.CFrame = value
            realCFrame = value
        end
        return true
    end
    function api.SetBusy(stomping, purchasing)
        state.Stomping, state.Purchasing = stomping == true, purchasing == true
    end
    local function resetBhop()
        wasJumping, isBoosting, bhopSpeed, lastCameraYaw = false, false, 0, nil
    end
    local function restoreAutoRotate()
        for hum, saved in pairs(autoRotateSaved) do
            attempt(function() hum.AutoRotate = saved end)
            autoRotateSaved[hum] = nil
        end
        spinYaw, jitterBase, jitterElapsed, jitterSide = nil, nil, 0, 1
    end
    local function resetJumpHold()
        jumpHeld, jumpTouch = false, nil
        if touchJumpButton then touchJumpButton.Text = "ПРЫЖОК · держи" end
    end
    function api.SetBhop(value)
        if unloaded or type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        invalidate()
        state.Bhop = value
        resetBhop()
        if not value then resetJumpHold() end
        notify(value and "Bhop ON · удерживай кнопку ПРЫЖОК" or "Bhop выключен")
        return true
    end
    function api.SetPower(value)
        if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return false end
        state.Power = math.clamp(math.floor(value + 0.5),10,150)
        resetBhop()
        uiRefresh()
        return true
    end
    function api.SetStrafe(value)
        if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        state.Strafe = value; resetBhop(); uiRefresh(); return true
    end
    function api.SetAutoStrafe(value)
        if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        state.AutoStrafe = value; resetBhop(); uiRefresh(); return true
    end
    function api.SetAntiAim(value)
        if unloaded or type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        invalidate()
        restoreAutoRotate()
        state.AntiAim = value
        notify(value and "Anti-Aim ON · реальный поворот тела" or "Anti-Aim выключен")
        return true
    end
    function api.SetAntiMode(value)
        if value ~= "spin" and value ~= "jitter" then return false end
        invalidate()
        restoreAutoRotate()
        state.AntiMode = value; uiRefresh(); return true
    end
    function api.SetSpinSpeed(value)
        if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return false end
        state.SpinSpeed = math.clamp(math.floor(value+0.5),90,1080)
        uiRefresh(); return true
    end
    function api.SetJitterAngle(value)
        if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then return false end
        state.JitterAngle = math.clamp(math.floor(value+0.5),15,180)
        uiRefresh(); return true
    end
    function api.StopAll()
        if unloaded then return end
        api.SetBhop(false)
        api.SetAntiAim(false)
        api.SetFake(false)
        api.SetVelocity(false)
        resetJumpHold()
        notify("Все функции выключены")
    end
    function api.GetState()
        return {Velocity = state.Velocity, Fake = state.Fake, Preset = state.Preset,
            Marker = state.Marker, Axes = {X=state.Axes.X,Y=state.Axes.Y,Z=state.Axes.Z},
            Range = {X=state.Range.X,Y=state.Range.Y,Z=state.Range.Z},
            Bhop=state.Bhop, Power=state.Power, Strafe=state.Strafe, AutoStrafe=state.AutoStrafe,
            AntiAim=state.AntiAim, AntiMode=state.AntiMode, SpinSpeed=state.SpinSpeed,
            JitterAngle=state.JitterAngle, LastError=state.LastError, Unloaded=unloaded}
    end
    local function planar(v) return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z) end
    local function cameraYaw()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        local v = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        if math.abs(v.X)+math.abs(v.Z) < 0.00001 then return nil end
        return math.atan2(-v.X,-v.Z)
    end
    local function jumpIsHeld()
        return jumpHeld or clock()-jumpHeldAt < 0.2 or Input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
    end
    connect(Input.JumpRequest, function() jumpHeldAt = clock() end)
    connect(Input.WindowFocusReleased, function()
        resetJumpHold()
        jumpHeldAt = -math.huge
    end)
    local function stepBhop()
        if not state.Bhop then return end
        local hum, hrp = humanoid, root
        if hum.Sit then resetBhop(); return end
        local current = hum:GetState()
        local jumping = current == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
        local airborne = jumping or current == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
        -- Hold-to-hop works in BOTH normal and strafe modes, including touch.
        if not airborne and jumpIsHeld() and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            hum.Jump = true
        end
        local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local md = planar(hum.MoveDirection)
        if state.Strafe or state.AutoStrafe then
            bhopSpeed = 0
            if jumping and not wasJumping then
                local dir = md.Magnitude > 0.1 and md or planar(hrp.CFrame.LookVector)
                if dir.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                    dir = dir.Unit
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X*state.Power,v.Y,dir.Z*state.Power)
                    isBoosting = true
                end
            end
            if isBoosting and airborne then
                if state.AutoStrafe then
                    local yaw = cameraYaw()
                    if yaw and lastCameraYaw then
                        local delta = (yaw-lastCameraYaw+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi
                        v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        local xz = planar(v)
                        if math.abs(delta)>0.0005 and xz.Magnitude>1 then
                            local c,s = math.cos(delta),math.sin(delta)
                            -- Equivalent to CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0,delta,0)*xz.
                            local rotated = Vector3.new(xz.X*c+xz.Z*s,0,-xz.X*s+xz.Z*c)
                            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(rotated.X,v.Y,rotated.Z)
                        end
                    end
                end
                v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local xz = planar(v)
                if md.Magnitude>0.1 then
                    local target = md.Unit*state.Power
                    local steered = xz:Lerp(target,0.3)
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(steered.X,v.Y,steered.Z)
                elseif state.AutoStrafe and xz.Magnitude>0.1 and xz.Magnitude<state.Power then
                    local keep = xz.Unit*state.Power
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(keep.X,v.Y,keep.Z)
                end
            end
            if not airborne then isBoosting = false end
        else
            local base = math.max(hum.WalkSpeed,1)
            local cap = math.max(state.Power,base)
            local increment = math.max(state.Power*0.1,1)
            bhopSpeed = math.max(bhopSpeed,base)
            if jumping and not wasJumping then
                bhopSpeed = math.min(bhopSpeed+increment,cap)
                local xz = planar(v)
                local dir = xz.Magnitude>0.1 and xz.Unit
                    or (md.Magnitude>0.1 and md.Unit or planar(hrp.CFrame.LookVector))
                if dir.Magnitude>0.001 then
                    dir = dir.Unit
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X*bhopSpeed,v.Y,dir.Z*bhopSpeed)
                    isBoosting = true
                end
            end
            if airborne and isBoosting then
                v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local xz = planar(v)
                local dir = md.Magnitude>0.1 and md.Unit or (xz.Magnitude>0.1 and xz.Unit or nil)
                if dir then
                    local speed = math.max(xz.Magnitude,bhopSpeed)
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X*speed,v.Y,dir.Z*speed)
                end
            end
            if not airborne then
                isBoosting = false
                if not jumpIsHeld() then bhopSpeed = 0 end
            end
        end
        lastCameraYaw, wasJumping = cameraYaw(), jumping
    end
    local function stepAntiAim(dt)
        if not state.AntiAim then return end
        if humanoid.Sit then restoreAutoRotate(); return end
        if autoRotateSaved[humanoid] == nil then autoRotateSaved[humanoid] = humanoid.AutoRotate end
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        if spinYaw == nil then
            local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
            spinYaw = math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z)
            jitterBase, jitterElapsed, jitterSide = spinYaw,0,1
        end
        local yaw
        if state.AntiMode == "spin" then
            spinYaw = (spinYaw + math.rad(state.SpinSpeed)*math.min(math.max(dt,0),0.1))%(2*math.pi)
            yaw = spinYaw
        else
            jitterElapsed = jitterElapsed + math.min(math.max(dt,0),0.1)
            while jitterElapsed>=0.12 do
                jitterElapsed = jitterElapsed-0.12
                jitterSide = -jitterSide
            end
            yaw = jitterBase + math.rad(state.JitterAngle*0.5)*jitterSide
        end
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position)*CFrame.Angles(0,yaw,0)
    end

    -- Keep the avatar at the actual fake location. Large fake coordinates are
    -- outside the renderable world, so also show a viewport/edge indicator.
    local markerModel, markerCharacter, markerOffset
    local markerGui, markerPointer, markerCaption, markerAnchor
    local markerRetryAt = 0
    local function hideMarker()
        if markerModel then markerModel.Parent = nil end
        if markerGui then markerGui.Enabled = false end
    end
    local function ensureMarkerGui()
        if markerGui and markerGui.Parent then return end
        if markerGui then markerGui:Destroy() end
        markerGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        markerGui.Name = "DaDa_FakePosition_Marker"
        markerGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        markerGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        markerGui.DisplayOrder = 1100
        markerGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        markerGui.Enabled = false
        markerAnchor = Instance.new("Frame")
        markerAnchor.Name = "Location"
        markerAnchor.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        markerAnchor.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        markerAnchor.Parent = markerGui
        markerPointer = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        markerPointer.Name = "Direction"
        markerPointer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        markerPointer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -9)
        markerPointer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
        markerPointer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        markerPointer.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        markerPointer.TextSize = 22
        markerPointer.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 130)
        markerPointer.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
        markerPointer.Parent = markerAnchor
        markerCaption = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        markerCaption.Name = "Distance"
        markerCaption.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        markerCaption.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 13)
        markerCaption.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(176, 18)
        markerCaption.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        markerCaption.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        markerCaption.TextSize = 11
        markerCaption.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        markerCaption.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
        markerCaption.Parent = markerAnchor
        markerGui.Parent = playerGui
    end
    local function finite(value)
        return value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end
    local function markerDistanceText(distance)
        if distance >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.2fB", distance / 1e9) end
        if distance >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.2fM", distance / 1e6) end
        if distance >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", distance / 1e3) end
        return string.format("%.0f", distance)
    end
    local function updateMarkerGui(camera)
        ensureMarkerGui()
        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
        if viewport.X < 2 or viewport.Y < 2 then markerGui.Enabled = false; return end
        local delta = fakePosition - camera.CFrame.Position
        local magnitude = delta.Magnitude
        if not finite(magnitude) then markerGui.Enabled = false; return end
        local direction = magnitude > 0.001 and delta.Unit or camera.CFrame.LookVector
        -- Project a nearby point on the same ray, avoiding precision loss at 1e9.
        local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(camera.CFrame.Position + direction * 1000)
        local marginX = math.min(94, viewport.X * 0.25)
        local marginY = math.min(40, viewport.Y * 0.25)
        local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
        local half = Vector2.new(math.max(1, center.X - marginX), math.max(1, center.Y - marginY))
        local x, y = screen.X, screen.Y
        local visible = onScreen and screen.Z > 0 and finite(x) and finite(y)
            and x >= marginX and x <= viewport.X - marginX
            and y >= marginY and y <= viewport.Y - marginY
        if visible then
            markerPointer.Text = "◇"
            markerPointer.Rotation = 0
        else
            local localDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
            local edge = Vector2.new(localDirection.X, -localDirection.Y)
            if edge.Magnitude < 0.00001 then edge = Vector2.new(0, 1) end
            local extent = math.max(math.abs(edge.X) / half.X, math.abs(edge.Y) / half.Y)
            local location = center + edge / extent
            x, y = location.X, location.Y
            markerPointer.Text = "▲"
            markerPointer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(edge.Y, edge.X)) + 90
        end
        markerAnchor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        local origin = realCFrame and realCFrame.Position or camera.CFrame.Position
        markerCaption.Text = "FAKE POSITION · " .. markerDistanceText((fakePosition - origin).Magnitude) .. " studs"
        markerGui.Enabled = true
    end
    local function destroyMarker()
        if markerModel then markerModel:Destroy() end
        markerModel, markerCharacter, markerOffset = nil, nil, nil
    end
    local function buildMarker()
        if not character or not root or not character.Parent then return false end
        local wasArchivable = character.Archivable
        local ok, clone = pcall(function()
            character.Archivable = true
            return character:Clone()
        end)
        character.Archivable = wasArchivable
        if not ok or not clone then return false end
        local configured, err = pcall(function()
            clone.Name = "DaDa_FakePosition_Avatar"
            for _, obj in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or obj:IsA("Tool") or obj:IsA("Sound")
                    or obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail")
                    or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                    obj:Destroy()
                elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    obj.Anchored = true
                    obj.CanCollide = false
                    obj.CanTouch = false
                    obj.CanQuery = false
                    obj.CastShadow = false
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    obj.Transparency = obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and 1
                        or math.max(obj.Transparency, 0.45)
                elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                    obj.Transparency = math.max(obj.Transparency, 0.45)
                elseif obj:IsA("Humanoid") then
                    obj.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                    obj.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                    obj.AutoRotate = false
                    obj.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
                end
            end
            local cloneRoot = clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            assert(cloneRoot, "Marker root unavailable")
            markerOffset = cloneRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(clone:GetPivot())
            clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, -100000, 0))
            markerModel, markerCharacter = clone, character
        end)
        if not configured then
            clone:Destroy()
            warn("[DaDa Fake marker] " .. tostring(err))
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function updateMarker()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not state.Fake or not state.Marker or not fakePosition or not character
            or not character.Parent or not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid
            or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not camera
            or not finite(fakePosition.X) or not finite(fakePosition.Y) or not finite(fakePosition.Z) then
            hideMarker()
            return
        end
        if markerCharacter ~= character then destroyMarker() end
        -- The overlay works independently of avatar cloning / streaming.
        updateMarkerGui(camera)
        if (fakePosition - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 20000 then
            if markerModel then markerModel.Parent = nil end
            return
        end
        if not markerModel then
            if clock() < markerRetryAt then return end
            markerRetryAt = clock() + 2
            if not buildMarker() then return end
        end
        local orientation = realCFrame and realCFrame.Rotation or CFrame.new()
        markerModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(fakePosition) * orientation * markerOffset)
        markerModel.Parent = workspace
    end

    local function bindCharacter(value)
        characterGeneration = characterGeneration + 1
        local thisCharacter = characterGeneration
        invalidate()
        restoreHooks()
        restoreTransparency()
        restoreAutoRotate()
        resetBhop()
        resetJumpHold()
        hideMarker()
        destroyMarker()
        markerRetryAt = 0
        root, humanoid, character = nil, nil, value
        realCFrame, fakePosition, pendingTeleport = nil, nil, nil
        if not value then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local nextRoot = value:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)
            local nextHumanoid = value:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
            if unloaded or characterGeneration ~= thisCharacter or player.Character ~= value then return end
            root, humanoid = nextRoot, nextHumanoid
            if not root then notify("HumanoidRootPart не найден"); return end
            realCFrame = root.CFrame
            if state.Fake then
                local ok, err = installRootHook(root)
                if not ok then
                    state.LastError = tostring(err)
                    api.SetFake(false)
                    notify("Fake отключён после респавна: " .. tostring(err))
                    return
                end
                updateTransparency()
            end
        end)
    end
    connect(player.CharacterAdded, bindCharacter)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(value)
        if value == character then bindCharacter(nil) end
    end)
    bindCharacter(player.Character)

    connect(Run.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        local now = clock()
        if now > lastTime then fps = 1 / (now - lastTime) end
        lastTime = now
        if unloaded or busy then return end
        if not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            resetBhop()
            restoreAutoRotate()
            return
        end
        -- Update real movement before snapshotting; otherwise spoof rollback would erase Bhop.
        local movementOK, movementError = pcall(function()
            stepBhop()
            stepAntiAim(dt)
        end)
        if not movementOK then
            state.LastError = tostring(movementError)
            api.StopAll()
            notify("Ошибка движения: " .. tostring(movementError))
            return
        end
        if not (state.Fake or state.Velocity) then return end
        local doFake = state.Fake and not humanoid.Sit and dt <= 0.45
        local doVelocity = state.Velocity and not state.Stomping and not state.Purchasing
            and (env.FLING_ACTIVE or 0) == 0
        if not doFake and not doVelocity then return end
        busy = true
        local token = generation
        local thisRoot = root
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                updateRate()
                attempt(function() sethiddenproperty(thisRoot, "NetworkIsSleeping", false) end)
                if pendingTeleport then
                    thisRoot.CFrame = pendingTeleport
                    thisRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = ZERO
                    thisRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = ZERO
                    pendingTeleport = nil
                end
                realCFrame = thisRoot.CFrame
                local saved = {Root=thisRoot, CFrame=realCFrame,
                    Linear=thisRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity, Angular=thisRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity}
                snapshot = saved
                -- Evaluate before applying any spoof, so a bad preset rolls back cleanly.
                local velocity = doVelocity and getVelocity(state.Preset) or nil
                local fake = doFake and getFakeCFrame(realCFrame) or nil
                if fake then
                    if thisRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 1 then
                        thisRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0.1,0)
                    end
                    fakePosition = fake.Position
                    thisRoot.CFrame = fake
                end
                if velocity then
                    env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = clock() + 0.35
                    thisRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
                end
                Run.RenderStepped:Wait()
                if not unloaded and generation == token and snapshot == saved then
                    restoreSnapshot()
                    if doVelocity then env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = clock() + 0.05 end
                end
            end)
            busy = false
            if not ok and not unloaded and generation == token then
                state.LastError = tostring(err)
                restoreSnapshot()
                api.SetFake(false)
                api.SetVelocity(false)
                notify("Ошибка: " .. tostring(err))
                warn("[Velocity/Fake] " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end)
    end)
    -- Restore position before the camera, as in the source's camera repair step.
    Run:BindToRenderStep(cameraBinding, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
        if unloaded then return end
        local saved = snapshot
        if state.Fake and saved then
            attempt(function() saved.Root.CFrame = saved.CFrame end)
        end
    end)
    connect(Run.RenderStepped, function()
        if unloaded then return end
        if state.Fake then updateTransparency() end
        local ok, err = pcall(updateMarker)
        if not ok then
            hideMarker()
            if clock() >= markerRetryAt then
                markerRetryAt = clock() + 2
                warn("[DaDa Fake marker] " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end
    end)

    function api.Unload()
        if unloaded then return end
        state.Fake, state.Velocity, state.Bhop, state.AntiAim = false,false,false,false
        resetJumpHold()
        resetBhop()
        restoreAutoRotate()
        unloaded = true
        characterGeneration = characterGeneration + 1
        invalidate()
        restoreHooks()
        restoreTransparency()
        local restored = setWorldLimits(false)
        restoreRate()
        Run:UnbindFromRenderStep(cameraBinding)
        for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
        destroyMarker()
        if markerGui then markerGui:Destroy() end
        markerGui, markerPointer, markerCaption, markerAnchor = nil, nil, nil, nil
        env.FAKE_POS_ACTIVE = false
        env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = 0
        if env.VelocityFakeMobile == api then env.VelocityFakeMobile = nil end
        if not restored then warn("[Velocity/Fake] Failed to restore FallenPartsDestroyHeight") end
    end

    env.FAKE_POS_ACTIVE = false
    env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = 0
    env.VelocityFakeMobile = api
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups, api.Unload)

    local fakePanel = makePanel(1, "left", "Fake Position")
    fakePanel:Toggle("Fake Position", false, function(v) api.SetFake(v) end, nil,
        {get=function() return state.Fake end})
    fakePanel:Toggle("Character Marker", true, function(v) api.SetMarker(v) end, nil,
        {get=function() return state.Marker end})
    for _, axisName in ipairs({"X", "Y", "Z"}) do
        local axis = axisName
        fakePanel:Toggle("Axis " .. axis, true, function(v) api.SetAxis(axis, v) end, nil,
            {get=function() return state.Axes[axis] end})
        fakePanel:Slider("Range " .. axis .. " x 1e9", 9, 1, 9,
            function(v) api.SetRange(axis, v) end,
            {step=1, get=function() return state.Range[axis] end})
    end

    local antiPanel = makePanel(1, "left", "Anti Aim", "right")
    antiPanel:Toggle("Anti Aim", false, function(v) api.SetAntiAim(v) end, nil,
        {get=function() return state.AntiAim end})
    antiPanel:Dropdown("Mode", {"spin", "jitter"}, "spin",
        function(v) api.SetAntiMode(v) end, {get=function() return state.AntiMode end})
    antiPanel:Slider("Spin Speed", 360, 90, 1080, function(v) api.SetSpinSpeed(v) end,
        {step=1, get=function() return state.SpinSpeed end})
    antiPanel:Slider("Jitter Angle", 90, 15, 180, function(v) api.SetJitterAngle(v) end,
        {step=1, get=function() return state.JitterAngle end})

    local velocityPanel = makePanel(1, "right", "Velocity Spoof", "right")
    velocityPanel:Toggle("Velocity Spoof", false, function(v) api.SetVelocity(v) end, nil,
        {get=function() return state.Velocity end})
    velocityPanel:Dropdown("Preset", presets, "low", function(v) api.SetPreset(v) end,
        {get=function() return state.Preset end})
    velocityPanel:Button("Stop Fake / Anti Aim / Velocity", api.StopAll)
    velocityPanel:Button("Diagnostics", function()
        local text = string.format("Fake: %s | Anti Aim: %s | Velocity: %s | %s",
            tostring(state.Fake), tostring(state.AntiAim), tostring(state.Velocity),
            state.LastError or statusText)
        if hostNotify then pcall(hostNotify, "Combat", text) end
        print("[DaDa Combat] " .. text)
    end)
    return api
end
