    local function lower(value)
        local out = {}
        for _, code in utf8.codes(tostring(value or "")) do
            if code >= 1040 and code <= 1071 then code = code + 32 end
            if code == 1025 then code = 1105 end
            out[#out + 1] = utf8.char(code)
        end
        return table.concat(out):lower()
    end
    for line in pairsText:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        local source, translated = line:match("^(.-)\t(.*)$")
        if source and source ~= "" then
            dictionary[source] = translated
            foldedDictionary[lower(source)] = translated
        end
    end
    local prefixes = {
        {"Saved: ", "Сохранено: "}, {"Loaded: ", "Загружено: "},
        {"Save failed: ", "Ошибка сохранения: "}, {"Load failed: ", "Ошибка загрузки: "},
        {"Deleted: ", "Удалено: "}, {"Delete failed: ", "Ошибка удаления: "},
        {"Press again to delete: ", "Нажмите ещё раз для удаления: "},
        {"Changed to ", "Изменено на "}, {"Loading frames: ", "Загрузка кадров: "},
        {"Priority: ", "Приоритет: "}, {"FAKE POSITION · ", "ФЕЙКОВАЯ ПОЗИЦИЯ · "},
    }
    local function translate(value)
        value = tostring(value or "")
        if language ~= "Русский" then return value end
        if dictionary[value] then return dictionary[value] end
        local axis = value:match("^Axis ([XYZ])$")
        if axis then return "Ось " .. axis end
        axis = value:match("^Range ([XYZ]) x 1e9$")
        if axis then return "Диапазон " .. axis .. " × 1e9" end
        for _, pair in ipairs(prefixes) do
            if value:sub(1, #pair[1]) == pair[1] then
                return pair[2] .. value:sub(#pair[1] + 1)
            end
        end
        return value
    end
    local records, rootConnections = {}, {}
    local stopped = false
    local api = {}
    local function keepText(object)
        if object:GetAttribute("DaDaKeepText") then return true end
        local parent = object.Parent
        while parent and parent ~= window.Gui do
            if parent.Name:match("^Asset_%d+$") then return true end
            parent = parent.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function paint(object, record, property)
        if stopped or record.writing[property] or not object.Parent then return end
        local source = record.source[property]
        if source == nil then return end
        local rendered = keepText(object) and source or translate(source)
        record.rendered[property] = rendered
        if object[property] ~= rendered then
            record.writing[property] = true
            object[property] = rendered
            record.writing[property] = nil
        end
    end
    local function release(object)
        local record = records[object]
        if not record then return end
        records[object] = nil
        for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    local function register(object)
        if stopped or records[object] then return end
        local properties
        if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") then
            properties = {"Text"}
        elseif object:IsA("TextBox") then
            -- Never translate typed config names, player names, IDs or searches.
            properties = {"PlaceholderText"}
        else
            return
        end
        local record = {source = {}, rendered = {}, writing = {}, connections = {}}
        records[object] = record
        for _, name in ipairs(properties) do
            local property = name
            record.source[property] = object[property]
            record.connections[#record.connections + 1] = object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function()
                if stopped or record.writing[property] then return end
                local value = object[property]
                -- Also handles deferred signals from our own rendered write.
                if value == record.rendered[property] then return end
                record.source[property] = value
                paint(object, record, property)
            end)
            paint(object, record, property)
        end
        record.connections[#record.connections + 1] = object.Destroying:Connect(function() release(object) end)
    end
    function api:GetLanguage() return language end
    function api:Text(value) return translate(value) end
    function api:Matches(query, ...)
        query = lower(query)
        if query == "" then return true end
        for _, value in ipairs({...}) do
            local source = lower(value)
            local translated = lower(foldedDictionary[source] or translate(value))
            if source:find(query, 1, true) or translated:find(query, 1, true) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function api:SetLanguage(value)
        if stopped then return false end
        if value ~= "English" and value ~= "Русский" then return false end
        language = value
        env.DaDaLanguage = value
        for object, record in pairs(records) do
            for property in pairs(record.source) do paint(object, record, property) end
        end
        if window.RefreshSearch then window.RefreshSearch() end
        return true
    end
    function api:Unload()
        if stopped then return end
        stopped = true
        for _, connection in ipairs(rootConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        local objects = {}
        for object in pairs(records) do objects[#objects + 1] = object end
        for _, object in ipairs(objects) do release(object) end
        if library.Localization == self then library.Localization = nil end
    end
    rootConnections[#rootConnections + 1] = window.Gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(register)
    rootConnections[#rootConnections + 1] = window.Gui.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
        local record = records[object]
        if not record then return end
        -- Restore source before detaching, so a later reparent never treats a
        -- Russian rendering as the original English label.
        for property, source in pairs(record.source) do
            record.writing[property] = true
            object[property] = source
        end
        release(object)
    end)
    for _, object in ipairs(window.Gui:GetDescendants()) do register(object) end
    library.Localization = api
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups, function() api:Unload() end)
    return api
end

-- Config picker: checkmarks control Hot Keys membership, NOT feature state.
local function mountDaDaToggleSearch(panel, config, library, locale)
    local root=Instance.new("Frame")
    root.Name="ToggleSearch"
    root.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,306)
    root.BackgroundTransparency=1
    panel:Mount(root,"Search toggle functions")
    local search=Instance.new("TextBox")
    search.Name="FunctionNameSearch"
    search.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
    search.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(26,22,27)
    search.BorderSizePixel=0
    search.Text=""
    search.PlaceholderText="Search functions by name..."
    search.ClearTextOnFocus=false
    search.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    search.TextSize=12
    search.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(236,226,229)
    search.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(160,145,153)
    search.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    search.Parent=root
    Instance.new("UICorner",search).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
    local inset=Instance.new("UIPadding",search)
    inset.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8)
    inset.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)
    local count=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    count.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)
    count.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,34)
    count.BackgroundTransparency=1
    count.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
    count.TextSize=10
    count.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(175,160,168)
    count.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    count.Text=""
    count.Parent=root
    local results=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    results.Name="ToggleResults"
    results.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,58)
    results.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,248)
    results.BackgroundTransparency=1
    results.BorderSizePixel=0
    results.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
    results.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    results.ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    results.ScrollBarThickness=3
    results.Parent=root
    local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout",results)
    layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,4)
    local rows, clicks={},{}
    local stopped=false
    local previousQuery,previousLanguage,previousCount
    local function clear()
        for _,connection in ipairs(clicks) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(clicks)
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do row.frame:Destroy() end
        table.clear(rows)
    end
    local function refresh()
        if stopped or not root.Parent then return end
        if not config.hotkeyIncludes then return end
        local query=search.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local language=locale:GetLanguage()
        if query~=previousQuery or language~=previousLanguage or #config.bindings~=previousCount then
            previousQuery,previousLanguage,previousCount=query,language,#config.bindings
            clear()
            local matches={}
            for _,binding in ipairs(config.bindings) do
                if binding.kind=="Toggle" and binding.searchName
                    and locale:Matches(query,binding.searchName) then
                    matches[#matches+1]=binding
                end
            end
            table.sort(matches,function(a,b)
                if a.searchName==b.searchName then return a.id<b.id end
                return a.searchName:lower()<b.searchName:lower()
            end)
            count.Text=language=="Русский" and ("Найдено: "..#matches) or ("Found: "..#matches)
            for index,binding in ipairs(matches) do
                local entry=binding
                local inclusion=config.hotkeyIncludes[entry.id]
                local button=Instance.new("TextButton")
                button.Name="Result"
                button.Size=UDim2.new(1,-6,0,42)
                button.LayoutOrder=index
                button.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(24,18,23)
                button.BorderSizePixel=0
                button.Text=""
                button.AutoButtonColor=false
                button.Parent=results
                Instance.new("UICorner",button).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
                local box=Instance.new("Frame")
                box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14)
                box.Position=UDim2.new(0,8,0.5,-7)
                box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(32,22,27)
                box.BorderSizePixel=0
                box.Parent=button
                Instance.new("UICorner",box).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
                local edge=Instance.new("UIStroke",box)
                edge.Thickness=1
                edge.Transparency=0.25
                local check=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                check.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                check.BackgroundTransparency=0
                check.BorderSizePixel=0
                check.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                check.Text="v"
                check.TextSize=9
                check.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
                check.Visible=inclusion and inclusion.read()==true or false
                check.Parent=box
                Instance.new("UICorner",check).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
                local name=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(30,3)
                name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,19)
                name.BackgroundTransparency=1
                name.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                name.TextSize=11
                name.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(236,226,229)
                name.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                name.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                name.Text=entry.searchName
                name.Parent=button
                local section=name:Clone()
                section.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(30,23)
                section.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,15)
                section.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
                section.TextSize=9
                section.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(175,160,168)
                section.Text=entry.searchSection or ""
                section.Parent=button
                rows[#rows+1]={frame=button,binding=inclusion,check=check,edge=edge}
                clicks[#clicks+1]=button.Activated:Connect(function()
                    if config.blocked() then return end
                    if not inclusion then return end
                    inclusion.apply(not inclusion.read())
                    config.sync()
                    check.Visible=inclusion.read()==true
                end)
            end
            results.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,0)
        end
        local accent=library:GetAccent()
        results.ScrollBarImageColor3=accent
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
            row.check.Visible=row.binding and row.binding.read()==true or false
            row.check.BackgroundColor3=accent
            row.edge.Color=accent
        end
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refresh))
    local elapsed=0
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        elapsed=elapsed+dt
        if elapsed<0.2 then return end
        elapsed=0
        if root:IsDescendantOf(game) then refresh() end
    end))
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
        stopped=true
        clear()
        root:Destroy()
    end)
    -- Wait until the remaining menu controls have registered their bindings.
    task.defer(refresh)
end

-- Live player cards: independent selection for fling and head sitting.
local function mountDaDaPlayerPicker(panel,pal,onSelect,getSelection)
    local root=Instance.new("Frame")
    root.Name="DaDaPlayerPicker"
    root.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,300)
    root.BackgroundTransparency=1
    panel:Mount(root,"Player avatars usernames search")
    local search=Instance.new("TextBox")
    search.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
    search.BackgroundColor3=pal.control; search.BorderSizePixel=0
    search.Text=""; search.PlaceholderText="Search player..."
    search.ClearTextOnFocus=false; search.TextSize=12; search.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
    search.TextColor3=pal.text; search.PlaceholderColor3=pal.text
    search.Parent=root
    Instance.new("UICorner",search).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
    local list=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.Name="Players"; list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,40)
    list.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,-40); list.BackgroundTransparency=1
    list.BorderSizePixel=0; list.CanvasSize=UDim2.new()
    list.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    list.ScrollingEnabled=true; list.Active=true; list.ClipsDescendants=true
    list.ScrollBarThickness=5; list.ScrollBarImageColor3=pal.blue
    list.Parent=root
    local layout=Instance.new("UIGridLayout",list)
    layout.CellSize=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,0,112)
    layout.CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6)
    layout.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    layout.FillDirectionMaxCells=2
    layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    espLifecycle:bindScrollCanvas(list, 8)
    local rows={}
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        local c=signal:Connect(callback); table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,c); return c
    end
    local function label(parent,value,y,height,size)
        local text=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        text:SetAttribute("DaDaKeepText",true)
        text.BackgroundTransparency=1; text.Text=value; text.TextColor3=pal.text
        text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium; text.TextSize=size
        text.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        text.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None
        text.TextWrapped=true
        text.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(3,y); text.Size=UDim2.new(1,-6,0,height)
        text.Parent=parent
        return text
    end
    local function paint()
        local selected=getSelection()
        for player,row in pairs(rows) do
            local chosen=player.Name==selected
            row.border.Color=chosen and pal.blue or pal.border
            row.border.Thickness=chosen and 2 or 1
            row.mark.Visible=chosen
        end
    end
    local function rebuild()
        if espLifecycle.stopped or not root.Parent then return end
        for _,row in pairs(rows) do row.button:Destroy() end
        table.clear(rows)
        local players={}
        local query=search.Text:lower()
        for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player~=LP and (query=="" or (player.Name.." "..player.DisplayName):lower():find(query,1,true)) then
                players[#players+1]=player
            end
        end
        table.sort(players,function(a,b) return a.Name:lower()<b.Name:lower() end)
        for index,player in ipairs(players) do
            local button=Instance.new("TextButton")
            button.Name="Player_"..player.UserId; button.Text=""
            button.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,0,112); button.LayoutOrder=index
            button.BackgroundColor3=pal.control; button.BorderSizePixel=0
            button.AutoButtonColor=true; button.Parent=list
            Instance.new("UICorner",button).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
            local border=Instance.new("UIStroke",button); border.Color=pal.border
            local image=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            image.Name="Avatar"; image.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(48,48)
            image.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0)
            image.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,5); image.BackgroundTransparency=1
            image.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            image.Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..player.UserId.."&w=150&h=150"
            image.Parent=button
            Instance.new("UICorner",image).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
            label(button,player.DisplayName,55,27,10)
            label(button,"@"..player.Name,83,26,9)
            local mark=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            mark.BackgroundTransparency=1; mark.Text="✓"; mark.TextColor3=pal.text
            mark.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; mark.TextSize=18
            mark.Position=UDim2.new(1,-22,0,2); mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(20,22)
            mark.Parent=button
            rows[player]={button=button,border=border,mark=mark}
            button.Activated:Connect(function()
                if espLifecycle.stopped or player.Parent~=Players then return end
                local ok,err=pcall(onSelect,player)
                if not ok then warn("[DaDa Player Picker] "..tostring(err)) end
                paint()
            end)
        end
        local empty=root:FindFirstChild("EmptyPlayers")
        if not empty then
            empty=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            empty.Name="EmptyPlayers"; empty.BackgroundTransparency=1
            empty.Text="No players found"; empty.TextColor3=pal.text
            empty.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; empty.TextSize=12
            empty.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,48); empty.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,40)
            empty.Parent=root
        end
        empty.Visible=#players==0
        paint()
    end
    connect(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),rebuild)
    connect(Players.PlayerAdded,rebuild)
    connect(Players.PlayerRemoving,function() task.defer(rebuild) end)
    local elapsed=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
        elapsed=elapsed+dt
        if elapsed>=0.25 then elapsed=0; if root.Parent then paint() end end
    end)
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function() root:Destroy(); table.clear(rows) end)
    rebuild()
    return {Refresh=rebuild}
end

local function initMenu()
    -- The backend has its own local `gui`, which is nil here. Resolve the
    -- Neverlose ScreenGui from the actual window instead of passing that nil.
    local actualScreen=main:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
    assert(actualScreen,"[DaDa] Neverlose ScreenGui not found")
    local menuLibrary,menuWindow=makeNeverloseAdapter(Win,Library,main,actualScreen)
    gui=menuWindow.Gui
    win=menuWindow.Main
    -- The old window still constructs the original callbacks and custom panels,
    -- but is never shown or toggled. New controls use the same live bindings.
    menuWindow.ExternalToggleKeys=true

    -- Keep the existing notify(title, message, duration) API, now rendered by V5.
    if notifGui then notifGui:Destroy(); notifGui=nil end
    notify=function(title,message,duration)
        if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
        menuLibrary:Notify(title,message,duration)
    end
    local FONT_REGULAR,FONT_MEDIUM,FONT_BOLD=Enum.Font.Gotham,Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Enum.Font.GothamBold
    local pal={
        canvas=Color3.fromRGB(8,10,17),panel=Color3.fromRGB(20,23,34),sidebar=Color3.fromRGB(18,20,29),
        content=Color3.fromRGB(20,23,34),card=Color3.fromRGB(18,20,29),control=Color3.fromRGB(28,31,45),
        controlHover=Color3.fromRGB(40,45,62),border=Color3.fromRGB(58,70,98),hairline=Color3.fromRGB(42,48,64),
        text=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236),muted=Color3.fromRGB(112,116,138),desc=Color3.fromRGB(112,116,138),
        blue=Color3.fromRGB(78,139,255),blueText=Color3.new(1,1,1),danger=Color3.fromRGB(255,69,58),
        success=Color3.fromRGB(82,224,120),toggleOff=Color3.fromRGB(28,31,45),toggleOn=Color3.fromRGB(78,139,255),
        knobOff=Color3.new(1,1,1),pill=Color3.fromRGB(40,45,62),rowOn=Color3.fromRGB(40,45,62),
    }
    getgenv().DaDa_MenuPal=pal
    getgenv().DaDa_UIV5={Library=menuLibrary,Window=menuWindow}
    local locale
    local translationOK,translationResult=pcall(mountDaDaTranslation,menuWindow,menuLibrary)
    if translationOK then locale=translationResult else
        warn("[DaDa translation] "..tostring(translationResult))
        locale={GetLanguage=function() return "English" end, SetLanguage=function() end,
            Text=function(_,v) return v end, Matches=function() return true end}
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
        menuLibrary:Unload()
        if getgenv().DaDa_UIV5 and getgenv().DaDa_UIV5.Library==menuLibrary then
            getgenv().DaDa_UIV5=nil
            getgenv().DaDa_MenuPal=nil
        end
    end)
    table.insert(themeUpdaters,function(theme)
        if menuLibrary.Unloaded then return end
        menuLibrary:SetAccent(theme.Accent)
        pal.blue=theme.Accent
    end)
    local menuTabs={}
    local specialTabs={}
    for _,record in ipairs({
        {1,"Combat","game functions","game"},{8,"Farm","automatic farming","game"},
        {2,"Fling","target functions","target"},{3,"Movement","local player","player"},
        {4,"Visuals","player visuals","visuals"},{5,"World","world visuals","world"},
        {10,"Skinchanger","MM2 weapon skins","models"},{11,"Animations","custom animations","animations"},
        {12,"Emotes","emote library","emotes"},{13,"Lua","touch and click fling","target"},
        {6,"Extras","sounds and utilities","player"},
        {7,"Config","settings and saved configs","models"},{9,"Info","credits and community","game"},
    }) do
        -- Keep the original tab record for compatibility, but do not create the Lua tab.
        if record[1] ~= 13 then
            local tab=menuWindow:AddTab(record[2],record[3],record[4])
            menuTabs[record[1]]=tab
        end
    end
    -- Keep Lua controls and their original config IDs in the Fling tab.
    menuTabs[13]=menuTabs[2]
    specialTabs["Skinchanger"]=menuTabs[10]
    specialTabs["Animations"]=menuTabs[11]
    specialTabs["Emotes"]=menuTabs[12]
    local uiRegistry={}
    -- Preserve full gallery sections, including their existing click handlers.
    local migratedGalleryPanels={}

    -- Each control owns its value, validator, renderer and real callback.
    -- Legacy aliases stay paint-only for hotkeys and skybox mutual exclusion.
    local uiConfig={bindings={},byId={},busy=false,busySince=0}
    -- A click must never be swallowed forever by a stuck "busy" flag.
    function uiConfig.blocked()
        if espLifecycle.stopped then return true end
        if uiConfig.busy then
            if os.clock()-(uiConfig.busySince or 0)>5 then uiConfig.busy=false else return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function uiConfig.add(kind,id,default,callback,render,spec,validate)
        spec=spec or {}
        id=spec.id or id
        assert(not uiConfig.byId[id],"Duplicate config control: "..id)
        local binding={kind=kind,id=id,default=default,value=default,legacy=spec.legacy,
            fromLegacy=spec.fromLegacy,callback=callback,render=render,validate=validate}
        function binding.read()
            if spec.get then
                local ok,value=pcall(spec.get)
                if ok and value~=nil then
                    local valid,normalized=validate(value)
                    if valid then return normalized end
                end
            end
            return binding.value
        end
        function binding.paint(value,animate)
            local ok,normalized=validate(value)
            if not ok then return false,normalized end
            binding.value=normalized
            binding.render(normalized,animate==true)
            return true
        end
        function binding.apply(value)
            local ok,normalized=validate(value)
            if not ok then return false,normalized end
            if callback then
                local success,err=pcall(callback,normalized)
                if not success then
                    if spec.get then binding.paint(binding.read(),false)
                    else binding.value=normalized; binding.paint(normalized,true) end
                    warn("[DaDa Config] "..id..": "..tostring(err))
                    return false,tostring(err)
                end
            end
            -- Read back the authoritative state: a callback may reject a change.
            binding.value=normalized
            binding.paint(binding.read(),true)
            return true
        end
        uiConfig.bindings[#uiConfig.bindings+1]=binding
        uiConfig.byId[id]=binding
        if binding.legacy then
            local alias=binding.legacy:match("^[^_]+_(.+)$")
            if alias then uiRegistry[alias]=function(value) return binding.paint(value,true) end end
        end
        binding.paint(binding.read(),false)
        return binding
    end
    function uiConfig.colorName(value,colors,fallback)
        for name,color in pairs(colors) do
            if value==color then return name end
        end
        return fallback
    end
    uiConfig.overlayColors={Purple=Color3.fromRGB(190,90,255),Red=Color3.fromRGB(255,65,80),
        Blue=Color3.fromRGB(70,155,255),Green=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140),
        White=Color3.fromRGB(245,245,255),Gold=Color3.fromRGB(255,190,65)}
    function uiConfig.sync()
        if uiConfig.blocked() then return end
        for _,binding in ipairs(uiConfig.bindings) do
            local value=binding.read()
            if value~=binding.value then binding.paint(value,false) end
        end
        ST.quick_state.silent=SL.enabled==true
        ST.quick_state.esp=ST.esp_on==true
        ST.quick_state.fly=ST.fly==true
        ST.quick_state.bhop=ST.bhop==true
        ST.quick_state.inf_jump=ST.inf_jump==true
        ST.quick_state.getgun=ST.getgun==true
        ST.quick_state.auto_shoot=SL.auto_on==true
        ST.quick_state.invisible=SHF.invisible==true
    end
    getgenv().DaDa_ConfigUI=uiConfig
    do
        local elapsed=0
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            elapsed=elapsed+dt
            if elapsed<0.2 then return end
            elapsed=0
            if gui and gui.Parent then uiConfig.sync() end
        end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
            if getgenv().DaDa_ConfigUI==uiConfig then getgenv().DaDa_ConfigUI=nil end
        end)
    end

    -- Native V5 widgets, original callbacks and original config keys.
    makePanel=function(tabIndex,side,title,configSide)
        local tab=specialTabs[title] or menuTabs[tabIndex]
        assert(tab,"Unknown DaDa tab: "..tostring(tabIndex))
        local section=tab:AddSection(title,specialTabs[title] and "left" or side)
        local P={body=section.Body,section=section}
        if (tabIndex==10 and (title=="Skinchanger" or title=="Morph"))
            or (tabIndex==6 and (title=="Animations" or title=="Emotes")) then
            -- Gallery is created directly in its Neverlose section.
        end
        -- Layout may change without changing existing saved config IDs.
        local configPanel=tostring(tabIndex).."/"..(configSide or side).."/"..title
        local function idFor(kind,label,spec)
            return (spec and spec.id) or (configPanel.."/"..kind.."/"..label)
        end
        local function event(binding,control,value)
            if not binding then return end
            if uiConfig.blocked() then control:Set(binding.read(),true); return end
            local ok= binding.apply(value)
            if not ok then control:Set(binding.read(),true) end
            uiConfig.sync()
        end
        function P:Mount(frame,name)
            if frame:IsA("TextButton") then
                frame.BackgroundColor3=pal.control
                frame.BackgroundTransparency=0
                frame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26)
                frame.TextColor3=pal.text
                frame.TextSize=11
                frame.AutoButtonColor=false
            end
            return section:Mount(frame,name)
        end
        function P:Toggle(label,default,callback,flag,spec)
            local binding,control
            control=section:AddToggle({Name=label,Flag=idFor("Toggle",label,spec),Default=default,
                Callback=function(value) event(binding,control,value) end})
            binding=uiConfig.add("Toggle",configPanel.."/Toggle/"..label,default==true,callback,
                function(value) control:Set(value,true) end,spec,function(value)
                    if type(value)~="boolean" then return false,"expected boolean" end
                    return true,value
                end)
            if flag then uiRegistry[flag]=function(value) return binding.paint(value,true) end end
            binding.control=control
            binding.searchName=label
            binding.searchSection=title
            binding.searchFlag=flag
            return binding
        end
        function P:Slider(label,default,min,max,callback,spec)
            local binding,control
            local step=(spec and spec.step) or ((default%1~=0 or min%1~=0 or max%1~=0) and 0.01 or 1)
            control=section:AddSlider({Name=label,Flag=idFor("Slider",label,spec),Default=default,
                Min=min,Max=max,Increment=step,Callback=function(value) event(binding,control,value) end})
            binding=uiConfig.add("Slider",configPanel.."/Slider/"..label,default,callback,
                function(value) control:Set(value,true) end,spec,function(value)
                    if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false,"expected finite number" end
                    if value<min-0.000001 or value>max+0.000001 then return false,"outside slider range" end
                    return true,math.clamp(math.floor(value/step+0.5)*step,min,max)
                end)
            binding.control=control
            binding.nlMin=min
            binding.nlMax=max
            binding.nlStep=step
            return binding
        end
        function P:Dropdown(label,values,default,callback,spec)
            local binding,control
            control=section:AddDropdown({Name=label,Flag=idFor("Dropdown",label,spec),Options=values,
                Default=default,Callback=function(value) event(binding,control,value) end})
            binding=uiConfig.add("Dropdown",configPanel.."/Dropdown/"..label,default,callback,
                function(value) control:Set(value,true) end,spec,function(value)
                    if type(value)~="string" then return false,"expected dropdown string" end
                    for _,item in ipairs(values) do if item==value then return true,value end end
                    return false,"unknown dropdown option: "..value
                end)
            function binding.setOptions(items)
                local copy={}
                for _,value in ipairs(items or {}) do copy[#copy+1]=value end
                table.clear(values)
                for _,value in ipairs(copy) do values[#values+1]=value end
                if #values==0 then values[1]="loading..." end
                control:SetOptions(values)
                binding.paint(binding.read(),false)
            end
            binding.control=control
            binding.nlOptions=values
            return binding
        end
        function P:Value(id,default,callback,get,validate)
            return uiConfig.add("Value",id,default,callback,function() end,{get=get},validate)
        end
        function P:ColorPicker(label,default,callback,spec)
            local binding,control
            local function normalize(value)
                if typeof(value)=="Color3" then
                    for _,channel in ipairs({value.R,value.G,value.B}) do
                        if channel~=channel or channel<0 or channel>1 then return false,"invalid color" end
                    end
                    return true,"#"..value:ToHex():upper()
                end
                if type(value)=="table" and value._c==true then
                    local r,g,b=value.r or value[1],value.g or value[2],value.b or value[3]
                    if type(r)=="number" and type(g)=="number" and type(b)=="number"
                        and r==r and g==g and b==b and r>=0 and r<=1 and g>=0 and g<=1 and b>=0 and b<=1 then
                        return true,"#"..Color3.new(r,g,b):ToHex():upper()
                    end
                end
                if type(value)=="string" then
                    if value:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return true,value:upper() end
                    local named=spec and spec.colors and spec.colors[value]
                    if value=="Default" then named=default end
                    if named then return true,"#"..named:ToHex():upper() end
                    local r,g,b=value:match("^(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
                    r,g,b=tonumber(r),tonumber(g),tonumber(b)
                    if r and g and b and r<=255 and g<=255 and b<=255 then
                        return true,"#"..Color3.fromRGB(r,g,b):ToHex():upper()
                    end
                end
                return false,"expected Color3 or #RRGGBB"
            end
            local _,hex=normalize(default)
            control=section:AddColorPicker({Name=label,Flag=idFor("ColorPicker",label,spec),Default=default,
                Callback=function(color)
                    if not binding then return end
                    if not uiConfig.blocked() then binding.apply(color) end
                    control:Set(Color3.fromHex(binding.read()),true)
                    uiConfig.sync()
                end})
            binding=uiConfig.add("ColorPicker",configPanel.."/ColorPicker/"..label,hex,
                function(value) if callback then callback(Color3.fromHex(value)) end end,
                function(value) control:Set(Color3.fromHex(value),true) end,spec,normalize)
            binding.control=control
            return binding
        end
        function P:Button(label,callback)
            return section:AddButton({Name=label,Callback=function()
                if uiConfig.blocked() then return end
                if callback then callback() end
                uiConfig.sync()
            end})
        end
        function P:Label(label) return section:AddLabel(label) end
        function P:Textbox(options) return section:AddTextbox(options) end
        return P
    end
    local visualColors={
        names={"Default","Black","White","Gray","Red","Green","Blue","Yellow","Orange","Purple","Pink","Cyan","Gold"},
        values={Black=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),White=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Gray=Color3.fromRGB(128,128,128),
            Red=Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50),Green=Color3.fromRGB(50,255,90),Blue=Color3.fromRGB(50,110,255),
            Yellow=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0),Orange=Color3.fromRGB(255,130,0),Purple=Color3.fromRGB(170,70,255),
            Pink=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,190),Cyan=Color3.fromRGB(0,220,255),Gold=Color3.fromRGB(255,195,45)}
    }
    -- COMBAT
    local cA=makePanel(1,"left","Silent Aim")
    cA:Button("Silent Aim",function()
        if SHF.silent_click then SHF.silent_click() end
    end)
    cA:Toggle("Prediction",true,function(v) SL.predict=v; SL_sync() end,nil,{get=function() return SL.predict end, legacy="SL_predict"})
    cA:Toggle("Force Shoot",false,function(v)
        SL.force=v
        SL_sync()
        if not v and _G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin then pcall(_G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin) end
    end,nil,{get=function() return SL.force end, legacy="SL_force"})
    cA:Slider("Origin",15,3,40,function(v) SL.stand_off=v; SL_sync() end,{get=function() return SL.stand_off end, legacy="SL_stand_off"})
    cA:Dropdown("Hit Part",{"Head","UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"},"UpperTorso",function(v) ST.hit_part=v end,{get=function() return ST.hit_part end, legacy="ST_hit_part"})
    local cB=makePanel(1,"right","Auto Shoot")
    cB:Toggle("Auto Shoot",false,function(v) SL.auto_on=v; SL_sync(); ST.quick_state.auto_shoot=v end,nil,{get=function() return SL.auto_on end, legacy="SL_auto_on"})
    cB:Slider("Auto Delay",0,0,600,function(v) SL.auto_delay=v/1000; SL_sync() end,{get=function() return SL.auto_delay*1000 end, legacy="SL_auto_delay", fromLegacy=function(v) return v*1000 end})
    -- Additive controls for the reference-123 auto controller.
    cB:Slider("Min Coverage %",60,0,100,function(v) SL.auto_quality=v/100; SL_sync() end,
        {get=function() return (SL.auto_quality or 0.60)*100 end,legacy="SL_auto_quality"})
    cB:Slider("Max Wait ms",600,0,2000,function(v) SL.auto_patience=v/1000; SL_sync() end,
        {get=function() return (SL.auto_patience or 0.60)*1000 end,legacy="SL_auto_patience"})
    cB:Label("Shot cooldown: native Shitaro")
    cB:Label("Shitaro: native movement checks always active")
    local cInvis=makePanel(1,"left","Invisible")
    cInvis:Toggle("Invisible",false,function(v)
        SHF.invisToggle(v)
    end,"invisible",{get=function() return SHF.invisible==true end,legacy="SHF_invisible"})
    local cLock=makePanel(1,"right","Aim Lock")
    cLock:Toggle("Aim Lock",false,function(v) ST.aim_lock=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.aim_lock end})
    cLock:Toggle("Prediction",true,function(v) ST.aim_lock_predict=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.aim_lock_predict end})
    cLock:Dropdown("Target",{"Nearest","Sheriff","Murder"},"Nearest",function(v) ST.aim_lock_target=v end,{get=function() return ST.aim_lock_target end})
    cLock:Slider("Prediction ms",120,0,500,function(v) ST.aim_lock_lead=v/1000 end,{get=function() return ST.aim_lock_lead*1000 end})
    local cC=makePanel(1,"left","Get Gun")
    cC:Toggle("Auto Get Gun",false,function(v) ST.getgun=v; ST.quick_state.getgun=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.getgun end, legacy="ST_getgun"})
    cC:Dropdown("Mode",{"Touch","Teleport","PlayerTP","AutoGrab"},"Touch",function(v) ST.getgun_mode=v end,{get=function() return ST.getgun_mode end, legacy="ST_getgun_mode"})
    cC:Slider("Interval",15,5,100,function(v) ST.getgun_interval=v/100 end,{get=function() return ST.getgun_interval*100 end, legacy="ST_getgun_interval", fromLegacy=function(v) return v*100 end})
    cC:Toggle("Teleport Back",true,function(v) ST.getgun_tp_back=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.getgun_tp_back end, legacy="ST_getgun_tp_back"})
    local cD=makePanel(1,"right","Knife / Murderer")
    cD:Toggle("Knife Throwing",false,function(v) SHF.setKnifeThrowing(v) end,nil,{id="1/right/Knife / Murderer/Toggle/Auto Knife Throw",get=function() return ST.auto_knife_throw end, legacy="ST_auto_knife_throw"})
    cD:Toggle("Knife Prediction",true,function(v) ST.knife_predict=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.knife_predict end, legacy="ST_knife_predict"})
    cD:Slider("Knife Lead %",100,0,300,function(v) ST.knife_lead=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_lead end, legacy="ST_knife_lead"})
    cD:Slider("Knife Range",400,10,2000,function(v) ST.knife_range=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_range end,legacy="ST_knife_range"})
    cD:Slider("Knife Speed",96,40,400,function(v) ST.knife_speed=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_speed end,legacy="ST_knife_speed"})
    cD:Slider("Knife Air %",35,0,120,function(v) ST.knife_air=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_air end,legacy="ST_knife_air"})
    cD:Slider("Knife Offset ms",0,-80,220,function(v) ST.knife_offset=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_offset end,legacy="ST_knife_offset"})
    cD:Slider("Auto Throw Interval",1,0.25,3,function(v) ST.knife_interval=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_interval end})
    cD:Dropdown("Auto Throw Mode",{"Remote","Game Input"},"Remote",function(v) ST.knife_auto_mode=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_auto_mode end})
    cD:Dropdown("Throw Input",{"E","Right Mouse"},"E",function(v) ST.knife_input=v end,{get=function() return ST.knife_input end,legacy="ST_knife_input"})
    cD:Slider("Throw Hold ms",150,50,500,function(v) ST.knife_hold=v/1000 end,{get=function() return ST.knife_hold*1000 end,legacy="ST_knife_hold",fromLegacy=function(v) return v*1000 end})
    cD:Button("Knife Diagnostics",function() if SHF.knifeDiagnostics then SHF.knifeDiagnostics() end end)
    cD:Toggle("Kill Aura",false,function(v) ST.killaura=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.killaura end, legacy="ST_killaura"})
    cD:Button("Kill All",function()
        if SHF.kill_all_once then SHF.kill_all_once() end
    end)
    cD:Slider("Kill Distance",30,5,60,function(v) ST.killaura_dist=v end,{get=function() return ST.killaura_dist end, legacy="ST_killaura_dist"})

    do
        -- Server-local target selection is intentionally not saved in configs.
        local panel=makePanel(1,"left","Teleport")
        local placeholder="Select player"
        local selectedName=placeholder
        local resolvingRole=false
        local picker=panel.section:AddDropdown({
            Name="Player",Flag="dada/teleport/player",Options={placeholder},Default=placeholder,
            Callback=function(value)
                if not uiConfig.blocked() then selectedName=value end
            end
        })
        local function refreshPlayers(leaving)
            if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            local names={}
            for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if other~=LP and other~=leaving then names[#names+1]=other.Name end
            end
            table.sort(names,function(a,b) return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b) end)
            local available=false
            for _,name in ipairs(names) do
                if name==selectedName then available=true; break end
            end
            if not available then selectedName=placeholder end
            table.insert(names,1,placeholder)
            picker:SetOptions(names)
            picker:Set(selectedName,true)
        end
        local function aliveRoot(other)
            local character=other and other.Character
            local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
                and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
                return root,character
            end
        end
        local function moveTo(destination)
            if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            local root,character=aliveRoot(LP)
            if not root then notify("Teleport","Your character is not alive"); return end
            local ok,err=pcall(function()
                -- Preserve the root-to-model-pivot offset, including custom rigs.
                local pivotOffset=root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(character:GetPivot())
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
                character:PivotTo(destination*pivotOffset)
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[DaDa Teleport] "..tostring(err))
                notify("Teleport","Teleport failed")
            end
        end
        local function teleportTo(other)
            if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            if not other or other.Parent~=Players or other==LP then
                notify("Teleport","Select an available player")
                return
            end
            local targetRoot=aliveRoot(other)
            if not targetRoot then notify("Teleport","Target character is not alive"); return end
            moveTo(targetRoot.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,4))
        end
        local function teleportToRole(wanted)
            if resolvingRole or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            resolvingRole=true
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok,err=pcall(function()
                    local roles={}
                    local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
                    -- Do not enter get_round's unbounded WaitForChild outside MM2.
                    if modules and modules:FindFirstChild("CurrentRoundClient") then
                        roles=get_roles()
                    end
                    if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
                    local ownRoot=aliveRoot(LP)
                    if not ownRoot then notify("Teleport","Your character is not alive"); return end
                    local chosen,best=nil,math.huge
                    for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        local root=other~=LP and aliveRoot(other)
                        if root then
                            local role=roles[other.Name]
                            local character=other.Character
                            local backpack=other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                            if holds(character,"Knife") or holds(backpack,"Knife") then
                                role="Murderer"
                            elseif role~="Murderer" and (holds(character,"Gun") or holds(backpack,"Gun")) then
                                role="Sheriff"
                            end
                            local matches=role==wanted or (wanted=="Sheriff" and role=="Hero")
                            local distance=(root.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude
                            if matches and distance<best then chosen,best=other,distance end
                        end
                    end
                    if chosen then teleportTo(chosen)
                    else notify("Teleport",wanted.." not found among living players") end
                end)
                resolvingRole=false
                if not ok and not espLifecycle.stopped then
                    warn("[DaDa Teleport] "..tostring(err))
                    notify("Teleport","Could not resolve the role")
                end
            end)
        end
        panel:Button("Teleport to Player",function()
            teleportTo(Players:FindFirstChild(selectedName))
        end)
        panel:Button("Teleport to Sheriff",function() teleportToRole("Sheriff") end)
        panel:Button("Teleport to Murderer",function() teleportToRole("Murderer") end)
        panel:Button("Teleport to Lobby",function()
            moveTo(CFrame.new(527.477722,461.372375,37.355587,1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1))
        end)
        panel:Button("Refresh Players",function() refreshPlayers() end)
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() refreshPlayers() end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(refreshPlayers))
        refreshPlayers()
    end

    local voteSlots={}
    local function deepFind(parent,name)
        if not parent then return nil end
        local found=parent:FindFirstChild(name,true)
        if found then return found end
        return nil
    end
    local function findVoteLobby()
        for _,lobbyName in ipairs({"RegularLobby","SummerLobby","Lobby"}) do
            local lobby=workspace:FindFirstChild(lobbyName) or workspace:FindFirstChild(lobbyName,true)
            if lobby then return lobby end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function getImageSource(root)
        if not root then return "" end
        local function read(obj)
            if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                return obj.Image
            elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                return obj.Texture
            end
            local ok,img=pcall(function() return obj.Image end)
            if ok and type(img)=="string" and img~="" then return img end
            return ""
        end
        local direct=read(root)
        if direct~="" then return direct end
        for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            local img=read(obj)
            if img~="" then return img end
        end
        return ""
    end
    local function getMapTitle(model)
        local voteInfo=deepFind(model,"VoteInfoGui")
        local mapInfo=deepFind(model,"MapInfoGui")
        local title=(voteInfo and deepFind(voteInfo,"MapName"))
            or (mapInfo and deepFind(mapInfo,"MapName"))
            or deepFind(model,"MapName")
        if title and (title:IsA("TextLabel") or title:IsA("TextButton") or title:IsA("TextBox")) then
            local value=title.Text
            if value and value~="" and value~="MAP NAME" then return value end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function getMapImage(model)
        local mapInfo=deepFind(model,"MapInfoGui")
        local icon=(mapInfo and deepFind(mapInfo,"MapIcon")) or deepFind(model,"MapIcon")
        local img=getImageSource(icon or mapInfo)
        if img=="" then
            -- Some lobby versions put the map thumbnail outside MapInfoGui.
            img=getImageSource(model)
        end
        return img
    end

                local slot=voteSlots[i]
                -- The clicked card is the authoritative target for Auto Vote.
                getgenv().DaDa_SelectedMapName = selectedMap
                getgenv().DaDa_MapPriority = selectedMap
                getgenv().DaDa_SelectedVoteModel = slot and slot.model or nil
                -- Restart the worker so it immediately re-reads the selected map.
                -- Selection is shared by Auto Vote and VoteDupe; restart either active worker.
                local restartAutoVote = SHF.mapvote
                local restartVoteDupe = SHF.mapvote_dupe

                    SHF.mapvote = false
                    SHF.mapvote_dupe = false
                    task.delay(0.12, function()
                        if voteCards and voteCards.Parent and getgenv().DaDa_SelectedMapName == selectedMap then
                            SHF.mapvote = restartAutoVote
                            SHF.mapvote_dupe = restartVoteDupe
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if notify then pcall(function() notify("Auto Vote","Selected map: "..selectedMap) end) end
            else
                if notify then pcall(function() notify("Auto Vote","Map not detected yet. Wait for the lobby cards to load.") end) end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function refreshVoteCards()
        local lobby=findVoteLobby()
        local padsRoot=lobby and deepFind(lobby,"VotePads")
        local candidates={}
        local seen={}
        local function addCandidate(model)
            if not model or seen[model] then return end
            local mapName=getMapTitle(model)
            if mapName then
                seen[model]=true
                local pad=deepFind(model,"Pad")
                if not (pad and pad:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    pad=model:IsA("BasePart") and model or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
                end
                local pos=pad and pad.Position or Vector3.zero
                candidates[#candidates+1]={name=mapName,image=getMapImage(model),model=model,x=pos.X,z=pos.Z}
            end
        end
        if padsRoot then
            -- The game's VotePads child order is the canonical slot order. Do not sort by
            -- map name or world coordinates: those can separate an image from its pad.
            for _,obj in ipairs(padsRoot:GetChildren()) do addCandidate(obj) end
            -- Some lobby variants wrap the three vote models in one extra folder.
            if #candidates==0 then
                for _,obj in ipairs(padsRoot:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj.Name:match("VotePad%d*") or obj.Name:match("Detector%d*") then addCandidate(obj) end
                end
            end
        end
        if #candidates==0 and lobby then
            for _,obj in ipairs(lobby:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj.Name:match("VotePad%d*") or obj.Name:match("Detector%d*") then addCandidate(obj) end
            end
        end
        for i,slot in ipairs(voteSlots) do
            local entry=candidates[i]
            if entry then
                slot.mapName=entry.name
                slot.model=entry.model
                slot.name.Text=entry.name
                slot.image.Image=entry.image or ""
                slot.card.Visible=true
            else
                slot.mapName=nil
                slot.model=nil
                slot.name.Text="Waiting for map..."
                slot.image.Image=""
                slot.card.Visible=true
            end
        end
        voteHint.Text=(#candidates>0) and "Tap a map to prioritize Auto Vote" or "Waiting for lobby map cards..."
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while voteCards.Parent do
            pcall(refreshVoteCards)
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

        end

                    if not uiConfig.blocked() then source.apply(value) end

                end})

        end
        interactionPanel:Label("Touch Fling: touch another character")
        interactionPanel:Label("Click Fling: click or tap a character")
        interactionPanel:Label("Duration and Bypass use the Fling tab settings")
        interactionPanel:Label("Disable Fly and Auto Farm before interaction fling")
        interactionPanel:Button("Stop Interaction Fling",function()
            api.setTouch(false); api.setClick(false)
            uiConfig.sync()
        end)
        end
    end

    -- MOVEMENT
    local mA=makePanel(3,"left","Fly / Noclip")

    -- Shared with the later Gun Beam controls in this same initMenu scope.
    local vB
    -- VISUALS: selection is an editing mask; each role keeps its own live profile.
    do
        local api=ST._espRoles
        local roles=makePanel(4,"left","ESP Roles")
        roles:Toggle("ESP",ST.esp_on,function(v) ST.esp_on=v; ST.quick_state.esp=v end,"esp",
            {get=function() return ST.esp_on end,legacy="ST_esp_on"})
        roles:Label("Select roles to EDIT together (not visibility)")
        for _,role in ipairs(api.order) do
            roles:Toggle(role,true,function(v) api.selected[role]=v end,nil,
                {get=function() return api.selected[role] end})
        end
        local summary=roles:Label("")
        local function updateSummary()
            local selected={}
            for _,role in ipairs(api.order) do if api.selected[role] then selected[#selected+1]=role end end
            summary:Set(#selected==0 and "No edit targets selected" or "Editing: "..table.concat(selected,", "))
        end
        -- Persistent, per-role values. Old global ESP configs migrate into every role.
        for _,role in ipairs(api.order) do
            local profile=api.profiles[role]
            for _,key in ipairs(api.fields) do
                local default=profile[key]
                local function validate(value)
                    if key=="esp_color" then
                        if value=="Role" or api.colors[value] then return true,value end
                        if type(value)=="string" and value:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return true,value:upper() end
                        return false,"expected Role, legacy preset or #RRGGBB"
                    elseif key=="esp_max_dist" then
                        if type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=100 and value<=3000 then return true,value end
                        return false,"ESP distance must be 100..3000"
                    end
                    if type(value)=="boolean" then return true,value end
                    return false,"expected boolean"
                end
                uiConfig.add("Value","esp-profile/"..role.."/"..key,default,
                    function(value) profile[key]=value end,function() end,
                    {get=function() return profile[key] end,legacy=key:sub(1,4)=="esp_" and key~="esp_color" and ("ST_"..key) or nil},validate)
            end
        end
        local effects=makePanel(4,"left","ESP Chams Settings")
        local basic=makePanel(4,"left","ESP Settings")
        local extra=makePanel(4,"right","ESP Extras")
        vB=extra
        local function groupToggle(panel,label,key)
            local binding=panel:Toggle(label,api.read(key),function(v) api.write(key,v) end,nil,
                {get=function() return api.read(key) end})
            binding.transient=true
        end
        groupToggle(basic,"Enable Profile","enabled")
        for _,item in ipairs({{"Outline","esp_outline"},{"Chams","esp_chams"},{"Cube v1","esp_cube_v1"},
            {"Cube v2","esp_cube_v2"},{"Solid Body","esp_solid_body"},{"Fill Chams","esp_fill_chams"}}) do
            groupToggle(effects,item[1],item[2])
        end
        for _,item in ipairs({{"Box","esp_box"},{"Name","esp_name"},{"Distance","esp_dist"},{"Health Bar","esp_health"}}) do
            groupToggle(basic,item[1],item[2])
        end
        for _,item in ipairs({{"Skeleton","esp_skel"},{"Snapline","esp_line"},{"Flags","esp_flags"}}) do
            groupToggle(extra,item[1],item[2])
        end
        extra:Slider("Max Distance",1000,100,3000,function(v) api.write("esp_max_dist",v) end,
            {get=function() return api.read("esp_max_dist") end}).transient=true
        effects:Toggle("Use Role Color",true,function(value)
            local role=api.editRole()
            api.write("esp_color",value and "Role" or ("#"..api.color(role,api.profiles[role]):ToHex():upper()))
        end,nil,{get=function() return api.read("esp_color")=="Role" end}).transient=true
        effects:ColorPicker("ESP Color",api.color(api.editRole(),api.profiles[api.editRole()]),function(color)
            api.write("esp_color","#"..color:ToHex():upper())
        end,{get=function() local role=api.editRole(); return api.color(role,api.profiles[role]) end}).transient=true
        extra:Label("Mixed values: showing the preview / first selected role")
        local previewPanel=makePanel(4,"right","ESP Preview")
        previewPanel:Dropdown("Preview Role",api.order,api.preview,function(v) api.preview=v end,
            {get=function() return api.preview end})
        previewPanel:Label("Preview ignores master ESP; changes are live")
        -- ViewportFrame does not render Highlight. Separate mesh silhouettes and a
        -- tinted viewport reproduce its fill/outline without touching the real avatar.
        local host=Instance.new("Frame")
        host.Name="LocalPlayerESPPreview"; host.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,300)
        host.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,19,26); host.BorderSizePixel=0
        host.ClipsDescendants=true
        local rounding=Instance.new("UICorner"); rounding.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7); rounding.Parent=host
        previewPanel:Mount(host,"Rotating local player preview")
        local function viewport(name,z)
            local view=Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
            view.Name=name; view.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); view.BackgroundTransparency=1
            view.BorderSizePixel=0; view.ZIndex=z; view.Ambient=Color3.new(1,1,1)
            view.LightColor=Color3.new(0,0,0); view.Parent=host
            local world=Instance.new("WorldModel"); world.Parent=view
            local camera=Instance.new("Camera"); camera.FieldOfView=35; camera.Parent=view
            view.CurrentCamera=camera
            return view,world,camera
        end
        local outlineView,outlineWorld,outlineCamera=viewport("OutlineSilhouette",2)
        local bodyView,bodyWorld,bodyCamera=viewport("Avatar",3)
        local tintView,tintWorld,tintCamera=viewport("ChamsFill",4)
        local cubeView,cubeWorld,cubeCamera=viewport("Cubes",5)
        local function frame(name,color)
            local object=Instance.new("Frame"); object.Name=name; object.BorderSizePixel=0
            object.BackgroundColor3=color or Color3.new(1,1,1); object.ZIndex=8
            object.Visible=false; object.Parent=host
            return object
        end
        local function label(name,size)
            local object=Instance.new("TextLabel"); object.Name=name
            object.BackgroundTransparency=1; object.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
            object.TextSize=size; object.TextStrokeTransparency=0.25
            object.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1); object.ZIndex=9
            object.Visible=false; object.Parent=host; return object
        end
        local box=frame("Box"); box.BackgroundTransparency=1
        local boxStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke"); boxStroke.Thickness=1.5; boxStroke.Parent=box
        local nameText=label("Name",12); local distanceText=label("Distance",11)
        local flagText=label("Role",11); local statusText=label("Status",10)
        statusText.Visible=true; statusText.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,18)
        statusText.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6); statusText.Text="Loading character..."
        local healthBG=frame("HealthBackground",Color3.new(0,0,0))
        local healthBar=frame("HealthBar")
        local snapline=frame("Snapline")
        local bones={}
        for i=1,20 do bones[i]=frame("Bone"..i) end
        local rig6={{"Head","Torso"},{"Torso","Left Arm"},{"Torso","Right Arm"},{"Torso","Left Leg"},{"Torso","Right Leg"}}
        local rig15={{"Head","UpperTorso"},{"UpperTorso","LowerTorso"},{"LowerTorso","LeftUpperLeg"},
            {"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg"},{"LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot"},{"LowerTorso","RightUpperLeg"},
            {"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg"},{"RightLowerLeg","RightFoot"},{"UpperTorso","LeftUpperArm"},
            {"LeftUpperArm","LeftLowerArm"},{"LeftLowerArm","LeftHand"},{"UpperTorso","RightUpperArm"},
            {"RightUpperArm","RightLowerArm"},{"RightLowerArm","RightHand"}}
        local model,neutralPivot,characterSource
        local fills,outlines,rigParts,voxels={},{},{},{}
        local radius,height,angle=4,6,0
        local rebuild=true
        local cubeMode=""
        local function clearPreview()
            bodyWorld:ClearAllChildren(); outlineWorld:ClearAllChildren()
            tintWorld:ClearAllChildren(); cubeWorld:ClearAllChildren()
            model=nil; characterSource=nil; neutralPivot=nil
            fills={}; outlines={}; rigParts={}; voxels={}; cubeMode=""
        end
        local function monoPart(source,parent,grow)
            local copy=source:Clone()
            for _,child in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                if child:IsA("DataModelMesh") then
                    if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                        child.TextureId=""; child.VertexColor=Vector3.new(1,1,1)
                        if grow then child.Scale=child.Scale*1.045 end
                    end
                else child:Destroy() end
            end
            if copy:IsA("MeshPart") then copy.TextureID="" end
            copy.Anchored=true; copy.CanCollide=false; copy.CanTouch=false; copy.CanQuery=false
            copy.CastShadow=false; copy.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            copy.Reflectance=0; copy.Transparency=0; copy.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
            if grow then copy.Size=copy.Size*1.045 end
            copy.Parent=parent; return copy
        end
        local function buildPreview()
            local source=LP.Character
            if not source or not source:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                clearPreview(); statusText.Text="Waiting for character..."; return
            end
            local old=source.Archivable
            local ok,copy=pcall(function() source.Archivable=true; return source:Clone() end)
            pcall(function() source.Archivable=old end)
            if not ok or not copy then statusText.Text="Character clone unavailable"; return end
            clearPreview()
            -- Destroy executable objects BEFORE attaching anything to a WorldModel.
            for _,object in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or object:IsA("Tool")
                    or object:IsA("Highlight") or object:IsA("PVAdornment")
                    or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail")
                    or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Sound")
                    or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                    object:Destroy()
                elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.Anchored=true; object.CanCollide=false; object.CanTouch=false
                    object.CanQuery=false; object.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
                end
            end
            for _,object in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("JointInstance") or object:IsA("Constraint") then object:Destroy() end
            end
            model=copy; characterSource=source
            local center,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
            model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-center.Position)*model:GetPivot())
            neutralPivot=model:GetPivot(); height=math.max(size.Y,1)
            radius=math.max(size.X,size.Z,height)*0.5
            model.Parent=bodyWorld
            for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" and part.Transparency<1 then
                    local isRig=part.Parent==model
                    fills[#fills+1]={source=part,copy=monoPart(part,tintWorld,false),rig=isRig}
                    outlines[#outlines+1]={source=part,copy=monoPart(part,outlineWorld,true)}
                    if isRig then rigParts[#rigParts+1]=part end
                end
            end
            rebuild=false
        end
        local function newVoxel(part,size,offset,transparency)
            local copy=Instance.new("Part"); copy.Anchored=true
            copy.CanCollide=false; copy.CanTouch=false; copy.CanQuery=false
            copy.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic; copy.Size=size
            copy.Transparency=transparency; copy.Parent=cubeWorld
            voxels[#voxels+1]={source=part,copy=copy,offset=offset}
        end
        local function updateCubes(cfg,col)
            local mode=(cfg.esp_cube_v1 and "1" or "0")..(cfg.esp_cube_v2 and "1" or "0")
            if mode~=cubeMode then
                cubeWorld:ClearAllChildren(); voxels={}; cubeMode=mode
                if cfg.esp_cube_v1 then
                    local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if root then
                        local low=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge)
                        local high=Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge)
                        for _,part in ipairs(rigParts) do
                            local relative=root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
                            for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
                                local v=relative:PointToWorldSpace(part.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)/2)
                                low=Vector3.new(math.min(low.X,v.X),math.min(low.Y,v.Y),math.min(low.Z,v.Z))
                                high=Vector3.new(math.max(high.X,v.X),math.max(high.Y,v.Y),math.max(high.Z,v.Z))
                            end end end
                        end
                        if #rigParts>0 then newVoxel(root,high-low+Vector3.new(0.15,0.15,0.15),CFrame.new((high+low)/2),0.72) end
                    end
                end
                if cfg.esp_cube_v2 then
                    for _,part in ipairs(rigParts) do
                        local size=part.Size
                        local nx,ny,nz=math.clamp(math.ceil(size.X/0.7),1,4),math.clamp(math.ceil(size.Y/0.7),1,6),math.clamp(math.ceil(size.Z/0.7),1,4)
                        local cell=Vector3.new(size.X/nx,size.Y/ny,size.Z/nz)
                        local edge=math.min(cell.X,cell.Y,cell.Z)*0.88
                        for x=1,nx do for y=1,ny do for z=1,nz do
                            newVoxel(part,Vector3.new(edge,edge,edge),CFrame.new(-size.X/2+(x-0.5)*cell.X,-size.Y/2+(y-0.5)*cell.Y,-size.Z/2+(z-0.5)*cell.Z),0.18)
                        end end end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _,pair in ipairs(voxels) do pair.copy.CFrame=pair.source.CFrame*pair.offset; pair.copy.Color=col end
        end
        local function shown()
            local node=host
            while node do
                if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then return false end
                if node:IsA("ScreenGui") and not node.Enabled then return false end
                node=node.Parent
            end
            return host.Parent~=nil
        end
        local function project(point,w,h)
            local p=bodyCamera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
            if p.Z>=-0.01 then return nil end
            local scale=h/(2*math.tan(math.rad(bodyCamera.FieldOfView/2)))
            return Vector2.new(w/2+p.X*scale/-p.Z,h/2-p.Y*scale/-p.Z)
        end
        local function segment(object,a,b,col)
            local delta=b-a
            object.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            object.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((a.X+b.X)/2,(a.Y+b.Y)/2)
            object.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(delta.Magnitude,1)
            object.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y,delta.X))
            object.BackgroundColor3=col; object.Visible=true
        end
        local function textAt(object,value,x,y,width,col,visible)
            object.Text=value; object.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
            object.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,16); object.TextColor3=col; object.Visible=visible
        end
        local overlays={box,nameText,distanceText,flagText,healthBG,healthBar,snapline}
        -- AbsoluteSize already includes every ancestor UIScale, but Offset values
        -- written to the overlays get scaled again. Work in unscaled units.
        local function guiScale(object)
            local s=1; local node=object
            while node and not node:IsA("LayerCollector") do
                local sc=node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                if sc then s=s*sc.Scale end
                node=node.Parent
            end
            return (s>0.001) and s or 1
        end
        local function drawPreview(dt)
            if not shown() then return end
            for _,object in ipairs(overlays) do object.Visible=false end
            for _,object in ipairs(bones) do object.Visible=false end
            if rebuild or characterSource~=LP.Character then buildPreview() end
            if not model then return end
            local uiS=guiScale(host)
            local w,h=host.AbsoluteSize.X/uiS,host.AbsoluteSize.Y/uiS
            if w<2 or h<2 then return end
            local cfg=api.profiles[api.preview]; local col=api.color(api.preview,cfg)
            -- Negative yaw turns the front of the avatar towards the viewer's right.
            angle=(angle+math.rad(12)*dt)%(2*math.pi)
            model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi-angle,0)*neutralPivot)
            local halfFov=math.tan(math.rad(35/2))
            local d=math.max(height*0.5/halfFov,radius/(halfFov*(w/h)))+radius
            local cameraCF=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,d*1.16),Vector3.zero)
            for _,camera in ipairs({bodyCamera,tintCamera,outlineCamera,cubeCamera}) do camera.CFrame=cameraCF end
            outlineView.Visible=cfg.enabled and cfg.esp_outline
            tintView.Visible=cfg.enabled and (cfg.esp_chams or cfg.esp_fill_chams or cfg.esp_solid_body)
            tintView.ImageTransparency=(cfg.esp_fill_chams or cfg.esp_solid_body) and 0 or 0.5
            cubeView.Visible=cfg.enabled and (cfg.esp_cube_v1 or cfg.esp_cube_v2)
            for _,pair in ipairs(fills) do
                pair.copy.CFrame=pair.source.CFrame; pair.copy.Color=col
                pair.copy.Transparency=(cfg.esp_solid_body and not (cfg.esp_chams or cfg.esp_fill_chams) and not pair.rig) and 1 or 0
            end
            for _,pair in ipairs(outlines) do pair.copy.CFrame=pair.source.CFrame; pair.copy.Color=col end
            if cubeView.Visible then updateCubes(cfg,col) end
            statusText.Text=api.preview..(cfg.enabled and "  |  12 deg/s" or "  |  profile disabled")
            statusText.TextColor3=col
            if not cfg.enabled then return end
            local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end
            local loX,loY,hiX,hiY=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
            -- Same fixed root-relative bounds as the in-world Drawing ESP.
            for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
                local p=project(root.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x*2,y*2.75,z)),w,h)
                if not p then return end
                loX=math.min(loX,p.X); loY=math.min(loY,p.Y); hiX=math.max(hiX,p.X); hiY=math.max(hiY,p.Y)
            end end end
            local bw,bh=hiX-loX,hiY-loY
            box.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(loX,loY); box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(bw,bh)
            boxStroke.Color=col; box.Visible=cfg.esp_box
            textAt(nameText,LP.Name,loX-40,loY-18,bw+80,col,cfg.esp_name)
            textAt(distanceText,"10m",loX,hiY+2,bw,col,cfg.esp_dist)
            textAt(flagText,api.preview,loX-20,hiY+(cfg.esp_dist and 18 or 2),bw+40,col,cfg.esp_flags)
            healthBG.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(loX-6,loY); healthBG.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(3,bh)
            local hum=characterSource and characterSource:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hf=hum and math.clamp(hum.Health/math.max(hum.MaxHealth,1),0,1) or 1
            healthBar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(loX-6,loY+bh*(1-hf)); healthBar.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(3,bh*hf)
            healthBar.BackgroundColor3=col; healthBar.Visible=cfg.esp_health; healthBG.Visible=cfg.esp_health
            if cfg.esp_line then segment(snapline,Vector2.new(w/2,h),Vector2.new((loX+hiX)/2,hiY),col) end
            if cfg.esp_skel then
                local rig=model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and rig15 or rig6
                for i,pair in ipairs(rig) do
                    local a,b=model:FindFirstChild(pair[1]),model:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
                    if a and b then
                        local ap,bp=project(a.Position,w,h),project(b.Position,w,h)
                        if ap and bp then segment(bones[i],ap,bp,col) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() rebuild=true end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,LP.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function() rebuild=true end))
        local previewWarning=0
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            local ok,err=pcall(drawPreview,dt)
            if not ok then
                if os.clock()-previewWarning>5 then previewWarning=os.clock(); warn("[DaDa ESP Preview] "..tostring(err)) end
                statusText.Text="Preview unavailable (see console)"
            end
        end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function() clearPreview(); host:Destroy() end)
        updateSummary()
        local summaryTime=0
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            summaryTime=summaryTime+dt
            if summaryTime>=0.2 then summaryTime=0; updateSummary() end
        end))
    end

    local vArrows=makePanel(4,"right","Arrows")
    vArrows:Toggle("Arrows",false,function(v) ST.arrows=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.arrows end})
    vArrows:Dropdown("Mode",{"Always","Hide On Screen"},"Always",function(v) ST.arrows_mode=v end,{get=function() return ST.arrows_mode end})
    vArrows:Dropdown("Arrow Style",{"normal","big bon","big hun","big hon","White triangle","Black triangle"},"normal",function(v) ST.arrows_style=v end,{get=function() return ST.arrows_style end})
    vArrows:Slider("Distance from Center",160,40,520,function(v) ST.arrows_radius=v end,{get=function() return ST.arrows_radius end})
    vArrows:Slider("Arrow Size",26,12,64,function(v) ST.arrows_size=v end,{get=function() return ST.arrows_size end})

    -- WORLD
    local wA=makePanel(5,"left","Visuals")
    wA:Toggle("Fullbright",false,function(v) ST.fullbright=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.fullbright end, legacy="ST_fullbright"})
    wA:Toggle("FOV Changer",false,function(v) ST.fov_changer=v end,nil,{get=function() return ST.fov_changer end, legacy="ST_fov_changer"})

    -- Extra local-only post-processing visuals
    local localFx = {}
    local function setLocalFx(key, className, enabled, configure)
        local effect = localFx[key]
        if enabled then
            if not effect or not effect.Parent then
                effect = Instance.new(className)
                effect.Name = "DaDa_Local_" .. key
                effect.Parent = Lighting
                localFx[key] = effect
            end
            if configure then pcall(configure, effect) end
            effect.Enabled = true
        elseif effect then
            pcall(function() effect.Enabled = false end)
        end
    end
    wC:Toggle("Color Correction",false,function(v)
        SHF.local_color_correction=v
        setLocalFx("ColorCorrection", "ColorCorrectionEffect", v, function(e)
            e.Brightness=0.02; e.Contrast=0.08; e.Saturation=0.12
            e.TintColor=Color3.fromRGB(235,225,255)
        end)
    end,nil,{get=function() return SHF.local_color_correction end, legacy="SHF_local_color_correction"})

    wD:Dropdown("Aura Type",{"angel","wind","starlight","heavenly","aurora","flame","frost","rose","void","emerald","solar","lunar","ocean","toxic","sakura","plasma","storm","ember","crystal","rainbow","shadow","mint","coral","gold","sapphire","amethyst","pearl","cinder","breeze","comet","stardust","aurum","glacier","dream"},"angel",function(v)

        if SHF.aura2Count then SHF.aura2Count(v) end

        SHF.aura2_color=color
