    -- CROSSHAIR (mouse + touch follow)
    do
        local playerGui=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local oldGui=playerGui:FindFirstChild("DaDaCrosshairOverlay")
        if oldGui then pcall(function() oldGui:Destroy() end) end
        local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name="DaDaCrosshairOverlay"
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
        gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
        gui.DisplayOrder=999999
        gui.Enabled=false
        gui.Parent=playerGui

        local root=Instance.new("Frame")
        root.Name="CrosshairRoot"
        root.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
        root.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
        root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(1,1)
        root.BackgroundTransparency=1
        root.BorderSizePixel=0
        root.Parent=gui

        local bars={}
        local function buildBar(name)
            local outline=Instance.new("Frame")
            outline.Name=name.."Outline"
            outline.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            outline.BorderSizePixel=0
            outline.BackgroundColor3=SHF.crosshair_out_col
            outline.ZIndex=1
            outline.Parent=root
            local inner=Instance.new("Frame")
            inner.Name=name
            inner.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            inner.BorderSizePixel=0
            inner.BackgroundColor3=SHF.crosshair_line_col
            inner.ZIndex=2
            inner.Parent=root
            bars[#bars+1]={outline=outline,inner=inner}
        end
        for i=1,4 do buildBar("Crosshair"..i) end

        local pointer=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local activeTouch=nil
        local function updatePointer(pos)
            if typeof(pos)=="Vector3" then pos=Vector2.new(pos.X,pos.Y) end
            if typeof(pos)=="Vector2" then
                pointer=pos
                root.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X,pos.Y)
            end
        end
        updatePointer(pointer)
        UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
            if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                activeTouch=input
                updatePointer(input.Position)
            elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                updatePointer(UIS:GetMouseLocation())
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                updatePointer(UIS:GetMouseLocation())
            elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and activeTouch then
                updatePointer(input.Position)
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input==activeTouch then activeTouch=nil end
        end)

        local rotation=0
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not gui.Parent then return end
            gui.Enabled=SHF.crosshair==true
            if not SHF.crosshair then return end
            -- Mouse tracking on PC; touch position is updated by InputChanged on mobile.
            if not activeTouch and not UIS.TouchEnabled then
                updatePointer(UIS:GetMouseLocation())
            end
            rotation=(rotation+dt*math.max(0,tonumber(SHF.crosshair_rot) or 0)*36)%360
            local gap=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.crosshair_gap) or 4,0,40)
            local length=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.crosshair_len) or 8,2,60)
            local thickness=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.crosshair_thick) or 2,1,8)
            local r=math.rad(rotation)
            for i,bar in ipairs(bars) do
                local a=r+(i-1)*math.pi/2
                local dx,dy=math.cos(a),math.sin(a)
                local dist=gap+length/2
                local pos=UDim2.fromOffset(dx*dist,dy*dist)
                bar.outline.Position=pos
                bar.outline.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(length,thickness+2)
                bar.outline.Rotation=math.deg(a)
                bar.outline.BackgroundColor3=SHF.crosshair_out_col
                bar.inner.Position=pos
                bar.inner.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(length,thickness)
                bar.inner.Rotation=math.deg(a)
                bar.inner.BackgroundColor3=SHF.crosshair_line_col
            end
        end)
    end

    -- CHINA HAT: Classic mesh and Drawing cone adapted from visuals.txt.
    do
        local classic,classicHead=nil,nil
        local drawings,ring={},{}
        local ringSides,ringRadius=0,0
        local drawingWarning=false
        local function clearClassic()
            if classic then classic:Destroy() end
            classic,classicHead=nil,nil
        end
        local function clearDrawings()
            for _,pair in ipairs(drawings) do
                pcall(function() pair.line:Remove() end)
                pcall(function() pair.triangle:Remove() end)
            end
            table.clear(drawings)
        end
        local function clearHat()
            clearClassic()
            clearDrawings()
        end
        local function hideDrawings()
            for _,pair in ipairs(drawings) do
                pair.line.Visible=false
                pair.triangle.Visible=false
            end
        end
        local function hatColor(index,count)
            if SHF.china_hat_rainbow then
                local period=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.china_hat_rainbow_speed) or 5,1,20)
                return Color3.fromHSV((os.clock()/period-(index or 0)/(count or 1))%1,
                    index and 0.5 or 1,1)
            end
            return SHF.china_hat_col
        end
        local function ensureDrawings(sides)
            if #drawings==sides then return true end
            clearDrawings()
            local ok,err=pcall(function()
                for _=1,sides do
                    -- Register each allocation before the next one can fail.
                    local pair={line=Drawing.new('Line')}
                    drawings[#drawings+1]=pair
                    pair.triangle=Drawing.new('Triangle')
                    pair.line.ZIndex=2
                    pair.line.Thickness=2
                    pair.line.Visible=false
                    pair.triangle.ZIndex=1
                    pair.triangle.Filled=true
                    pair.triangle.Visible=false
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                clearDrawings()
                SHF.china_hat_style='Classic'
                if not drawingWarning then
                    drawingWarning=true
                    warn('[DaDa China Hat] Drawing unavailable; using Classic: '..tostring(err))
                end
            end
            return ok
        end
        local function updateHat()
            if espLifecycle.stopped or not SHF.china_hat then clearHat(); return end
            local char=LP.Character
            local head=char and char:FindFirstChild('Head')
            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if not head or not head:IsA('BasePart') or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then clearHat(); return end
            local info=SHF.morphEffectTarget
            local morph=info and info.char==char and info.model and info.model.Parent
            local center,hatFrame,owner
            if morph then
                local box=info.model:GetPivot()*info.boxOffset
                local half=info.size*0.5
                -- World-space top even if the imported model's box is tilted.
                local top=math.abs(box.RightVector.Y)*half.X
                    +math.abs(box.UpVector.Y)*half.Y+math.abs(box.LookVector.Y)*half.Z
                center=box.Position+Vector3.new(0,top+0.25,0)
                hatFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,0.35,0))
                owner=info.model
            else
                center=head.Position+Vector3.new(0,head.Size.Y*0.5+0.25,0)
                hatFrame=head.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.1,0)
                owner=head
            end
            local radius=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.china_hat_radius) or 2.4,0.5,10)
            local height=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.china_hat_height) or 1.6,0.5,5)
            local transparency=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.china_hat_transparency) or 0.3,0,1)
            if SHF.china_hat_style~='Drawing' then
                if #drawings>0 then clearDrawings() end
                if not classic or not classic.Parent or classicHead~=owner then
                    clearClassic()
                    classic=Instance.new('Part')
                    classic.Name='DaDaChineseHat'
                    classic.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1)
                    classic.Anchored=true
                    classic.CanCollide=false
                    classic.CanTouch=false
                    classic.CanQuery=false
                    classic.Massless=true
                    classic.CastShadow=false
                    classic.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
                    classic.CFrame=hatFrame
                    local mesh=Instance.new('SpecialMesh')
                    mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
                    mesh.MeshId='rbxassetid://1033714'
                    mesh.Parent=classic
                    classic.Parent=workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace
                    classicHead=owner
                end
                classic.Anchored=true
                classic.CanCollide=false;classic.CanTouch=false;classic.CanQuery=false
                classic.CFrame=hatFrame
                classic.Color=hatColor()
                classic.Transparency=transparency
                classic.Reflectance=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.china_hat_reflectance) or 0,0,1)
                classic:FindFirstChildOfClass('SpecialMesh').Scale=Vector3.new(radius,height,radius)
                return
            end
            clearClassic()
            local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not camera or (camera.CFrame.Position-camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude<=1 then
                hideDrawings(); return
            end
            local sides=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(SHF.china_hat_sides) or 25),3,300)
            if not ensureDrawings(sides) then return end
            if sides~=ringSides or radius~=ringRadius then
                table.clear(ring)
                for i=1,sides do
                    local angle=(i-1)/sides*math.pi*2
                    ring[i]=Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,0,math.sin(angle)*radius)
                end
                ringSides,ringRadius=sides,radius
            end
            -- The source cone is 0.75 high at the default 1.6 setting.
            local top=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(center+Vector3.new(0,height*(0.75/1.6),0))
            for i,pair in ipairs(drawings) do
                local a=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(center+ring[i])
                local b=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(center+ring[i%sides+1])
                local visible=top.Z>0 and a.Z>0 and b.Z>0
                pair.line.Visible=visible
                pair.triangle.Visible=visible
                if visible then
                    local color=hatColor(i,sides)
                    pair.line.From=Vector2.new(a.X,a.Y)
                    pair.line.To=Vector2.new(b.X,b.Y)
                    pair.line.Color=color
                    pair.line.Transparency=1-transparency
                    pair.triangle.PointA=Vector2.new(top.X,top.Y)
                    pair.triangle.PointB=pair.line.From
                    pair.triangle.PointC=pair.line.To
                    pair.triangle.Color=color
                    pair.triangle.Transparency=(1-transparency)*0.5
                end
            end
        end
        SHF.updateChinaHat=updateHat
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateHat))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,LP.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clearHat))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
            SHF.china_hat=false
            clearHat()
            SHF.updateChinaHat=nil
        end)
    end

    -- AURA TRAIL: the limb-to-root ribbon effect from visuals.txt, not a particle aura.
    do
        local character,root=nil,nil
        local entries={}
        local elapsed=0
        local function removeEntry(part)
            local entry=entries[part]
            if not entry then return end
            entries[part]=nil
            for _,object in ipairs(entry) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
        end
        local function clearTrail()
            local parts={}
            for part in pairs(entries) do parts[#parts+1]=part end
            for _,part in ipairs(parts) do removeEntry(part) end
            character,root=nil,nil
        end
        local function updateTrail()
            if espLifecycle.stopped or not SHF.aura_trail then clearTrail(); return end
            local char=LP.Character
            local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if not char or not hrp or not hrp:IsA('BasePart') or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then
                clearTrail(); return
            end
            if character~=char or root~=hrp then clearTrail(); character,root=char,hrp end
            local stale={}
            for part,entry in pairs(entries) do
                if part.Parent~=char or entry[1].Parent~=part
                    or entry[2].Parent~=part or entry[3].Parent~=hrp then stale[#stale+1]=part end
            end
            for _,part in ipairs(stale) do removeEntry(part) end
            local color=ColorSequence.new(SHF.aura_trail_col)
            local lifetime=math.clamp(tonumber(SHF.aura_trail_lifetime) or 0.5,0.1,3)
            for _,part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                -- Direct rig parts only: never tools, hats, accessories or skin overlays.
                if part:IsA('BasePart') and part~=hrp and part.Name~='DaDaChineseHat' then
                    local entry=entries[part]
                    if not entry then
                        local p1=Instance.new('Attachment')
                        p1.Name='DaDaAuraPointer1'
                        p1.Parent=part
                        local p2=Instance.new('Attachment')
                        p2.Name='DaDaAuraPointer2'
                        p2.Parent=hrp
                        local trail=Instance.new('Trail')
                        trail.Name='DaDaAuraTrailer'
                        trail.Enabled=false
                        trail.Texture='rbxassetid://1390780157'
                        trail.Attachment0=p1
                        trail.Attachment1=p2
                        trail.Parent=part
                        entry={trail,p1,p2}
                        entries[part]=entry
                    end
                    entry[1].Color=color
                    entry[1].Lifetime=lifetime
                    entry[1].Enabled=true
                end
            end
        end
        SHF.updateAuraTrail=updateTrail
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            elapsed=elapsed+dt
            if elapsed<0.15 then return end
            elapsed=0
            updateTrail()
        end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,LP.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clearTrail))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
            SHF.aura_trail=false
            clearTrail()
            SHF.updateAuraTrail=nil
        end)
    end

    -- CHAMS: one cache for both features, with tools excluded from body chams.
    do
        local originals={}
        local function restorePart(part,record)
            pcall(function() part.Material=record.material; part.Color=record.color end)
        end
        local function clearChams()
            for part,record in pairs(originals) do restorePart(part,record) end
            table.clear(originals)
        end
        local function isToolPart(part,char)
            local ancestor=part.Parent
            while ancestor and ancestor~=char do
                if ancestor:IsA("Tool") then return true end
                ancestor=ancestor.Parent
            end
            return false
        end
        local function chamsStep()
            if espLifecycle.stopped then clearChams(); return end
            local char=LP.Character
            local selected={}
            if char and (SHF.self_chams or SHF.tool_chams) then
                for _,part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" then
                        local tool=isToolPart(part,char)
                        local weapon=tool and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
                        local tinted=weapon and ((weapon.Name=="Gun" and SHF.gun_skin=="Custom")
                            or (weapon.Name=="Knife" and SHF.knife_skin=="Custom"))
                        local enabled=(tool and SHF.tool_chams or (not tool and SHF.self_chams)) and not tinted
                        if enabled then
                            selected[part]=true
                            if not originals[part] then originals[part]={material=part.Material,color=part.Color} end
                            part.Material=Enum.Material.ForceField
                            if tool then part.Color=SHF.tool_chams_col else part.Color=SHF.self_chams_col end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for part,record in pairs(originals) do
                if not selected[part] then restorePart(part,record); originals[part]=nil end
            end
        end
        -- perf: chams rescan 10x per second instead of every physics step
        local chamsAcc=0
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_,dt) chamsAcc=chamsAcc+(dt or 0); if chamsAcc<0.1 then return end; chamsAcc=0; chamsStep() end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,LP.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clearChams))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,clearChams)
    end

    -- Jump circle: grounded detection, expanding rotating decal and sparkles.
    do
        local charConnections={}
        local effects={}
        local generation=0
        local function disconnectCharacter()
            for _,c in ipairs(charConnections) do c:Disconnect() end
            table.clear(charConnections)
        end
        local function clearEffects()
            generation+=1
            for object in pairs(effects) do
                if typeof(object)=="RBXScriptConnection" then object:Disconnect() else object:Destroy() end
                effects[object]=nil
            end
        end
        local function effect(char,hum,root)
            local p=RaycastParams.new(); p.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; p.FilterDescendantsInstances={char}
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-10,0),p)
            local pos=hit and hit.Position or root.Position-Vector3.new(0,hum.HipHeight+root.Size.Y/2,0)
            local part=Instance.new("Part"); part.Name="DaDaJumpCircle"; part.Anchored=true; part.CanCollide=false; part.CanQuery=false; part.CanTouch=false; part.CastShadow=false; part.Transparency=1; part.Size=Vector3.new(1,0.05,1); part.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(0,0.15,0)); part.Parent=workspace; effects[part]=true
            local surface=Instance.new("SurfaceGui"); surface.Adornee=part; surface.Face=Enum.NormalId.Top; surface.SizingMode=Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize; surface.CanvasSize=Vector2.new(512,512); surface.LightInfluence=0; surface.Parent=part
            local img=Instance.new("ImageLabel"); img.BackgroundTransparency=1; img.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); img.Image="rbxassetid://112464610719689"; img.ImageColor3=SHF.landing_circle_col; img.ImageTransparency=0.15; img.Parent=surface
            local host=Instance.new("Part"); host.Name="DaDaJumpSparkles"; host.Size=Vector3.one; host.Anchored=true; host.Transparency=1; host.CanCollide=false; host.CanQuery=false; host.CanTouch=false; host.Parent=workspace; effects[host]=true
            local att=Instance.new("Attachment",host)
            local pe=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter"); pe.Texture="rbxassetid://133470232232371"; pe.Rate=0; pe.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(1.8,2.8); pe.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top; pe.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(15,15); pe.Speed=NumberRange.new(2,5); pe.Drag=1.5; pe.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360); pe.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-60,60); pe.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.06),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2,0.3),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.15)}); pe.LightEmission=1; pe.LightInfluence=0; pe.LockedToPart=false; pe.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1,0.1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,0.3),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}); pe.Parent=att
            local gen=generation
            task.spawn(function()
                for _=1,14 do
                    if gen~=generation or not host.Parent then return end
                    local angle=math.random()*math.pi*2; local r=3*math.sqrt(math.random())
                    att.WorldPosition=pos+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*r,0.4+math.random()*1.2,math.sin(angle)*r)
                    pe:Emit(1); task.wait(0.02)
                end
            end)
            task.delay(3.2,function() if host.Parent then host:Destroy() end; effects[host]=nil end)
            local elapsed=0; local conn
            conn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                if not part.Parent or gen~=generation then conn:Disconnect(); effects[conn]=nil; return end
                elapsed+=dt; local a=math.clamp(elapsed/1.8,0,1)
                local size=1+8*(1-(1-a)^3)
                part.Size=Vector3.new(size,0.05,size)
                part.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos+Vector3.new(0,0.15,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(270*a),0)
                img.ImageTransparency=0.15+0.85*math.clamp((a-0.35)/0.65,0,1)
                if a>=1 then conn:Disconnect(); effects[conn]=nil; part:Destroy(); effects[part]=nil end
            end)
            effects[conn]=true
        end
        local function bindCharacter(char)
            disconnectCharacter()
            if not SHF.landing_circle or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
            local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
            if not hum or not root or not SHF.landing_circle or char~=LP.Character then return end
            local jumped,airStart=false,nil
            charConnections[#charConnections+1]=hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,new)
                if new==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then jumped=true end
            end)
            charConnections[#charConnections+1]=UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function() jumped=true end)
            charConnections[#charConnections+1]=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not char.Parent or not SHF.landing_circle then return end
                if hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then
                    if not airStart then airStart=os.clock() end
                elseif airStart then
                    local duration=os.clock()-airStart; airStart=nil
                    if duration>=0.15 and jumped then effect(char,hum,root) end
                    jumped=false
                end
            end)
        end
        SHF.lc_bind=function()
            disconnectCharacter()
            if SHF.landing_circle and LP.Character then task.spawn(bindCharacter,LP.Character) else clearEffects() end
        end
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) if SHF.landing_circle then task.spawn(bindCharacter,char) end end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function() disconnectCharacter(); clearEffects(); SHF.lc_bind=nil end)
    end

    -- GUN ESP: remove drawings as soon as the drop leaves Workspace.
    do
        local guns={}
        local function removeGun(object)
            local entry=guns[object]; guns[object]=nil
            if not entry then return end
            if entry.hl then pcall(function() entry.hl:Destroy() end) end
            if entry.txt then
                pcall(function() entry.txt.Visible=false end)
                pcall(function() entry.txt:Remove() end)
            end
        end
        local function clearGuns()
            for object in pairs(guns) do removeGun(object) end
        end
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups, clearGuns)
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections, workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
            if guns[object] then removeGun(object) end
        end))
        local function gunStep()
            for object,entry in pairs(guns) do
                if entry.txt then entry.txt.Visible=false end
                if entry.hl then entry.hl.Enabled=false end
                if not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or object.Name~="GunDrop" then removeGun(object) end
            end
            if espLifecycle.stopped or not (SHF.gun_esp or SHF.gun_esp_hl or SHF.gun_esp_text) then
                clearGuns(); return
            end
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if object.Name=="GunDrop" and object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local entry=guns[object]
                    if not entry then entry={}; guns[object]=entry end
                    if SHF.gun_esp_hl then
                        if not entry.hl then
                            local hl=Instance.new("Highlight"); entry.hl=hl
                            hl.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                            hl.FillTransparency=1; hl.OutlineTransparency=0
                            hl.Adornee=object; hl.Parent=CoreGui
                        end
                        entry.hl.OutlineColor=SHF.gun_esp_hl_col; entry.hl.Enabled=true
                    elseif entry.hl then
                        entry.hl:Destroy(); entry.hl=nil
                    end
                    if SHF.gun_esp_text then
                        if not entry.txt then
                            local text=Drawing.new("Text"); entry.txt=text
                            text.Visible=false; text.Center=true; text.Outline=true; text.Size=13
                        end
                        local point,onScreen=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(object.Position)
                        if onScreen and point.Z>0 then
                            entry.txt.Position=Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
                            entry.txt.Text="Gun"; entry.txt.Color=SHF.gun_esp_text_col
                            entry.txt.Visible=true
                        end
                    elseif entry.txt then
                        entry.txt:Remove(); entry.txt=nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local lastWarning=0
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            local ok,err=pcall(gunStep)
            if not ok then
                clearGuns()
                if os.clock()-lastWarning>5 then
                    lastWarning=os.clock(); warn("[DaDa Gun ESP] "..tostring(err))
                end
            end
        end))
    end

    -- FAKE POSITION
    do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local char=LP.Character
            local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            if SHF.fake_pos then
                local rx=SHF.fake_pos_range_x*1e9
                local ry=SHF.fake_pos_range_y*1e9
                local rz=SHF.fake_pos_range_z*1e9
                local old=hrp.CFrame
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.CFrame=CFrame.new(
                        (math.random()*2-1)*rx,
                        -(math.random())*ry,
                        (math.random()*2-1)*rz
                    )
                end)
                task.wait()
                pcall(function() hrp.CFrame=old end)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- MOVEMENT GRAPH
    do
        local lines={}; local shadows={}; local history={}; local accum=0
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not SHF.mov_graph then
                for i=1,#lines do lines[i].Visible=false shadows[i].Visible=false end
                return
            end
            local char=LP.Character
            local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            local vel=hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local sp=math.sqrt(vel.X*vel.X+vel.Z*vel.Z)
            accum=accum+dt
            if accum>=0.05 then
                accum=0
                table.insert(history,{t=os.clock(),v=sp})
                if #history>60 then table.remove(history,1) end
            end
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vp=cam.ViewportSize
            local w=280; local h=72; local cx=vp.X/2; local cy=vp.Y/2+180
            while #lines<#history do
                local l=Drawing.new("Line")
                l.Thickness=1
                l.Color=SHF.mov_graph_col
                l.Visible=false
                table.insert(lines,l)
                local s=Drawing.new("Line")
                s.Thickness=3
                s.Color=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                s.Visible=false
                table.insert(shadows,s)
            end
            for i=1,#history-1 do
                local a=history[i]
                local b=history[i+1]
                local ax=cx-w/2+(i/#history)*w
                local bx=cx-w/2+((i+1)/#history)*w
                local ay=cy-math.clamp(a.v/50,-1,1)*h/2
                local by=cy-math.clamp(b.v/50,-1,1)*h/2
                lines[i].From=Vector2.new(ax,ay)
                lines[i].To=Vector2.new(bx,by)
                lines[i].Visible=true
                shadows[i].From=Vector2.new(ax,ay)
                shadows[i].To=Vector2.new(bx,by)
                shadows[i].Visible=true
            end
        end)
    end

    -- AUTO MAP VOTE / VOTE DUPER: exact VotePad1/2/3 scanning + respawn loop
    do
        local workerId = 0
        local wasEnabled = false
        local loadingPause = false
        local namesBeforeLoading = nil
        local loadingConn = nil
        local lastChosenMap = nil

        local function normalizeMapName(value)
            value = tostring(value or "")
            value = value:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            value = value:gsub("%s+", " ")
            return string.lower(value)
        end

        local function getLobby()
            -- Current game update: workspace.Lobby.VotePads.VotePad1...
            local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
            if lobby then return lobby end
            -- Compatibility fallback for older versions of the map hierarchy.
            return workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
                or workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby", true)
        end

        local function getPadMapName(pad)
            if not pad then return nil end
            local gui = pad:FindFirstChild("VoteInfoGui", true)
            local container = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Container", true)
            local label = container and container:FindFirstChild("MapName", true)
            if label and (label:IsA("TextLabel") or label:IsA("TextButton") or label:IsA("TextBox")) then
                local value = tostring(label.Text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if value ~= "" and normalizeMapName(value) ~= "map name" then return value end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function getPadPart(pad)
            if not pad then return nil end
            local namedPad = pad:FindFirstChild("Pad", true)
            if namedPad and namedPad:IsA("BasePart") then return namedPad end
            if pad:IsA("BasePart") then return pad end
            if pad:IsA("Model") and pad.PrimaryPart then return pad.PrimaryPart end
            return pad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end

        local function scanVotePads()
            local lobby = getLobby()
            local result = {}
            if not lobby then return result end

            -- Updated hierarchy: workspace.Lobby.VotePads.VotePad1/2/3
            local padsRoot = lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
                or lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads", true)
            local searchRoot = padsRoot or lobby
            for i = 1, 3 do
                local pad = searchRoot:FindFirstChild("VotePad" .. i)
                if not pad then pad = searchRoot:FindFirstChild("VotePad" .. i, true) end
                if pad then
                    result[#result + 1] = {
                        instance = pad,
                        name = getPadMapName(pad),
                        part = getPadPart(pad),
                        slot = i,
                    }
                end
            end
            return result
        end

        local function currentNamesSignature()
            local pads = scanVotePads()
            local names = {}
            for i = 1, 3 do
                local found = ""
                for _, item in ipairs(pads) do
                    if item.slot == i then found = item.name or "" break end
                end
                names[i] = found
            end
            return names
        end

        local function anyNameChanged(before, now)
            -- Resume as soon as at least one of the three pad labels changes.
            -- The other two labels are allowed to keep the same map name.
            if not before or not now then return false end
            for i = 1, 3 do
                local oldName = normalizeMapName(before[i])
                local newName = normalizeMapName(now[i])
                if newName ~= "" and newName ~= "map name" and oldName ~= "" and oldName ~= "map name" and newName ~= oldName then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function selectedMapName()
            local chosen = getgenv().DaDa_SelectedMapName
                or getgenv().DaDa_MapPriority
                or lastChosenMap
            if chosen and tostring(chosen) ~= "" then
                lastChosenMap = tostring(chosen)
                return lastChosenMap
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function findSelectedPad()
            local chosen = selectedMapName()
            if not chosen then return nil end
            local wanted = normalizeMapName(chosen)
            for _, item in ipairs(scanVotePads()) do
                if item.name and item.part and normalizeMapName(item.name) == wanted then
                    return item
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function isEnabled()
            return SHF.mapvote or SHF.mapvote_dupe
        end

        local function getCharacterParts(id)
            local start = os.clock()
            repeat
                if workerId ~= id or not isEnabled() or loadingPause then return nil end
                local character = LP.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if humanoid and hrp and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    return character, humanoid, hrp
                end
                task.wait(0.04)
            until os.clock() - start > 6
            return nil
        end

        local function runCycle(id)
            while workerId == id and isEnabled() do
                if loadingPause then
                    -- Resume once ANY one of the three MapName labels changes.
                    -- The remaining pads may still show the same map names.
                    local now = currentNamesSignature()
                    if anyNameChanged(namesBeforeLoading, now) then
                        loadingPause = false
                        namesBeforeLoading = nil
                        if notify then pcall(function() notify("Vote Duper", "Vote pads refreshed; resuming " .. tostring(selectedMapName() or "selected map")) end) end
                    else
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        continue
                    end
                end

                local chosen = selectedMapName()
                local target = findSelectedPad()
                if not target then
                    -- Selected map is not one of the current three choices: wait for the next refresh.
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    continue
                end

                local character, humanoid, hrp = getCharacterParts(id)
                if not character or not humanoid or not hrp then
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    continue
                end

                -- Match the requested reference behavior: go to the pad matching its MapName,
                -- allow the game to register the vote, then reset and repeat.
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.CFrame = target.part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
                task.wait(0.12)

                if workerId ~= id or not isEnabled() or loadingPause then continue end
                -- Re-check the selection so tapping another map immediately redirects the loop.
                if normalizeMapName(selectedMapName()) ~= normalizeMapName(chosen) then continue end
                pcall(function() humanoid.Health = 0 end)
                local respawnStart = os.clock()
                repeat
                    if workerId ~= id or not isEnabled() or loadingPause then break end
                    local c = LP.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h and r and h.Health > 0 then break end
                    task.wait(0.04)
                until os.clock() - respawnStart > 6
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end

        local function startWorker()
            workerId += 1
            local id = workerId
            task.spawn(function() runCycle(id) end)
        end

        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local on = isEnabled()
            if on and not wasEnabled then
                startWorker()
            elseif not on and wasEnabled then
                workerId += 1
            end
            wasEnabled = on
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
            local loadingMap = gameplay and (gameplay:FindFirstChild("LoadingMap") or gameplay:FindFirstChild("LoadingMAP"))
            if loadingMap and (loadingMap:IsA("RemoteEvent") or loadingMap:IsA("BindableEvent")) then
                local signal = loadingMap:IsA("RemoteEvent") and loadingMap.OnClientEvent or loadingMap.Event
                loadingConn = signal:Connect(function()
                    -- Snapshot labels when LoadingMap fires; pause until at least one label changes.
                    namesBeforeLoading = currentNamesSignature()
                    loadingPause = true
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- NEW FUNCTIONS (menu-side only; existing features untouched)
    -- ============================================================
    do -- Native V5 interface settings; legacy control IDs remain valid.
        local savedTheme=getgenv().DADA_MENU_THEME=="Halloween" and "Halloween" or "Dark"
        local fpsVisible=true
        local menuScale,menuOpacity=0,100
        menuWindow:SetMenuTheme(savedTheme)
        local pI=makePanel(7,"left","Interface")
        pI:Dropdown("Menu Theme",{"Dark","Halloween"},savedTheme,function(value)
            menuWindow:SetMenuTheme(value)
            pal.blue=menuLibrary:GetAccent()
            getgenv().DADA_MENU_THEME=value
        end,{get=function() return menuWindow.ThemeName end})
        pI:Toggle("Show FPS",true,function(value)
            fpsVisible=value; menuWindow.FPSLabel.Visible=value
        end,nil,{get=function() return fpsVisible end})
        pI:Slider("Menu Scale",0,-100,100,function(value)
            menuScale=value
            local factor=1+value/200
            Win:SetScale(initialNeverloseScale*factor)
        end,{get=function() return menuScale end})
        pI:Slider("Menu Opacity",100,60,100,function(value)
            menuOpacity=value
            local target=getgenv().DaDa_NL_Window
            if target then target:SetMenuOpacity(value) else win.BackgroundTransparency=1-value/100 end
        end,{get=function() return menuOpacity end})
        local close=pI:Button("Hide Menu",function() menuWindow:SetVisible(false) end)
        pI:Label("RightShift / Insert: menu | End: unload")
        pI:ColorPicker("Menu Color",menuLibrary:GetAccent(),function(color)
            menuLibrary:SetAccent(color); pal.blue=color
        end,{id="custom/menu-accent",get=function() return menuLibrary:GetAccent() end})
    end

    do -- Config manager rendered entirely with native V5 controls.
        local CFG_DIR="DaDa_configs/"
        local INDEX_PATH=CFG_DIR.."_index.json"
        local function cfgApi() return getgenv().DaDa_Config end
        local function safeName(name)
            name=tostring(name or "")
            name=name:gsub("[^%w_%- ]",""):gsub("%s+","_")
            name=name:sub(1,40)
            return name
        end
        local function canFiles()
            return type(isfile)=="function" and type(writefile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function"
        end
        local function filesReady()
            if not canFiles() then return false end
            if type(isfolder)=="function" then
                local ok,exists=pcall(isfolder,CFG_DIR)
                if ok and exists then return true end
                if type(makefolder)=="function" then
                    local made=pcall(makefolder,CFG_DIR)
                    local check,now=pcall(isfolder,CFG_DIR)
                    return made and check and now==true
                end
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        local function readIndex()
            local out={}
            if not canFiles() then return out end
            local ok,exists=pcall(isfile,INDEX_PATH)
            if not ok or not exists then return out end
            local rok,raw=pcall(readfile,INDEX_PATH)
            if not rok or type(raw)~="string" then return out end
            local dok,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
            if dok and type(data)=="table" then
                for _,n in ipairs(data) do
                    if type(n)=="string" and n~="" then out[#out+1]=n end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        local function writeIndex(list)
            if not canFiles() then return end
            pcall(function() writefile(INDEX_PATH,HttpService:JSONEncode(list)) end)
        end
        local function indexAdd(name)
            local list=readIndex()
            for _,n in ipairs(list) do if n==name then return end end
            list[#list+1]=name
            writeIndex(list)
        end
        local function indexRemove(name)
            local list,out=readIndex(),{}
            for _,n in ipairs(list) do if n~=name then out[#out+1]=n end end
            writeIndex(out)
        end
        local function fileExists(name)
            if type(isfile)~="function" then return true end
            local ok,res=pcall(isfile,CFG_DIR..name..".json")
            return ok and res==true
        end
        local function listNames()
            local api=cfgApi()
            local seen,out={},{}
            local function add(n)
                if type(n)=="string" and n~="" and n:sub(1,1)~="_" and not seen[n] then
                    seen[n]=true; out[#out+1]=n
                end
            end
            if api and api.list then
                local ok,l=pcall(api.list)
                if ok and type(l)=="table" then for _,n in ipairs(l) do add(n) end end
            end
            for _,n in ipairs(readIndex()) do
                if fileExists(n) then add(n) end
            end
            table.sort(out,function(a,b) return a:lower()<b:lower() end)
            return out
        end


        local panel=makePanel(7,"right","Saved Configs")
        local input=panel:Textbox({Name="Name",Default="",Placeholder="new config name",Flag="v5/config-name"})
        local names=listNames()
        local dropdown=panel.section:AddDropdown({Name="Saved",Options=#names>0 and names or {"No configs"},Flag="v5/config-selected"})
        local status=panel:Label("DaDa_configs/ · JSON")
        local function setStatus(message,good)
            status:Set(message)
            status.Label.TextColor3=good==false and pal.danger or good==true and pal.success or pal.muted
        end
        local function refresh(preferred)
            names=listNames()
            local current=preferred or dropdown:Get()
            dropdown:SetOptions(#names>0 and names or {"No configs"})
            local selected=names[1] or "No configs"
            for _,name in ipairs(names) do if name==current then selected=name; break end end
            dropdown:Set(selected,true)
        end
        local function apiReady()
            local api=cfgApi()
            if not api then setStatus("Config system is not ready",false) end
            return api
        end
        local function selection(allowTyped)
            local typed=safeName(input:Get()):gsub("^_+", "")
            if allowTyped and typed~="" then return typed end
            local selected=dropdown:Get()
            for _,name in ipairs(names) do if name==selected then return name end end
            if typed~="" then return typed end
            setStatus("Enter a name or choose a config",false)
        end
        panel:Button("Create / Save Config",function()
            if not filesReady() then setStatus("File access unavailable",false); return end
            local api=apiReady(); local name=selection(true)
            if not api or not name then return end
            local ok,result=pcall(api.save,name)
            if ok and result then indexAdd(name); refresh(name); input:Set("",true); setStatus("Saved: "..name,true)
            else setStatus("Save failed: "..name,false) end
        end)
        panel:Button("Load Selected",function()
            local api=apiReady(); local name=selection(false)
            if not api or not name then return end
            local ok,result=pcall(api.load,name)
            setStatus((ok and result and "Loaded: " or "Load failed: ")..name,ok and result==true)
        end)
        local armedName,armedUntil=nil,0
        local deleteButton
        deleteButton=panel:Button("Delete Selected",function()
            local name=selection(false); if not name then return end
            if armedName~=name or os.clock()>armedUntil then
                armedName=name; armedUntil=os.clock()+2.5
                deleteButton:Set("Confirm Delete")
                setStatus("Press again to delete: "..name)
                task.delay(2.5,function()
                    if not espLifecycle.stopped and deleteButton.Button.Parent and os.clock()>=armedUntil then
                        armedName=nil; deleteButton:Set("Delete Selected")
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            armedName=nil; deleteButton:Set("Delete Selected")
            local api=apiReady(); if not api then return end
            local ok,result=pcall(api.delete,name)
            if ok and result then indexRemove(name); refresh(); setStatus("Deleted: "..name,true)
            else setStatus("Delete failed: "..name,false) end
        end)
        panel:Button("Refresh Config List",function() refresh(); setStatus("List refreshed") end)
        panel:Button("Load Last Config",function()
            local api=apiReady(); if not api then return end
            local ok,name=pcall(api.last)
            if not ok or not name then setStatus("No last config",false); return end
            local loaded,result=pcall(api.load,name)
            refresh(name); setStatus((loaded and result and "Loaded: " or "Load failed: ")..name,loaded and result==true)
        end)
        panel:Button("Reset Settings",function()
            local api=apiReady(); if not api then return end
            local ok,result=pcall(api.reset)
            setStatus(ok and result and "Settings reset" or "Reset failed",ok and result==true)
        end)
        task.delay(4,function()
            if not espLifecycle.stopped and panel.body.Parent then refresh() end
        end)
    end

    do -- Server: rejoin / hop / copy ids
        local pS=makePanel(7,"right","Server")
        if pS then
            local TeleportService=game:GetService("TeleportService")
            local HttpSvc=game:GetService("HttpService")
            local function say(title,msg)
                if notify then pcall(function() notify(title,msg) end) end
            end
            pS:Button("Rejoin Server",function()
                local ok=pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId,game.JobId,LP) end)
                if not ok then pcall(function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId,LP) end) end
            end)
            pS:Button("Server Hop",function()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok,err=pcall(function()
                        local url="https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"..game.PlaceId.."/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
                        local data=HttpSvc:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url))
                        local pick
                        for _,sv in ipairs(data.data or {}) do
                            if sv.id~=game.JobId and sv.playing and sv.maxPlayers and sv.playing<sv.maxPlayers-1 then
                                if not pick or sv.playing<pick.playing then pick=sv end
                            end
                        end
                        if not pick then say("Server Hop","No free server found"); return end
                        say("Server Hop","Teleporting...")
                        TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId,pick.id,LP)
                    end)
                    if not ok then say("Server Hop","Failed to get server list") end
                end)
            end)
            pS:Button("Copy Job ID",function()
                local sc=setclipboard or toclipboard
                if sc then pcall(sc,tostring(game.JobId)); say("Server","Job ID copied") else say("Server","Clipboard not supported") end
            end)
            pS:Button("Copy Place ID",function()
                local sc=setclipboard or toclipboard
                if sc then pcall(sc,tostring(game.PlaceId)); say("Server","Place ID copied") else say("Server","Clipboard not supported") end
            end)
        end
    end

    do -- User-provided World particle effects, independently switchable.
        local panel=makePanel(5,"left","Particles")
        local stops={}
        local function stop(name)
            local f=stops[name]; stops[name]=nil
            if f then pcall(f) end
        end
        local function startRain()
local alive=true
local hosts={}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

local DROP_TEXTURE = "rbxassetid://73414622520224"
local RIPPLE_TEXTURE = "rbxassetid://82817773252063"

local RAIN_RATE = 40          -- капель в секунду
local RAIN_RADIUS = 40        -- радиус дождя вокруг игрока (студы)
local FALL_HEIGHT = 35        -- с какой высоты падает капля
local DROP_SPEED = 90         -- скорость падения (студы/сек)
local DROP_SIZE = 1.5         -- размер капли
local RIPPLE_LIFETIME = 1.2   -- сколько живёт круг (сек)
local RIPPLE_MAX_SIZE = 3     -- итоговый размер круга

local FALL_TIME = FALL_HEIGHT / DROP_SPEED

local function makeHost()
	local host = Instance.new("Part")
	host.Name = "RainFxHost"
	host.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	host.Transparency = 1
	host.Anchored = true
	host.CanCollide = false
	host.CanQuery = false
	host.CanTouch = false
	host.Parent = workspace
    hosts[#hosts+1]=host

	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Parent = host
	return att
end

-- Капли
local dropAtt = makeHost()
local dropPE = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
dropPE.Texture = DROP_TEXTURE
dropPE.Rate = 0
dropPE.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(FALL_TIME)
dropPE.Speed = NumberRange.new(DROP_SPEED)
dropPE.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
dropPE.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
dropPE.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCameraWorldUp
dropPE.Size = NumberSequence.new(DROP_SIZE)
dropPE.LightEmission = 0.3
dropPE.LightInfluence = 0
dropPE.LockedToPart = false
dropPE.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.9, 0.3),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
dropPE.Parent = dropAtt

-- Круги на земле
local rippleAtt = makeHost()
local ripplePE = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
ripplePE.Texture = RIPPLE_TEXTURE
ripplePE.Rate = 0
ripplePE.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(RIPPLE_LIFETIME)
ripplePE.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.05)
ripplePE.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
ripplePE.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
ripplePE.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular -- лежит плоско на земле
ripplePE.LightEmission = 0.3
ripplePE.LightInfluence = 0
ripplePE.LockedToPart = false
-- маленький -> быстро растёт -> дальше растёт медленно
ripplePE.Size = NumberSequence.new({
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, RIPPLE_MAX_SIZE * 0.8),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, RIPPLE_MAX_SIZE),
})
-- медленно пропадает
ripplePE.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 0.35),
	NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
ripplePE.Parent = rippleAtt

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function spawnDrop(center)
	local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local r = RAIN_RADIUS * math.sqrt(math.random())
	local origin = Vector3.new(
		center.X + math.cos(angle) * r,
		center.Y + 50,
		center.Z + math.sin(angle) * r
	)

	-- ищем землю под этой точкой
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), params)
	if not result then return end

	local ground = result.Position
	local ripplePos = ground + result.Normal * 0.1

	dropAtt.WorldPosition = ground + Vector3.new(0, FALL_HEIGHT, 0)
	dropPE:Emit(1)

	task.delay(FALL_TIME, function()
        if not alive or not rippleAtt.Parent then return end
		rippleAtt.WorldPosition = ripplePos
		ripplePE:Emit(1)
	end)
end

local acc = 0
local connection=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = lp.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }

	acc = math.min(acc + RAIN_RATE * dt, 20)
	while acc >= 1 do
		acc -= 1
		spawnDrop(hrp.Position)
	end
end)
return function() alive=false; connection:Disconnect(); for _,host in ipairs(hosts) do host:Destroy() end end
        end
        local function startCircles(texture, color)
local alive=true
local hosts={}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

local TEXTURES = type(texture)=="table" and texture or {texture}

local P_RATE = 10                          -- частиц в секунду
local P_LIFETIME = NumberRange.new(4, 7)   -- сколько живут (сек)
local P_SIZE = 0.6                         -- размер частицы
local MIN_DIST = 6                         -- минимум от игрока (студы)
local MAX_DIST = 60                        -- максимум от игрока
local MIN_HEIGHT = -5                      -- ниже уровня игрока
local MAX_HEIGHT = 10                      -- выше уровня игрока

local function startEffect(texture)
	-- Невидимая точка, из которой выпускаем частицы
	local host = Instance.new("Part")
	host.Name = "FxHost"
	host.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	host.Transparency = 1
	host.Anchored = true
	host.CanCollide = false
	host.CanQuery = false
	host.CanTouch = false
	host.Parent = workspace
    hosts[#hosts+1]=host

	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Parent = host

	local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	pe.Texture = texture
    pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	pe.Rate = 0 -- частицы выпускаем сами через Emit
	pe.Lifetime = P_LIFETIME
	pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1)
	pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	pe.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	pe.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
	pe.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30)
	pe.Size = NumberSequence.new(P_SIZE)
	pe.LightEmission = 1
	pe.LightInfluence = 0
	pe.LockedToPart = false
	-- быстро появляется, потом медленно растворяется
	pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	pe.Parent = att
    -- Each texture has its own emitter. Never change an emitter's texture
    -- after it has emitted, because that also changes particles already alive.
    local emitters={pe}
    for i=2,#TEXTURES do
        local other=pe:Clone()
        other.Texture=TEXTURES[i]
        other.Parent=att
        emitters[#emitters+1]=other
    end

	task.spawn(function()
		while alive do
			task.wait(1 / P_RATE)
            if not alive then break end

			local char = lp.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				-- t^2 даёт больше ближних частиц и меньше дальних
				local t = math.random()
				local dist = MIN_DIST + (MAX_DIST - MIN_DIST) * t * t
				local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				local height = MIN_HEIGHT + (MAX_HEIGHT - MIN_HEIGHT) * math.random()

				att.WorldPosition = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(
					math.cos(angle) * dist,
					height,
					math.sin(angle) * dist
				)
                emitters[math.random(1,#emitters)]:Emit(1)
			end
		end
	end)
end

startEffect(TEXTURES[1])
return function()
    alive=false
    for _,host in ipairs(hosts) do
        for _,emitter in ipairs(host:GetDescendants()) do
            if emitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then emitter.Enabled=false; emitter:Clear() end
        end
        host:Destroy()
    end
end
        end
        local function set(name,value,starter)
            stop(name)
            if value and not espLifecycle.stopped then
                local ok,result=pcall(starter)
                if ok and type(result)=="function" then stops[name]=result
                else warn("[DaDa Particles] "..name..": "..tostring(result)) end
            end
        end
        local particleEnabled=false
        local particleMode="Circles"
        local particleColor=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        local textures={Circles="rbxassetid://105212617258028",Stars="rbxassetid://118278158415684",Constellation={"rbxassetid://90690904298030","rbxassetid://114870653658903","rbxassetid://138459180690239"}}
        local function refreshParticles()
            set("circles",particleEnabled,function() return startCircles(textures[particleMode],particleColor) end)
        end
        panel:Toggle("Particles",false,function(v) particleEnabled=v; refreshParticles() end,nil,
            {get=function() return particleEnabled end})
        panel:Dropdown("Particles Mode",{"Circles","Stars","Constellation"},"Circles",function(v)
            particleMode=v; refreshParticles()
        end,{get=function() return particleMode end})
        panel:ColorPicker("Particles Color",particleColor,function(color)
            particleColor=color; refreshParticles()
        end,{get=function() return particleColor end})
        panel:Toggle("Rain",false,function(v) set("rain",v,startRain) end)
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function() stop("circles"); stop("rain") end)
    end

    do -- Weather: client-side particles that follow the camera
        local pW=makePanel(5,"right","Weather")
        if pW then
            local WEATHER={"Off","Rain","Snow","Sakura","Fireflies"}
            local mode,intensity="Off",50
            local holder,emitter,follow
            local function rateFor()
                if mode=="Rain" then return 60+intensity*14
                elseif mode=="Snow" then return 15+intensity*3.5
                elseif mode=="Sakura" then return 6+intensity*1.6
                elseif mode=="Fireflies" then return 3+intensity*0.35 end
                return 0
            end
            local function clear()
                if follow then pcall(function() follow:Disconnect() end); follow=nil end
                if holder then pcall(function() holder:Destroy() end); holder=nil end
                emitter=nil
            end
            local function build()
                clear()
                if mode=="Off" then return end
                local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then return end
                holder=Instance.new("Part")
                holder.Name="DaDaWeather"
                holder.Anchored=true; holder.CanCollide=false; holder.CanQuery=false; holder.CanTouch=false
                holder.Transparency=1
                holder.Size=Vector3.new(80,1,80)
                holder.Parent=cam
                emitter=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                emitter.Shape=Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
                emitter.Rate=rateFor()
                local height=40
                if mode=="Rain" then
                    emitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(175,205,255))
                    emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(0.1)
                    emitter.Squash=NumberSequence.new(-6)
                    emitter.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
                    emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0.45)
                    emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.5,0.6)
                    emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(110,130)
                    emitter.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                    emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(0,0)
                elseif mode=="Snow" then
                    emitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
                    emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(0.22)
                    emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0.1)
                    emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(6,8)
                    emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(5,8)
                    emitter.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                    emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(25,25)
                    emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-60,60)
                elseif mode=="Sakura" then
                    emitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,175,205))
                    emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(0.32)
                    emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0.1)
                    emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(6,8)
                    emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(3,6)
                    emitter.Acceleration=Vector3.new(3,0,1.5)
                    emitter.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                    emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(30,30)
                    emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-120,120)
                else -- Fireflies
                    height=6
                    holder.Size=Vector3.new(60,20,60)
                    emitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,235,120))
                    emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(0.25)
                    emitter.LightEmission=1
                    emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3,0.1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7,0.1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1),
                    })
                    emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(4,6)
                    emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(0.5,2)
                    emitter.EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top
                    emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
                end
                emitter.Parent=holder
                follow=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local c=workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if not holder or not holder.Parent or not c then return end
                    holder.CFrame=CFrame.new(c.CFrame.Position+Vector3.new(0,height,0))
                end)
                pcall(function() table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,follow) end)
            end
            pW:Dropdown("Weather",WEATHER,"Off",function(v) mode=v; build() end)
            pW:Slider("Intensity",50,1,100,function(v)
                intensity=v
                if emitter then emitter.Rate=rateFor() end
            end)
        end
    end
end
initMenu()

-- ============================================================
-- INIT 15: MAIN LOOP
-- ============================================================
local function initMainLoop()
    main_conn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin then
                if _G.DaDa_SL_getForceAtt and _G.DaDa_SL_getForceAtt() then
                    if os.clock()-(_G.DaDa_SL_getForceStamp and _G.DaDa_SL_getForceStamp() or 0)>0.05 then
                        _G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin()
                    end
                end
            end
            local now=os.clock()
            -- Shitaro owns target refresh, hooks, tracking and auto-fire.
            -- Reconcile settings/compatibility target, not a second aim loop.
            if SL_sync then SL_sync() end
            if SL.enabled then SL_refresh() end
            getgun_step(now)
            killaura_step()
            antifling_step()
            if knife_silent_step then pcall(knife_silent_step) end
        end)
    end)
end
initMainLoop()
