-- INIT 16: HOT KEYS
-- ============================================================
local function initQuick()
    quick_gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    quick_gui.Name="DaDaHotKeys_"..math.random(1000,9999)
    quick_gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
    quick_gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
    quick_gui.DisplayOrder=99
    quick_gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    quick_gui.Enabled=false
    pcall(function() quick_gui.Parent=CoreGui end)
    if not quick_gui.Parent then quick_gui.Parent=LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
    local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name="HotKeys"
    holder.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(208,0)
    holder.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    holder.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(14,14,18)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
    holder.BorderSizePixel=0
    holder.Parent=quick_gui
    Instance.new("UICorner",holder).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)
    local padding=Instance.new("UIPadding",holder)
    padding.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,8)
    padding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8)
    padding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8)
    padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)
    local menuScale=Instance.new("UIScale",holder)
    menuScale.Scale=ST.hotkeys_scale
    local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout",holder)
    list.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Padding=UDim.new(0,5)
    local header=Instance.new("TextButton")
    header.Name="Header"
    header.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,29)
    header.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24)
    header.BackgroundTransparency=0
    header.BorderSizePixel=0
    header.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    header.Text="hot keys"
    header.Active=true
    header.AutoButtonColor=false
    header.TextSize=13
    header.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,240)
    header.LayoutOrder=0
    header.Parent=holder
    Instance.new("UICorner",header).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
    local headerEdge=Instance.new("UIStroke",header)
    headerEdge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    headerEdge.Thickness=1
    headerEdge.Color=ST.hotkeys_color
    local defaults={silent="Z",esp="X",bhop="C",fly="V",inf_jump="B",getgun="N",auto_shoot="",invisible=""}
    local reserved={RightShift=true,Insert=true,End=true,Home=true}
    local rows={}
    local config=getgenv().DaDa_ConfigUI
    local featuresByFlag={}
    local includes={}
    local function isIncluded(flag) return includes[flag]==true end
    if config then
        config.hotkeyIncludes={}
        local candidates={}
        for _,binding in ipairs(config.bindings) do
            if binding.kind=="Toggle" and binding.searchName then
                candidates[#candidates+1]=binding
            end
        end
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do featuresByFlag[feature.flag]=feature end
        local aliases={["Silent Aim"]="silent",["Auto Shoot"]="auto_shoot",
            ["Invisible"]="invisible",["Auto Get Gun"]="getgun"}
        for _,binding in ipairs(candidates) do
            local flag=binding.searchFlag or aliases[binding.searchName]
            local feature=flag and featuresByFlag[flag]
            if not feature then
                flag="toggle:"..binding.id
                feature={name=binding.searchName,flag=flag,binding=binding}
                ST.quick_features[#ST.quick_features+1]=feature
                featuresByFlag[flag]=feature
            end
            feature.catalogIds=feature.catalogIds or {}
            feature.catalogIds[#feature.catalogIds+1]=binding.id
            feature.stateBinding=feature.stateBinding or binding
        end
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do
            local flag=feature.flag
            local default=feature.binding==nil
                or (feature.binding and (feature.binding.id=="custom/touch-fling"
                    or feature.binding.id=="custom/click-fling")) or false
            includes[flag]=default
            local selection=config.add("Value","custom/hotkeys/include/"..flag,default,
                function(value) includes[flag]=value end,function() end,
                {get=function() return includes[flag] end},function(value)
                    if type(value)~="boolean" then return false,"expected boolean" end
                    return true,value
                end)
            for _,id in ipairs(feature.catalogIds or {}) do config.hotkeyIncludes[id]=selection end
        end
    else
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do includes[feature.flag]=true end
    end
    local dragging
    local function limits()
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp=camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
        return math.max(0,vp.X-holder.AbsoluteSize.X-8),math.max(0,vp.Y-holder.AbsoluteSize.Y-8)
    end
    local function place()
        local maxX,maxY=limits()
        holder.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(ST.hotkeys_x,0,maxX),math.clamp(ST.quick_offset_y,0,maxY))
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if ST.hotkeys_locked or (config and config.blocked()) then return end
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging={input=input,x=input.Position.X,y=input.Position.Y,
                originX=holder.AbsolutePosition.X,originY=holder.AbsolutePosition.Y,
                touch=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch}
        end
    end))
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if ST.hotkeys_locked or not ST.quick or (config and config.blocked()) then dragging=nil; return end
        if (dragging.touch and input~=dragging.input)
            or (not dragging.touch and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then return end
        local maxX,maxY=limits()
        ST.hotkeys_x=math.clamp(dragging.originX+input.Position.X-dragging.x,0,maxX)
        ST.quick_offset_y=math.clamp(dragging.originY+input.Position.Y-dragging.y,0,maxY)
        place()
    end))
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and ((dragging.touch and input==dragging.input)
            or (not dragging.touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then dragging=nil end
    end))
    if config then
        local function coordinate(value)
            if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value<0 or value>100000 then return false,"invalid screen coordinate" end
            return true,value
        end
        config.add("Value","custom/hotkeys/x",18,function(v) ST.hotkeys_x=v end,function() place() end,
            {get=function() return ST.hotkeys_x end,legacy="ST_hotkeys_x"},coordinate)
        config.add("Value","7/left/Config/Slider/Quick Y Offset",180,function(v) ST.quick_offset_y=v end,function() place() end,
            {get=function() return ST.quick_offset_y end,legacy="ST_quick_offset_y"},coordinate)
    end
    local function active(flag)
        local feature=featuresByFlag[flag]
        if feature and (feature.stateBinding or feature.binding) then
            return (feature.stateBinding or feature.binding).read()==true
        end
        if flag=="silent" then return SL.enabled==true
        elseif flag=="esp" then return ST.esp_on==true
        elseif flag=="auto_shoot" then return SL.auto_on==true
        elseif flag=="invisible" then return SHF.invisible==true
        else return ST[flag]==true end
    end
    local function toggle(flag)
        if config and config.blocked() then return end
        local value=not active(flag)
        local feature=featuresByFlag[flag]
        if feature and (feature.stateBinding or feature.binding) then
            (feature.stateBinding or feature.binding).apply(value)
            ST.quick_state[flag]=active(flag)
            if config then config.sync() end
            return
        end
        if flag=="silent" then
            SL.enabled=value
            SL_sync()
            if value then task.spawn(function() pcall(SL_installHooks); pcall(SL_refresh) end)
            elseif _G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin then pcall(_G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin) end
        elseif flag=="esp" then ST.esp_on=value
        elseif flag=="auto_shoot" then SL.auto_on=value; SL_sync()
        elseif flag=="invisible" then SHF.invisToggle(value)
        else ST[flag]=value end
        ST.quick_state[flag]=active(flag)
        local registry=getgenv().DaDa_UIRegistry
        if registry and registry[flag] then pcall(registry[flag],active(flag)) end
        if config then config.sync() end
    end
    local function normalize(value)
        if type(value)~="string" then return false,"expected key name" end
        value=value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if value=="" then return true,"" end
        if #value==1 then value=value:upper() end
        local ok,key=pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[value] end)
        if not ok or not key or key==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown or reserved[value] then
            return false,"invalid or reserved key"
        end
        return true,value
    end
    for index,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do
        local flag=feature.flag
        ST.quick_binds[flag]=ST.quick_binds[flag] or defaults[flag] or ""
        local row=Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Name=flag
        row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,25)
        row.BackgroundTransparency=1
        row.BorderSizePixel=0
        row.LayoutOrder=index
        row.Visible=isIncluded(flag)
        row.Parent=holder
        -- Dedicated toggle left of the editable key, matching the main menu.
        local switch=Instance.new("TextButton")
        switch.Name="Toggle"
        switch.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(25,25)
        switch.BackgroundTransparency=1
        switch.BorderSizePixel=0
        switch.Text=""
        switch.AutoButtonColor=false
        switch.Parent=row
        local box=Instance.new("Frame")
        box.Name="Box"
        box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14)
        box.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-7,0.5,-7)
        box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24)
        box.BackgroundTransparency=1
        box.BorderSizePixel=0
        box.Parent=switch
        Instance.new("UICorner",box).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
        local edge=Instance.new("UIStroke",box)
        edge.Thickness=1
        edge.Transparency=0
        edge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        edge.Color=ST.hotkeys_color
        local fill=Instance.new("Frame")
        fill.Name="Fill"
        fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        fill.BorderSizePixel=0
        -- Retain the existing object, but never use a colored state fill.
        fill.Visible=false
        fill.BackgroundTransparency=1
        fill.Parent=box
        Instance.new("UICorner",fill).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
        local check=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        check.Name="Check"
        check.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        check.BackgroundTransparency=1
        check.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        check.Text="✓"
        check.TextSize=13
        check.TextColor3=ST.hotkeys_color
        check.Visible=active(flag)
        check.ZIndex=2
        check.Parent=box
        local key=Instance.new("TextBox")
        key.Name="Key"
        key.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(31,0)
        key.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(25,25)
        key.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24)
        key.BackgroundTransparency=0
        key.BorderSizePixel=0
        key.Font=Enum.Font.Code
        key.TextSize=13
        key.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,190,197)
        key.PlaceholderText="-"
        key.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(115,115,123)
        key.ClearTextOnFocus=false
        key.Text=ST.quick_binds[flag]
        key.Parent=row
        Instance.new("UICorner",key).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
        local keyEdge=Instance.new("UIStroke",key)
        keyEdge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        keyEdge.Thickness=1
        keyEdge.Color=ST.hotkeys_color
        local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Name="Feature"
        label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(62,0)
        label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-62,1,0)
        label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24)
        label.BackgroundTransparency=0
        label.BorderSizePixel=0
        label.Text=feature.name
        label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        label.TextSize=12
        label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,225,232)
        label.Parent=row
        Instance.new("UICorner",label).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
        local labelEdge=Instance.new("UIStroke",label)
        labelEdge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        labelEdge.Thickness=1
        labelEdge.Color=ST.hotkeys_color
        rows[flag]={frame=row,key=key,label=label,fill=fill,check=check,edge=edge,
            keyEdge=keyEdge,labelEdge=labelEdge}
        local binding
        if config then
            binding=config.add("Value","custom/keybinds/"..flag,defaults[flag] or "",function(value)
                ST.quick_binds[flag]=value
            end,function(value)
                if not key:IsFocused() then key.Text=value end
            end,{get=function() return ST.quick_binds[flag] end},normalize)
        end
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,key.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local valid,value=normalize(key.Text)
            if valid and value~="" then
                for other,assigned in pairs(ST.quick_binds) do
                    if other~=flag and isIncluded(other) and assigned==value then
                        valid=false
                        notify("Hot Keys","This key is already assigned")
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if valid then
                if binding then binding.apply(value) else ST.quick_binds[flag]=value end
            end
            key.Text=ST.quick_binds[flag]
        end))
        table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,switch.Activated:Connect(function()
            toggle(flag)
            local on=active(flag)
            fill.Visible=false
            check.Visible=on
        end))
    end
    -- BEGIN DADA CANDY CATALOG: full existing toggle catalog, UI bridge only.
    Win._candyButtonsSnapshot=function()
        local out={}
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do
            local flag=feature.flag
            out[#out+1]={id="quick:"..flag,label=feature.name,on=active(flag),
                toggle=function() toggle(flag) end}
        end
        return out
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function() Win._candyButtonsSnapshot=nil end)
    -- END DADA CANDY CATALOG
    Win._quickSnapshot=function()
        local out={}
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do
            local flag=feature.flag
            if isIncluded(flag) then
                out[#out+1]={id="quick:"..flag,label=feature.name,key=flag,
                    value=ST.quick_binds[flag]~="" and ST.quick_binds[flag] or "-",on=active(flag),mode="toggle",
                    toggle=function() toggle(flag); Win.KeybindList.refresh() end,
                    setKey=function(text)
                        if text=="-" then text="" end
                        local ok,value=normalize(text)
                        if ok then
                            for other,assigned in pairs(ST.quick_binds) do
                                if other~=flag and value~="" and isIncluded(other) and assigned==value then
                                    notify("Hotkeys","This key is already assigned"); return
                                end
                            end
                            local binding=config and config.byId["custom/keybinds/"..flag]
                            if binding then binding.apply(value) else ST.quick_binds[flag]=value end
                        end
                        Win.KeybindList.refresh()
                    end}
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function() Win._quickSnapshot=nil end)
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
        if processed or espLifecycle.stopped or not Win.HotkeysEnabled or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do
            if isIncluded(feature.flag) and ST.quick_binds[feature.flag]==input.KeyCode.Name then
                toggle(feature.flag); break
            end
        end
    end))
    local quickPaintElapsed=0
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
        quickPaintElapsed=quickPaintElapsed+dt
        if quickPaintElapsed < 0.1 then return end
        quickPaintElapsed=0
        quick_gui.Enabled=false
        if Win._quickExpanded then
            local now=os.clock()
            if not Win._quickRefreshAt or now-Win._quickRefreshAt>0.25 then
                Win._quickRefreshAt=now
                if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then Win.KeybindList.refresh() end
            end
        end
        if ST.hotkeys_locked then dragging=nil end
        menuScale.Scale=ST.hotkeys_scale
        place()
        -- Hot Keys has its own editable outline color, blue by default.
        -- Main-menu theme changes must not repaint keys or function backgrounds.
        local accent=ST.hotkeys_color or Color3.fromRGB(78,139,255)
        headerEdge.Color=accent
        for _,feature in ipairs(ST.quick_features) do
            local on=active(feature.flag)
            ST.quick_state[feature.flag]=on
            local widgets=rows[feature.flag]
            widgets.frame.Visible=isIncluded(feature.flag)
            widgets.fill.Visible=false
            widgets.check.Visible=on
            widgets.fill.BackgroundColor3=accent
            widgets.fill.BackgroundTransparency=1
            widgets.check.TextColor3=accent
            widgets.edge.Color=accent
            widgets.keyEdge.Color=accent
            widgets.labelEdge.Color=accent
            widgets.key.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24)
            widgets.label.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,24)
            widgets.key.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,190,197)
            widgets.label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,225,232)
            widgets.key.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,160)
        end
    end))
end
initQuick()

-- The old duplicate Quick Menu / bottom hotbar and fixed key handlers are
-- intentionally removed. Hot Keys is the sole owner of these keyboard shortcuts.
hubGui=nil
hotbarGui=nil

-- ============================================================
-- INIT 19: HOTKEYS
-- ============================================================
local function initHotkeys()
    table.insert(espLifecycle.connections,UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,gpe)
        if espLifecycle.stopped or gpe or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
            -- Neverlose owns RightShift. Avoid reopening the hidden V5 menu.
            if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Insert then Win:Toggle() end
        elseif input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.End then
            if getgenv().DADA_UNLOAD then pcall(getgenv().DADA_UNLOAD) end
        elseif input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Home then
            if SHF.clearWorldEffects then pcall(SHF.clearWorldEffects) end
            if SHF.clearAura then pcall(SHF.clearAura) end
            if SHF.clearAura2 then pcall(SHF.clearAura2) end
            if SHF.setPurpleAura then pcall(SHF.setPurpleAura, false) end
            if SHF.clearPremSky then pcall(SHF.clearPremSky) end
            if SHF.restoreShader then pcall(SHF.restoreShader) end
            notify("Reset","World restored")
        end
    end))
end
initHotkeys()

getgenv().DADA_UNLOAD=function()
    espLifecycle:cleanup()
    SL.enabled=false; SL.auto_on=false; SL.force=false
    ST.getgun=false; ST.quick=false; ST.esp_on=false
    ST.killaura=false; ST.autoknife=false; ST.antifling=false
    ST.auto_knife_throw=false; ST.fly=false; ST.noclip=false; ST.inf_jump=false
    ST.speed_hack=false; ST.jump_power=false; ST.bhop=false; ST.gravity=false
    ST.fullbright=false; ST.fov_changer=false; ST.world_color=false
    ST.char_transparency=false
    SHF.kill_sound=false; SHF.sheriff_sound=false; SHF.gunshot_sound=false
    SHF.shaders=false; SHF.exposure=false
    SHF.prem_skybox=false; SHF.world_fx=false; SHF.aura=false
    if SHF.aura2Toggle then pcall(function() SHF.aura2Toggle(false) end) end
    if SHF._skinDisconnect then pcall(SHF._skinDisconnect) end
    if SHF._visualDisconnect then pcall(SHF._visualDisconnect) end
    SHF.crosshair=false; SHF.china_hat=false; SHF.aura_trail=false; SHF.self_chams=false
    SHF.tool_chams=false; SHF.landing_circle=false; SHF.gun_esp=false
    SHF.gun_esp_text=false; SHF.gun_esp_hl=false
    SHF.mapvote=false; SHF.fake_pos=false; SHF.mov_graph=false
    getgenv().SILENT_AIM_ACTIVE=false
    if _G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin then pcall(_G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin) end
    if SHF.clearAura then pcall(SHF.clearAura) end
    if SHF.clearPremSky then pcall(SHF.clearPremSky) end
    if getgenv().DaDa_apply_skybox then pcall(function() getgenv().DaDa_apply_skybox("Default") end) end
    if SHF.restoreShader then pcall(SHF.restoreShader) end
    if SHF.animReset then pcall(SHF.animReset) end
    if SHF.emoteUnload then pcall(SHF.emoteUnload) end
    if main_conn then pcall(function() main_conn:Disconnect() end) main_conn=nil end
    if antifling_conn then pcall(function() antifling_conn:Disconnect() end) antifling_conn=nil end
    for p,v in pairs(af_cache or {}) do if p.Parent then pcall(function() p.CanCollide=v end) end end
    if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
    if quick_gui then pcall(function() quick_gui:Destroy() end) end
    if hubGui then pcall(function() hubGui:Destroy() end) end
    if hotbarGui then pcall(function() hotbarGui:Destroy() end) end
    if notifGui then pcall(function() notifGui:Destroy() end) end
    getgenv().DaDa_UIRegistry = nil
    print("[DaDa v16.3] Unloaded")
end

-- ============================================================
-- INIT 22: CONFIG SYSTEM
-- ============================================================
local function initConfigs()
    local CONFIG_DIR = "DaDa_configs/"
    local CONFIG_EXT = ".json"
    local CONFIG_LAST = "DaDa_configs/_last.txt"
    local can_read_write = type(writefile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function" and type(isfile)=="function"
    local can_list = type(listfiles)=="function"
    local function ensure_dir()
        if not can_read_write then return false end
        if type(isfolder)=="function" then
            local ok,exists=pcall(isfolder,CONFIG_DIR)
            if ok and exists then return true end
        end
        if type(makefolder)=="function" then
            local made,result=pcall(makefolder,CONFIG_DIR)
            if made then
                if type(isfolder)~="function" then return true end
                local check,exists=pcall(isfolder,CONFIG_DIR)
                if check and exists then return true end
                if result~=false then return true end
            end
        end
        -- Some executors create folders implicitly on writefile.
        return true
    end
    local function safe_name(name)
        name = tostring(name or "default")
        name = name:gsub("[^%w_%- ]", ""):gsub("%s+", "_")
        name = name:sub(1, 40)
        if name == "" then name = "default" end
        return name
    end
    local function config_path(name)
        return CONFIG_DIR .. safe_name(name) .. CONFIG_EXT
    end
    local ui=getgenv().DaDa_ConfigUI
    local namespaces={ST=ST,SHF=SHF,SL=SL,farm_cfg=farm_cfg,FLING=ST.fling_mini}
    local blocked={am_sheriff=true,last_shot=true,getgun_last=true,teleporting=true,
        fire_gap=true,mapvote_dupe=true,fling_murder=true,fling_sheriff=true}
    local silentKeys={enabled=true,predict=true,force=true,auto_on=true,auto_delay=true,stand_off=true}
    -- Persist the new user settings, not transient controller diagnostics.
    for _,key in ipairs({"auto_quality","auto_patience","auto_cooldown","reject_erratic"}) do
        silentKeys[key]=true
    end
    for _,key in ipairs({"plan_score","plan_risk","plan_quality","auto_threshold",
        "motion_coherence","motion_reversals","auto_confirmed_at","auto_sent_at","auto_error"}) do
        blocked[key]=true
    end
    local function scalar(value)
        local t=type(value)
        return t=="boolean" or t=="string" or
            (t=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)~=math.huge)
    end
    local function encodeValue(value)
        if typeof(value)=="Color3" then return {_c=true,r=value.R,g=value.G,b=value.B} end
        if scalar(value) then return value end
        return nil
    end
    local function decodeValue(value)
        if type(value)=="table" and value._c==true then
            local r,g,b=value.r or value[1] or value["1"],value.g or value[2] or value["2"],value.b or value[3] or value["3"]
            for _,component in ipairs({r,g,b}) do
                if type(component)~="number" or component~=component or component<0 or component>1 then
                    return false,"invalid Color3"
                end
            end
            if r==nil or g==nil or b==nil then return false,"incomplete Color3" end
            return true,Color3.new(r,g,b)
        end
        if scalar(value) then return true,value end
        return false,"unsupported value"
    end
    local mediaCats={idle=true,walk=true,run=true,jump=true,fall=true,climb=true,swim=true,swimidle=true}
    local function assetId(value)
        if type(value)~="number" and type(value)~="string" then return nil end
        local raw=tostring(value):match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or tostring(value):match("^(%d+)$")
        local n=raw and tonumber(raw)
        if not n or n<=0 or n>=1e16 or n%1~=0 then return nil end
        return raw
    end
    local function validateMedia(data)
        local media={}
        if data._animations~=nil then
            if type(data._animations)~="table" then return false,"invalid animation selections" end
            media.animations={}
            for category,record in pairs(data._animations) do
                if not mediaCats[category] or type(record)~="table" or type(record.name)~="string"
                    or record.name=="" or #record.name>300 then return false,"invalid animation category/record" end
                local item={name=record.name}
                if record.id~=nil then
                    item.id=assetId(record.id)
                    if not item.id then return false,"invalid bundle id" end
                end
                if record.bundledItems~=nil then
                    if type(record.bundledItems)~="table" then return false,"invalid bundled assets" end
                    item.bundledItems={}
                    local groupCount=0
                    for group,ids in pairs(record.bundledItems) do
                        groupCount=groupCount+1
                        if groupCount>64 or (type(group)~="string" and type(group)~="number")
                            or #tostring(group)>100 or type(ids)~="table" then return false,"invalid bundle group" end
                        local clean={}
                        for _,id in pairs(ids) do
                            local valid=assetId(id)
                            if not valid or #clean>=64 then return false,"invalid bundled asset id" end
                            clean[#clean+1]=valid
                        end
                        item.bundledItems[tostring(group)]=clean
                    end
                end
                media.animations[category]=item
            end
        end
        if data._emote~=nil then
            local record=data._emote
            if type(record)~="table" or type(record.name)~="string" or #record.name>300 then
                return false,"invalid emote record"
            end
            if record.name=="" and (record.id=="" or record.id==nil) then
                media.emote={name="",id=""}
            else
                local id=assetId(record.id)
                if not id or record.name=="" then return false,"invalid emote asset id" end
                media.emote={name=record.name,id=id}
            end
        end
        return true,media
    end
    local function restoreMedia(media,errors)
        local queued=SHF._queuedMediaConfig or {}
        for _,entry in ipairs({{"animations","animRestoreConfig"},{"emote","emoteRestoreConfig"}}) do
            local value=media[entry[1]]
            if value~=nil then
                local fn=SHF[entry[2]]
                if type(fn)=="function" then
                    local ok,err=pcall(fn,value)
                    if not ok then errors[#errors+1]=entry[1]..": "..tostring(err) end
                    queued[entry[1]]=nil
                else queued[entry[1]]=value end
            end
        end
        SHF._queuedMediaConfig=next(queued) and queued or nil
    end
    local function snapshot()
        if not ui then error("UI bindings are not initialized") end
        ui.sync()
        local queued=SHF._queuedMediaConfig or {}
        local data={_version="v16-config-4",_time=os.time(),_controls={},
            _animations=SHF.animExportConfig and SHF.animExportConfig() or queued.animations or {},
            _emote=SHF.emoteExportConfig and SHF.emoteExportConfig() or queued.emote or {name="",id=""}}
        data._dualWield={gun=ST.double_gun==true,knife=ST.double_knife==true}
        data._hotKeys={enabled=ST.quick==true,locked=ST.hotkeys_locked==true,
            size=ST.hotkeys_scale*100,x=ST.hotkeys_x,y=ST.quick_offset_y,binds={}}
        for flag,value in pairs(ST.quick_binds) do data._hotKeys.binds[flag]=value end
        for prefix,state in pairs(namespaces) do
            for key,value in pairs(state or {}) do
                if not blocked[key] and key:sub(1,1)~="_" and (prefix~="SL" or silentKeys[key]) then
                    local encoded=encodeValue(value)
                    if encoded~=nil then data[prefix.."_"..key]=encoded end
                end
            end
        end
        for _,binding in ipairs(ui.bindings) do
            local value=binding.read()
            -- Loading placeholders are not real animation/emote selections.
            if not binding.transient and value~="loading..." then data._controls[binding.id]=value end
        end
        return data
    end
    local function restore(data)
        if type(data)~="table" or not ui then return false,{"invalid config or missing UI"} end
        if ui.blocked and ui.blocked() then return false,{"another config operation is running"} end
        if data._controls~=nil and type(data._controls)~="table" then return false,{"invalid control map"} end
        local validMedia,media=validateMedia(data)
        if not validMedia then return false,{media} end
        local controls={}
        for id,value in pairs(data._controls or {}) do controls[id]=value end
        if data._dualWield~=nil then
            if type(data._dualWield)~="table" then return false,{"invalid dual-wield settings"} end
            if data._dualWield.gun~=nil then controls["6/left/Dual Wield/Toggle/Double Gun"]=data._dualWield.gun end
            if data._dualWield.knife~=nil then controls["6/left/Dual Wield/Toggle/Double Knife"]=data._dualWield.knife end
        end
        if data._hotKeys~=nil then
            local hot=data._hotKeys
            if type(hot)~="table" or (hot.binds~=nil and type(hot.binds)~="table") then
                return false,{"invalid hot-keys settings"}
            end
            local ids={enabled="7/left/Config/Toggle/Quick Menu",locked="custom/hotkeys/locked",
                size="custom/hotkeys/size",x="custom/hotkeys/x",y="7/left/Config/Slider/Quick Y Offset"}
            for key,id in pairs(ids) do if hot[key]~=nil then controls[id]=hot[key] end end
            for flag,value in pairs(hot.binds or {}) do controls["custom/keybinds/"..flag]=value end
        end
        local pending,raw,claimed,errors={},{},{},{}
        -- Validate everything before the first mutation. false is a saved value, not a missing key.
        for _,binding in ipairs(ui.bindings) do
            if binding.legacy then claimed[binding.legacy]=true end
            local value=controls[binding.id]
            if value==nil and binding.legacy and data[binding.legacy]~=nil then
                local ok,decoded=decodeValue(data[binding.legacy])
                if ok and binding.fromLegacy then ok,decoded=pcall(binding.fromLegacy,decoded) end
                if ok then value=decoded else errors[#errors+1]=binding.id..": "..tostring(decoded) end
            end
            if binding.transient then value=nil end
            if value~=nil then
                local ok,normalized=binding.validate(value)
                if ok then pending[#pending+1]={binding=binding,value=normalized}
                else errors[#errors+1]=binding.id..": "..tostring(normalized) end
            end
        end
        -- Import only known scalar/color fields. Never replace callbacks, Instances or runtime tables.
        for prefix,state in pairs(namespaces) do
            for key,current in pairs(state or {}) do
                local name=prefix.."_"..key
                if not claimed[name] and not blocked[key] and key:sub(1,1)~="_"
                    and (prefix~="SL" or silentKeys[key]) and data[name]~=nil and encodeValue(current)~=nil then
                    local ok,value=decodeValue(data[name])
                    if ok and typeof(value)==typeof(current) then
                        raw[#raw+1]={state=state,key=key,value=value}
                    else errors[#errors+1]=name..": invalid property type" end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Invalid entries are skipped and reported; everything valid is still applied.
        local applied=0
        ui.busy=true; ui.busySince=os.clock()
        local success,fatal=pcall(function()
            for _,entry in ipairs(raw) do entry.state[entry.key]=entry.value; applied=applied+1 end
            -- Set parameters before enabling their workers/effects. Base sky selection must
            -- happen before the premium/preset switches, since it clears those switches.
            for phase=1,3 do
                for _,entry in ipairs(pending) do
                    local binding,value=entry.binding,entry.value
                    local selected=(phase==1 and binding.kind~="Toggle")
                        or (phase==2 and binding.kind=="Toggle" and value==false)
                        or (phase==3 and binding.kind=="Toggle" and value==true)
                    if selected then
                        local ok,err=binding.apply(value)
                        if ok then applied=applied+1 else errors[#errors+1]=binding.id..": "..tostring(err) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        -- Galleries restore after basic Anim Pack controls; bundle selections
        -- and the selected emote therefore cannot be overwritten by those controls.
        if success then restoreMedia(media,errors) end
        ui.busy=false
        if not success then errors[#errors+1]=tostring(fatal) end
        -- Reconcile both ON and OFF after all config phases.
        -- Native callbacks exclusively own tracking and auto-shoot lifecycle.
        if SL_sync then SL_sync() end
        if SL.enabled then
            local ok,installed=pcall(SL_installHooks)
            if not ok then
                errors[#errors+1]="Silent Aim: "..tostring(installed)
            elseif not installed then
                errors[#errors+1]="Silent Aim: WeaponService is not available yet"
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                if not espLifecycle.stopped and SL.enabled then pcall(SL_refresh) end
            end)
        elseif _G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin then
            pcall(_G.DaDa_SL_restore_origin)
        end
        ST.quick_state.silent=SL.enabled==true
        ST.quick_state.auto_shoot=SL.auto_on==true
        ui.sync()
        return #errors==0,errors,applied
    end
    local defaults=snapshot()
    local CFG={}
    local manuallyUsed=false
    local function reportErrors(errors)
        local text=table.concat(errors or {},"; ")
        warn("[DaDa Config] "..text)
        if notify then notify("Config","Не всё применено: "..tostring((errors or {})[1] or "unknown error")) end
    end
    function CFG.save(name)
        manuallyUsed=true
        if espLifecycle.stopped or not ui or (ui.blocked and ui.blocked()) then return false end
        if not can_read_write or not ensure_dir() then
            if notify then notify("Config","Файловое API недоступно") end
            return false
        end
        name=safe_name(name)
        local ok,raw=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(snapshot()) end)
        if not ok or type(raw)~="string" then
            if notify then notify("Config","Ошибка encode: "..tostring(raw)) end
            return false
        end
        local saved,err=pcall(writefile,config_path(name),raw)
        if not saved or err==false then
            if notify then notify("Config","Ошибка записи: "..tostring(err)) end
            return false
        end
        pcall(writefile,CONFIG_LAST,name)
        if notify then notify("Config","Сохранено: "..name) end
        return true
    end
    function CFG.load(name)
        manuallyUsed=true
        if espLifecycle.stopped or not ui or (ui.blocked and ui.blocked()) then return false end
        if not can_read_write then
            if notify then notify("Config","Файловое API недоступно") end
            return false
        end
        name=safe_name(name)
        local path=config_path(name)
        local existsOk,exists=pcall(isfile,path)
        if not existsOk or not exists then
            if notify then notify("Config","Не найдено: "..name) end
            return false
        end
        local readOk,raw=pcall(readfile,path)
        if not readOk or type(raw)~="string" then
            if notify then notify("Config","Ошибка read: "..tostring(raw)) end
            return false
        end
        local decodeOk,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not decodeOk or type(data)~="table" then
            if notify then notify("Config","Ошибка decode") end
            return false
        end
        local ok,errors,applied=restore(data)
        if not ok and (applied or 0)==0 then reportErrors(errors); return false end
        pcall(writefile,CONFIG_LAST,name)
        if ok then
            if notify then notify("Config","Загружено: "..name) end
        else
            warn("[DaDa Config] skipped: "..table.concat(errors or {},"; "))
            if notify then notify("Config","Загружено: "..name.." (пропущено: "..tostring(#errors)..")") end
        end
        return true
    end
    function CFG.delete(name)
        manuallyUsed=true
        if not can_read_write or type(delfile)~="function" then
            if notify then notify("Config","Удаление файлов недоступно") end
            return false
        end
        name=safe_name(name)
        local ok,exists=pcall(isfile,config_path(name))
        if ok and exists then
            local removed=pcall(delfile,config_path(name))
            if removed then
                if CFG.last()==name then pcall(delfile,CONFIG_LAST) end
                if notify then notify("Config","Удалено: "..name) end
                return true
            end
        end
        if notify then notify("Config","Не удалось удалить") end
        return false
    end
    function CFG.list()
        local result,seen={},{}
        if not can_list or not ensure_dir() then return result end
        local ok,files=pcall(listfiles,CONFIG_DIR)
        if not ok or type(files)~="table" then return result end
        for _,path in ipairs(files) do
            if type(path)=="string" then
                local name=path:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                if name and not seen[name] then result[#result+1]=name; seen[name]=true end
            end
        end
        table.sort(result)
        return result
    end
    function CFG.last()
        if not can_read_write then return nil end
        local ok,exists=pcall(isfile,CONFIG_LAST)
        if not ok or not exists then return nil end
        local readOk,name=pcall(readfile,CONFIG_LAST)
        if readOk and type(name)=="string" and name~="" then return safe_name(name) end
        return nil
    end
    function CFG.reset()
        manuallyUsed=true
        if espLifecycle.stopped then return false end
        local ok,errors,applied=restore(defaults)
        if not ok and (applied or 0)==0 then reportErrors(errors); return false end
        if notify then notify("Config","Настройки сброшены") end
        return true
    end
    getgenv().DaDa_Config=CFG
    table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,function()
        if getgenv().DaDa_Config==CFG then getgenv().DaDa_Config=nil end
    end)
    task.delay(3.5,function()
        -- An old instance must not auto-load into a re-executed script.
        if espLifecycle.stopped or getgenv().DaDa_Config~=CFG or manuallyUsed then return end
        local last=CFG.last()
        if last then CFG.load(last) end
    end)
end
initConfigs()

-- ============================================================
-- INIT 23: DOUBLE JUMP (по твоему коду)
-- ============================================================
do
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")

    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local character
    local humanoid

    local enabled = false
    local jumps = 0
    local maxJumps = 2
    local jumpTick = tick()

    local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
        character = newCharacter
        humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

        jumps = 0
        jumpTick = tick()

        humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
            if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
            or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
            or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics then
                jumps = 0
            end
        end)
    end

    UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        if not enabled then return end
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        if jumps < maxJumps and tick() - jumpTick > 0.2 then
            jumpTick = tick()
            jumps += 1
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end)

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    if player.Character then
        onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
    end

    getgenv().DADA_DOUBLEJUMP_TOGGLE = function(v)
        enabled = v and true or false
        ST.double_jump = enabled
        if not enabled then jumps = 0 end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- INIT 24: ANIMATIONS + EMOTES
-- ============================================================
do
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

    -- ==========================================================
    -- ANIMATIONS ENGINE
    -- ==========================================================
    do
        local cats = {
            {"Idle","idle"},{"Walk","walk"},{"Run","run"},{"Jump","jump"},
            {"Fall","fall"},{"Climb","climb"},{"Swim","swim"},{"Swim Idle","swimidle"}
        }
        local animItems, byName, mapCache, sel, origMap = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
        SHF.animSelections=sel
        local enabled, animConn = false, nil
        local fetched, pendingApply, applyToken = false, false, 0

        local function getParts()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            return char, char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        end

        local function stopTracks(hum)
            if not hum then return end
            for _,track in pairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                -- Downloading a movement bundle may finish AFTER the config's
                -- Action-priority emote starts. Never stop that restored emote.
                local priority=track.Priority
                if priority==Enum.AnimationPriority.Core or priority==Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
                    or priority==Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement then
                    pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function refreshAnimate(animate, hum)
            if animate and hum and not animate.Disabled then
                animate.Disabled = true
                animate.Disabled = false
                hum:Move(hum.MoveDirection, false)
            end
        end

        local function resolveMappings(data)
            local key = tostring(data.id)
            if mapCache[key] then return mapCache[key] end
            local bundled = data.bundledItems
            if type(bundled) ~= "table" then return nil end
            local mappings = {}
            for _, ids in pairs(bundled) do
                if type(ids) == "table" then
                    for _, assetId in pairs(ids) do
                        local ok, objs = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, "rbxassetid://"..assetId)
                        if ok and objs then
                            local known={idle=true,walk=true,run=true,jump=true,fall=true,climb=true,swim=true,swimidle=true}
                            local function scan(object, category)
                                local name=string.lower(object.Name)
                                if known[name] then category=name end
                                if object:IsA("Animation") and object.AnimationId~="" then
                                    mappings[#mappings+1]={category=category,name=object.Name,id=object.AnimationId}
                                end
                                for _,child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do scan(child,category) end
                            end
                            for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                                scan(o,nil)
                                pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            mapCache[key] = mappings
            return mappings
        end

        local function catItems(data, folderName)
            local mappings = resolveMappings(data)
            if not mappings then return nil end
            local items = {}
            for _, m in ipairs(mappings) do
                if m.category and m.category:lower() == folderName then
                    items[m.name:lower()] = m.id
                end
            end
            return items
        end

        local function applyCat(animate, folderName, data)
            if not (animate and data) then return end
            local items = catItems(data, folderName)
            if not (items and next(items)) then return end
            local folder = animate:FindFirstChild(folderName)
            if not folder then
                for _,candidate in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
                    if string.lower(candidate.Name)==folderName then folder=candidate; break end
                end
            end
            if not folder then return end
            local _, first = next(items)
            for _, a in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if a:IsA("Animation") then
                    local id = items[a.Name:lower()] or first
                    if id then
                        if origMap[a] == nil then origMap[a] = a.AnimationId end
                        a.AnimationId = id
                        a.Parent = nil
                        a.Parent = folder
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function applyAll(animate)
            for _, c in ipairs(cats) do
                local name = sel[c[2]]
                if name and name ~= "none" and byName[name] then
                    applyCat(animate, c[2], byName[name])
                end
            end
        end

        local function restore()
            for a, id in pairs(origMap) do
                if a and a.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        local folder = a.Parent
                        a.AnimationId = id
                        a.Parent = nil
                        a.Parent = folder
                    end)
                end
            end
            origMap = {}
        end

        local function doApply()
            applyToken = applyToken + 1
            local token = applyToken
            task.spawn(function()
                local char,hum,animate=getParts()
                local deadline=os.clock()+15
                -- A config may load while the CURRENT character is still being
                -- assembled, without another CharacterAdded event to retry it.
                while (not char or not hum or not animate) and os.clock()<deadline do
                    if token~=applyToken or espLifecycle.stopped or not enabled then return end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    char,hum,animate=getParts()
                end
                if not char or not hum or not animate or token~=applyToken
                    or espLifecycle.stopped or not enabled then return end
                -- Resolve bundled assets before mutating this character; GetObjects may yield.
                for _, category in ipairs(cats) do
                    local selected = sel[category[2]]
                    if selected and byName[selected] then resolveMappings(byName[selected]) end
                end
                if LP.Character ~= char or token ~= applyToken or espLifecycle.stopped
                    or char:FindFirstChild("Animate") ~= animate or not enabled then return end
                stopTracks(hum)
                restore()
                applyAll(animate)
                if token == applyToken then refreshAnimate(animate, hum) end
            end)
        end

        local function requestApply()
            if not enabled then return end
            if not fetched then
                pendingApply = true
                return
            end
            doApply()
        end

        local function fetchAll()
            local urls = {
                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/AnimationSniper.json",
                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/AnimationSniperoffsale.json"
            }
            local seen = {}
            for _, url in ipairs(urls) do
                local ok, res = pcall(function()
                    local c = game:HttpGet(url)
                    return c ~= "" and HttpService:JSONDecode(c) or nil
                end)
                if ok and type(res) == "table" then
                    local list = res.data or res
                    for _, item in pairs(list) do
                        local id = tonumber(item.id)
                        if id and id > 0 and item.bundledItems and not seen[id] then
                            seen[id] = true
                            local nm = tostring(item.name or ("Animation_"..id))
                            if byName[nm] then nm = nm.." ["..id.."]" end
                            byName[nm] = {id = id, bundledItems = item.bundledItems}
                            animItems[#animItems+1] = {name = nm, id = id}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function bind_respawn()
            if animConn then return end
            animConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                applyToken = applyToken + 1
                origMap = {}
                -- Bounded retries also catch animation folders populated after Animate itself.
                task.spawn(function()
                    local deadline = os.clock() + 15
                    local lastAnimate, lastCount = nil, -1
                    while enabled and not espLifecycle.stopped and LP.Character == c
                        and c.Parent and os.clock() < deadline do
                        local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local animate = c:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                        if hum and animate then
                            local count = 0
                            for _, item in ipairs(animate:GetDescendants()) do
                                if item:IsA("Animation") then count = count + 1 end
                            end
                            if animate ~= lastAnimate or count ~= lastCount then
                                lastAnimate, lastCount = animate, count
                                requestApply()
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(0.4)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end

        local function drop_respawn()
            if animConn then pcall(function() animConn:Disconnect() end) animConn = nil end
        end

        local function wipe_anims()
            local _, hum, animate = getParts()
            stopTracks(hum)
            restore()
            refreshAnimate(animate, hum)
        end

        SHF.animApply = function(name, catKey)
            catKey=catKey or "all"
            if name and not byName[name] then return end
            if name and SHF.anim_pack ~= "Default" and SHF.applyAnim then
                SHF.applyAnim("Default")
            end
            if catKey == "all" then
                for _, c in ipairs(cats) do
                    if name then sel[c[2]] = name else sel[c[2]] = nil end
                end
            else
                if name then sel[catKey] = name else sel[catKey] = nil end
            end
            if SHF.animGallery then SHF.animGallery:Refresh() end
            enabled = false
            for _, v in pairs(sel) do
                if v then enabled = true; break end
            end
            if enabled then
                bind_respawn()
                requestApply()
            else
                pendingApply = false
                applyToken = applyToken + 1
                drop_respawn()
                wipe_anims()
            end
        end
        SHF.animReset = function()
            for k in pairs(sel) do sel[k] = nil end
            SHF.animApply(nil, "all")
        end

        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups, function()
            enabled = false
            pendingApply = false
            applyToken = applyToken + 1
            drop_respawn()
            restore()
        end)

        getgenv().DADA_ANIM_APPLY = function(name)
            local cat = getgenv().DADA_ANIM_CAT or "all"
            SHF.animApply(name, cat)
        end
        getgenv().DADA_ANIM_RESET = function()
            SHF.animReset()
        end

        -- Configs contain stable asset data, not only a gallery highlight. Saved
        -- bundles remain usable when catalogue HTTP requests finish late/fail.
        local restoredBundles={}
        SHF.animExportConfig=function()
            local result={}
            for _,category in ipairs(cats) do
                local key=category[2]
                local name=sel[key]
                if name then
                    local data=byName[name] or restoredBundles[name]
                    result[key]={name=name,id=data and data.id or nil,
                        bundledItems=data and data.bundledItems or nil}
                end
            end
            return result
        end
        SHF.animRestoreConfig=function(records)
            table.clear(sel)
            table.clear(restoredBundles)
            for _,category in ipairs(cats) do
                local key=category[2]
                local record=records[key]
                if record then
                    sel[key]=record.name
                    if record.id and record.bundledItems then
                        local bundle={id=record.id,bundledItems=record.bundledItems}
                        restoredBundles[record.name]=bundle
                        if not byName[record.name] then byName[record.name]=bundle end
                    end
                end
            end
            enabled=next(sel)~=nil
            if enabled then
                if SHF.anim_pack~="Default" and SHF.applyAnim then SHF.applyAnim("Default") end
                bind_respawn()
                requestApply()
            else
                pendingApply=false; applyToken=applyToken+1
                drop_respawn(); wipe_anims()
            end
            if SHF.animGallery then SHF.animGallery:Refresh() end
        end

        local fetching=false
        SHF.reloadAnimations=function()
            if fetching or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            fetching=true
            fetched=false
            if SHF.animGallery then SHF.animGallery:SetData({},"Loading animation bundles...") end
            task.spawn(function()
                local oldItems,oldByName=animItems,byName
                animItems,byName={},{}
                local ok,err=pcall(fetchAll)
                if #animItems==0 then animItems,byName=oldItems,oldByName end
                -- HTTP completion must not erase bundles imported by a config.
                for name,bundle in pairs(restoredBundles) do
                    if not byName[name] then byName[name]=bundle end
                end
                fetching=false
                fetched=true
                if espLifecycle.stopped then return end
                if SHF.animGallery then SHF.animGallery:SetData(animItems) end
                if enabled then pendingApply=false; requestApply() end
                if not ok then warn("[DaDa Animations] "..tostring(err)) end
                if notify then pcall(notify,"Animations","Загружено "..#animItems.." паков") end
            end)
        end
        SHF.reloadAnimations()
    end

    -- ==========================================================
    -- EMOTES ENGINE
    -- ==========================================================
    do
        local emoteFile = "emotes.json"
        local statEmotes = {
            {"Griddy", "129149402922241"}
        }
        local custEmotes, emoteMap, emoteList, animCache = {}, {}, {}, {}
        local allList, allMap = {}, {}
        local curTrack, selId, custRaw, alive = nil, nil, nil, true
        SHF.emoteSelection={name="",id=""}
        local playToken=0

        local function parseCustom()
            if not (isfile and isfile(emoteFile)) then
                if custRaw ~= nil then custRaw, custEmotes = nil, {} return true end
                return false
            end
            local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, emoteFile)
            if not ok or raw == custRaw then return false end
            custRaw, custEmotes = raw, {}
            local dok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
            if dok and type(data) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(data) do
                    local name, id
                    if type(v) == "table" then
                        name, id = tostring(v.name or v[1] or k), tostring(v.id or v[2] or "")
                    else
                        name, id = tostring(k), tostring(v)
                    end
                    if name ~= "" and id ~= "" then
                        custEmotes[#custEmotes+1] = {name, id}
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end

        local function buildList()
            emoteMap, emoteList = {}, {}
            local function add(name, id)
                name = tostring(name)
                if emoteMap[name] then name = name.." ["..tostring(id).."]" end
                emoteMap[name] = tostring(id)
                emoteList[#emoteList+1] = {name = name, id = tonumber((tostring(id):gsub("%D", ""))) or id}
            end
            for _, e in ipairs(statEmotes) do add(e[1], e[2]) end
            for _, e in ipairs(custEmotes) do add(e[1], e[2]) end
            for _, e in ipairs(allList) do add(e.name, e.id) end
            if not espLifecycle.stopped and SHF.emoteGallery then SHF.emoteGallery:SetData(emoteList) end
        end

        parseCustom()
        buildList()

        local function getHum()
            local char = LP.Character
            return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        end

        local function stopEmote()
            playToken=playToken+1
            if curTrack then
                pcall(function() curTrack:Stop(0.1); curTrack:Destroy() end)
                curTrack = nil
            end
        end

        local function resolveId(id)
            if animCache[id] then return animCache[id] end
            if id:find("://") then animCache[id] = id return id end
            local raw = id:gsub("%D", "")
            local ok, objs = pcall(game.GetObjects, game, "rbxassetid://"..raw)
            if ok and type(objs) == "table" then
                local found
                local function scan(inst)
                    if found then return end
                    if inst:IsA("Animation") and inst.AnimationId ~= "" then
                        found = inst.AnimationId
                        return
                    end
                    for _, c in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do scan(c) end
                end
                for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                    scan(o)
                    pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
                end
                if found then animCache[id] = found return found end
            end
            local url = "rbxassetid://"..raw
            animCache[id] = url
            return url
        end

        local function playEmote()
            local hum=getHum()
            if not hum or hum.Health<=0 or not selId or not alive then return end
            stopEmote()
            local token=playToken
            local requested=selId
            task.spawn(function()
                local resolved=resolveId(requested)
                if not alive or espLifecycle.stopped or token~=playToken
                    or getHum()~=hum or selId~=requested or hum.Health<=0 then return end
                local animator=hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if not animator then
                    if notify then pcall(notify,"Emotes","Animator not found on this character") end
                    return
                end
                local anim=Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId=resolved
                local ok,track=pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
                anim:Destroy()
                if ok and track then
                    if token~=playToken or not alive or getHum()~=hum then track:Destroy(); return end
                    track.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                    track.Looped=true
                    track:Play(0.1)
                    curTrack=track
                else
                    warn("[DaDa Emotes] "..tostring(track))
                    if notify then pcall(notify,"Emotes","Animation could not be loaded; check asset access and rig") end
                end
            end)
        end

        local function fetchEmotes()
            local ok, res = pcall(function()
                local c = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/EmoteSniper.json")
                return c ~= "" and HttpService:JSONDecode(c) or nil
            end)
            if ok and type(res) == "table" then
                local list = res.data or res
                local seen = {}
                for _, item in pairs(list) do
                    local id = tonumber(item.id)
                    if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] then
                        seen[id] = true
                        local nm = tostring(item.name or ("Emote_"..id))
                        if allMap[nm] then nm = nm.." ["..id.."]" end
                        allMap[nm] = tostring(id)
                        allList[#allList+1] = {name = nm, id = id}
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        SHF.emotePlay = function(name)
            if type(name)~="string" or name=="" then
                selId=nil; SHF.emoteSelection={name="",id=""}; stopEmote()
                if SHF.emoteGallery then SHF.emoteGallery:ClearSelection() end
                return true
            end
            local id=emoteMap[name]
            if not id then return false end
            selId=tostring(id)
            SHF.emoteSelection={name=name,id=selId}
            if SHF.emoteGallery then SHF.emoteGallery:SetSelection(name) end
            playEmote()
            return true
        end
        SHF.emoteStop = function()
            selId=nil; SHF.emoteSelection={name="",id=""}
            stopEmote()
            if SHF.emoteGallery then SHF.emoteGallery:ClearSelection() end
        end
        SHF.emoteExportConfig=function()
            return {name=SHF.emoteSelection.name,id=SHF.emoteSelection.id}
        end
        SHF.emoteRestoreConfig=function(record)
            if record.name=="" or record.id=="" then SHF.emoteStop(); return end
            SHF.emoteSelection={name=record.name,id=tostring(record.id)}
            selId=tostring(record.id)
            if SHF.emoteGallery then SHF.emoteGallery:SetSelection(record.name) end
            playEmote()
        end


        getgenv().DADA_EMOTE_PLAY = SHF.emotePlay
        getgenv().DADA_EMOTE_STOP = SHF.emoteStop

        local char_conn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            stopEmote()
            task.spawn(function()
                local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
                if hum then hum:WaitForChild("Animator",10) end
                if alive and not espLifecycle.stopped and LP.Character==char and selId then playEmote() end
            end)
        end)

        local fetching=false
        SHF.reloadEmotes=function()
            if fetching or not alive or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
            fetching=true
            task.spawn(function()
                local oldList,oldMap=allList,allMap
                allList,allMap={},{}
                local ok,err=pcall(fetchEmotes)
                if #allList==0 then allList,allMap=oldList,oldMap end
                fetching=false
                if not alive or espLifecycle.stopped then return end
                buildList()
                if not ok then warn("[DaDa Emotes] "..tostring(err)) end
                if notify then pcall(notify,"Emotes","Загружено "..#emoteList.." эмоций") end
            end)
        end
        SHF.reloadEmotes()

        task.spawn(function()
            while alive and task.wait(3) do
                if parseCustom() then
                    buildList()
                end
            end
        end)

        SHF.emoteUnload = function()
            alive = false
            selId = nil
            stopEmote()
            if char_conn then pcall(function() char_conn:Disconnect() end) char_conn = nil end
        end
        table.insert(espLifecycle.cleanups,SHF.emoteUnload)
    end

    -- A manual/automatic config load can precede engine initialization.
    local queued=SHF._queuedMediaConfig
    SHF._queuedMediaConfig=nil
    if queued then
        if queued.animations then SHF.animRestoreConfig(queued.animations) end
        if queued.emote then SHF.emoteRestoreConfig(queued.emote) end
    end
    task.wait(1)
    if notify then pcall(notify, "DaDa", "Animations + Emotes загружены") end
end

notify("DaDa v16.3","здраствуй в царство воин")
print("[DaDa v16.3] кароч ку это значит то что скрипт загружен и тд кароч приятной игры")
end
local started, startupError=xpcall(startDaDaBackend, function(err)
    return tostring(err).."\n"..debug.traceback()
end)
dadaBackendFinished=true
if not started then
    warn("[DaDa startup error] "..startupError)
    if not dadaIntroStarted then dadaIntroDone=true end
end
-- Always release the wait if the loader fails or its watchdog expires.
while not dadaIntroDone do task.wait(0.05) end
-- BEGIN DADA MUSIC INTEGRATION (additive; original script preserved)
do
    local failedCleanup
    local function installDaDaMusic()
        local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local environment = (type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G
        local CrackHubEnvironment = {
            isfile=environment.isfile or isfile, isfolder=environment.isfolder or isfolder,
            makefolder=environment.makefolder or makefolder, writefile=environment.writefile or writefile,
            readfile=environment.readfile or readfile,
            getcustomasset=environment.getcustomasset or environment.getsynasset or getcustomasset or getsynasset,
        }
        local isfile, isfolder = CrackHubEnvironment.isfile, CrackHubEnvironment.isfolder
        local makefolder, writefile, readfile = CrackHubEnvironment.makefolder, CrackHubEnvironment.writefile, CrackHubEnvironment.readfile
        local Theme = {
            Background=Color3.fromRGB(18,20,29), Element=Color3.fromRGB(28,31,45),
            ElementHover=Color3.fromRGB(40,45,62), Stroke=Color3.fromRGB(58,70,98),
            Text=Color3.fromRGB(226,228,236), SubText=Color3.fromRGB(112,116,138),
            Accent=Color3.fromRGB(78,139,255), Danger=Color3.fromRGB(255,69,58),
        }
        pcall(function() Theme.Accent=Win:GetCustomization().accentColor or Theme.Accent end)
        local bridgeAlive, bridgeConnections, themedObjects = true, {}, {}
        local ownedObjects = {}
        -- Track even the Sound created directly by the untouched music module.
        local NativeInstance=Instance
        local Instance={new=function(class,parent)
            local object=NativeInstance.new(class,parent)
            table.insert(ownedObjects,object)
            return object
        end}
        local function connect(signal, callback)
            local connection=signal:Connect(function(...) if bridgeAlive then return callback(...) end end)
            table.insert(bridgeConnections,connection)
            return connection
        end
        local function Create(class, properties, children)
            local object=Instance.new(class)
            for property,value in pairs(properties or {}) do
                if property~="Parent" then
                    object[property]=value
                    if typeof(value)=="Color3" then
                        for key,color in pairs(Theme) do
                            if value==color then table.insert(themedObjects,{Object=object,Property=property,Key=key});break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _,child in ipairs(children or {}) do child.Parent=object end
            if properties and properties.Parent then object.Parent=properties.Parent end
            return object
        end
        local function Corner(radius) return Create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 7)}) end
        local function Stroke(color,thickness,transparency)
            return Create("UIStroke",{Color=color or Theme.Stroke,Thickness=thickness or 1,Transparency=transparency or 0,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})
        end
        local function List(padding)
            return Create("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,padding or 6),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
        end
        local order=0
        local function NextOrder() order=order+1;return order end
        local function Tween(object,properties,duration,style,direction)
            local tween=TweenService:Create(object,TweenInfo.new(duration or .15,style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),properties)
            tween:Play();return tween
        end
        local function MakeDraggable(handle,frame,connections)
            local inputDown,origin,startPosition
            local function bind(signal,fn)
                local c=signal:Connect(fn);table.insert(connections,c)
            end
            bind(handle.InputBegan,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    inputDown=input;origin=input.Position;startPosition=frame.Position
                end
            end)
            bind(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
                if not inputDown or not frame.Parent then return end
                if input~=inputDown and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
                if inputDown.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input~=inputDown then return end
                local delta=input.Position-origin
                frame.Position=UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale,startPosition.X.Offset+delta.X,startPosition.Y.Scale,startPosition.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
            end)
            bind(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
                if input==inputDown or (inputDown and inputDown.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then inputDown=nil end
            end)
        end
        -- Kept for compatibility with the supplied module's optional embedded assets.
        local function Base64Decode(data)
            local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            local lookup={};for i=1,#alphabet do lookup[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
            local result,buffer,bits={},0,0
            for char in tostring(data):gmatch(".") do
                local value=lookup[char]
                if value then
                    buffer=buffer*64+value;bits=bits+6
                    if bits>=8 then bits=bits-8;local divisor=2^bits;result[#result+1]=string.char(math.floor(buffer/divisor)%256);buffer=buffer%divisor end
                end
            end
            return table.concat(result)
        end
        local Container={};Container.__index=Container
        local function label(parent,text,size)
            return Create("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=size or UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0),
                Font=Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Text=tostring(text or ""),Parent=parent})
        end
        local function row(self,name,height)
            return Create("Frame",{Name=name or "MusicControl",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height or 36),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,
                BackgroundTransparency=.22,BorderSizePixel=0,LayoutOrder=NextOrder(),Parent=self.Holder},{Corner(7)})
        end
        function Container:AddToggle(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,36)
            label(frame,options.Name,UDim2.new(1,-66,1,0))
            local switch=Create("TextButton",{Name="Switch",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(32,18),
                BackgroundColor3=Theme.ElementHover,BorderSizePixel=0,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Parent=frame},{Corner(9)})
            local dot=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.new(0,3,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Text,Parent=switch},{Corner(6)})
            local hit=Create("TextButton",{Name="ToggleHit",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",Parent=frame})
            local value=options.Default==true
            local object={Frame=frame}
            local function paint()
                switch.BackgroundColor3=value and Theme.Accent or Theme.ElementHover
                dot.Position=value and UDim2.new(1,-15,.5,0) or UDim2.new(0,3,.5,0)
            end
            function object:Get() return value end
            function object:Set(v,quiet) value=v==true;paint();if not quiet and options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end end
            connect(hit.Activated,function() object:Set(not value) end)
            paint();return object
        end
        function Container:AddSlider(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,54)
            label(frame,options.Name,UDim2.new(1,-85,0,25))
            local number=label(frame,"",UDim2.new(0,70,0,25));number.Position=UDim2.new(1,-80,0,0);number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            local area=Create("TextButton",{Name="SliderHit",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,26),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,24),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",Active=true,Parent=frame})
            local track=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.new(0,0,.5,-2),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,4),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=area},{Corner(2)})
            local fill=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=track},{Corner(2)})
            local knob=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Text,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=track},{Corner(5)})
            local minimum,maximum=options.Min or 0,options.Max or 100
            local increment=options.Increment or 1
            local value=math.clamp(tonumber(options.Default) or minimum,minimum,maximum)
            local active
            local object={Frame=frame}
            local function paint()
                local fraction=maximum>minimum and (value-minimum)/(maximum-minimum) or 0
                fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(fraction,1);knob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(fraction,.5)
                number.Text=tostring(value)..(options.Suffix or "")
            end
            function object:Get() return value end
            function object:Set(v,quiet)
                v=tonumber(v) or minimum
                if increment>0 then v=minimum+math.floor((v-minimum)/increment+.5)*increment end
                value=math.clamp(v,minimum,maximum);paint()
                if not quiet and options.Callback then options.Callback(value) end
            end
            local function setAt(input)
                if track.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then object:Set(minimum+math.clamp((input.Position.X-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/track.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)*(maximum-minimum)) end
            end
            connect(area.InputBegan,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then active=input;setAt(input) end
            end)
            connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
                if active and (input==active or (active.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then setAt(input) end
            end)
            connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
                if active and (input==active or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then active=nil end
            end)
            paint();return object
        end
        function Container:AddDropdown(options)
            local frame=row(self,options.Name,36)
