                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then press(false) end
            end)
            connect(hit.Activated,function()
                if os.clock()<entry.suppressUntil or (drag and drag.entry==entry and drag.moved) then return end
                local feature=source[entry.id]
                if feature and type(feature.toggle)=="function" then
                    local ok,err=pcall(feature.toggle)
                    if not ok then warn("[DaDa Buttons] "..entry.id..": "..tostring(err)) end
                end
            end)
            entries[def.id]=entry
            paintEntry(entry)
            return entry
        end
        connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
            if not drag then return end
            if drag.touch and input~=drag.input then return end
            if not drag.touch and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
            if state.locked or drag.entry.cfg.locked then return end
            local delta=Vector2.new(input.Position.X-drag.origin.X,input.Position.Y-drag.origin.Y)
            if delta.Magnitude>8 then drag.moved=true end
            if not drag.moved then return end
            drag.entry.suppressUntil=os.clock()+0.25
            local w,h=dimensions()
            drag.entry.cfg.x=math.clamp((drag.start.X-canvas.AbsolutePosition.X+delta.X)/w,0,1)
            drag.entry.cfg.y=math.clamp((drag.start.Y-canvas.AbsolutePosition.Y+delta.Y)/h,0,1)
            placement(drag.entry)
        end)
        connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
            if not drag then return end
            if (drag.touch and input~=drag.input) or (not drag.touch and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return end
            local entry=drag.entry
            if drag.moved then
                entry.suppressUntil=os.clock()+0.25
                if entry.positionX then entry.positionX:Set(entry.cfg.x*100) end
                if entry.positionY then entry.positionY:Set(entry.cfg.y*100) end
                save()
            end
            if entry.pressTween then entry.pressTween:Cancel() end
            entry.pressTween=tween(entry.scale,{Scale=1},0.18)
            drag=nil
        end)
        connect(canvas:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"),repaint)
        -- Complete feature catalog supplied by the existing UI binding registry.
        -- No extra automation implementation or action code is copied from Candy.
        local provider=Win._candyButtonsSnapshot or Win._quickSnapshot
        if type(provider)=="function" then
            local ok,result=pcall(provider)
            if ok and type(result)=="table" then catalog=result end
        end
        for _,feature in ipairs(catalog) do
            source[feature.id]=feature;byId[feature.id]=feature
        end
        local tab=Win:AddTab("Buttons","gear")
        local general=tab:AddSection("Buttons / General","left")
        local appearance=tab:AddSection("Buttons / Appearance","right")
        general:AddToggle("Enable Floating Buttons",state.enabled,function(v) state.enabled=v;repaint();save() end)
        general:AddToggle("Lock All Button Positions",state.locked,function(v) state.locked=v;save() end)
        general:AddToggle("Candy Style / All Menu Controls",state.skin,function(v)
            state.skin=v
            for _,s in pairs(skins) do s.paint() end
            save()
        end)
        local function all(key,value)
            defaults[key]=value
            for _,entry in pairs(entries) do entry.cfg[key]=value end
            for _,set in ipairs(controls) do
                local control=set[key]
                if control then control:Set(value) end
            end
            repaint();save()
        end
        appearance:AddSlider("All Buttons / Width",80,400,defaults.width,function(v) all("width",v) end,"px")
        appearance:AddSlider("All Buttons / Height",44,200,defaults.height,function(v) all("height",v) end,"px")
        appearance:AddSlider("All Buttons / Transparency",0,90,defaults.transparency*100,function(v) all("transparency",v/100) end,"%")
        appearance:AddSlider("All Buttons / Corner Radius",0,40,defaults.corner,function(v) all("corner",v) end,"px")
        local function action(section,text,callback)
            local frame=Instance.new("TextButton")
            frame.Name="CandyAction";frame.Text=text;frame.TextWrapped=true
            frame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,36);frame.BorderSizePixel=0
            frame.BackgroundColor3=palette().inner;frame.TextColor3=palette().text
            frame.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;frame.TextSize=13
            corner(frame,8);section:MountMigrated(frame)
            connect(frame.Activated,callback)
            return frame
        end
        action(general,"Reset All Button Positions",function()
            for i,feature in ipairs(catalog) do
                local cfg=state.buttons[feature.id]
                if cfg then
                    cfg.x=0.18+(i-1)%5*0.15;cfg.y=0.35+math.floor((i-1)/5)%3*0.16
                    local entry=entries[feature.id]
                    if entry and entry.positionX then entry.positionX:Set(cfg.x*100) end
                    if entry and entry.positionY then entry.positionY:Set(cfg.y*100) end
                end
            end
            repaint();save()
        end)
        action(general,"Hide All Floating Buttons",function()
            for _,feature in ipairs(catalog) do
                local cfg=state.buttons[feature.id]
                if cfg then cfg.visible=false end
                if byId[feature.id].visibility then byId[feature.id].visibility:Set(false) end
            end
            repaint();save()
        end)
        local availableLeft=tab:AddSection("Available Buttons / Left","left")
        local availableRight=tab:AddSection("Available Buttons / Right","right")
        for index,feature in ipairs(catalog) do
            local entry=createEntry(feature,index)
            local cfg=entry.cfg
            -- Retain full, unshortened original feature names.
            local section=index%2==1 and availableLeft or availableRight
            local visible=section:AddToggle(feature.label.." / Show Button",cfg.visible,function(v)
                cfg.visible=v;paintEntry(entry);save()
            end)
            feature.visibility=visible
            local options=visible:AddSettings()
            local set={}
            controls[#controls+1]=set
            options:AddToggle(feature.label.." / Lock Position",cfg.locked,function(v) cfg.locked=v;save() end)
            set.width=options:AddSlider(feature.label.." / Width",80,400,cfg.width,function(v) cfg.width=v;paintEntry(entry);save() end,"px")
            set.height=options:AddSlider(feature.label.." / Height",44,200,cfg.height,function(v) cfg.height=v;paintEntry(entry);save() end,"px")
            local opacity=options:AddSlider(feature.label.." / Transparency",0,90,cfg.transparency*100,function(v)
                cfg.transparency=v/100;paintEntry(entry);save()
            end,"%")
            set.transparency={Set=function(_,v) opacity:Set(v*100) end}
            set.corner=options:AddSlider(feature.label.." / Corner Radius",0,40,cfg.corner,function(v) cfg.corner=v;paintEntry(entry);save() end,"px")
            entry.positionX=options:AddSlider(feature.label.." / Horizontal Position",0,100,cfg.x*100,function(v) cfg.x=v/100;placement(entry);save() end,"%")
            entry.positionY=options:AddSlider(feature.label.." / Vertical Position",0,100,cfg.y*100,function(v) cfg.y=v/100;placement(entry);save() end,"%")
        end
        local elapsed=0
        connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
            elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<0.2 then return end;elapsed=0
            if type(provider)=="function" then
                local ok,result=pcall(provider)
                if ok and type(result)=="table" then
                    for _,feature in ipairs(result) do source[feature.id]=feature end
                end
            end
            local p=palette()
            for button,s in pairs(skins) do
                if button.Parent then
                    s.edge.Color=p.accent
                    if s.trackEdge then s.trackEdge.Color=p.accent end
                end
            end
            repaint()
        end)
        local function cleanup()
            if not alive then return end
            saveNow();alive=false;drag=nil
            for _,c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            for button,s in pairs(skins) do
                pcall(function()
                    if s.animation then s.animation:Cancel() end
                    button.AutoButtonColor=s.auto
                    button.BackgroundColor3=s.background
                    button.BackgroundTransparency=s.transparency
                    s.edge:Destroy()
                    if s.trackEdge then s.trackEdge:Destroy() end
                    if s.ownedCorner then s.corner:Destroy() end
                end)
            end
            if root.Parent then root:Destroy() end
        end
        connect(gui.Destroying,cleanup)
        local previousUnload=environment.DADA_UNLOAD
        environment.DADA_UNLOAD=function(...)
            cleanup()
            if type(previousUnload)=="function" then return previousUnload(...) end
        end
        Win.CandyButtons={Tab=tab,Entries=entries,Settings=state,Refresh=repaint,Cleanup=cleanup}
        repaint()
        return Win.CandyButtons
    end
    local ok,err=xpcall(installCandyButtons,function(e) return tostring(e).."\n"..debug.traceback() end)
    if not ok then warn("[DaDa Buttons] UI installation failed: "..tostring(err)) end
end
-- END DADA CANDY BUTTONS

Win:SetOpen(true)
return Win
